**Wat bieden wij?**
-------------------


* € 3\.405 \- € 4\.911 o.b.v. 40 uur
* 40\-urige werkweek
* Diverse opleidingsmogelijkheden
* Genoeg verlofdagen. Deze zijn ook extra te kopen
* Persoonlijk Arbeidsvoorwaarden Budget van 13,7%
* Goede werk en privébalans vinden we belangrijk
* Wij zijn goed voor het klimaat én voor jou
* Samenwerken aan onze missie

**Wat is vereist?**
-------------------


* Minimaal Mbo\- 2 (bij voorkeur richting bedrijfsautotechniek);
* Ervaring met mechanische, pneumatische en hydraulische systemen.
**Vacature**
------------


**Word jij blij van technisch vakwerk, waar je werk net zo afwisselend is als het wagenpark zelf en waar de focus ligt op kwaliteit boven snelheid? Dan is de functie van bedrijfsautotechnicus iets voor jou!**


Als bedrijfsautotechnicus werk je bij ons aan een breed en uniek wagenpark, met wagens die soms letterlijk meer kosten dan een Ferrari. Van vrachtwagens, veegmachines tot personenauto’s en zelfs specialistisch materieel zoals walking floors en LZV’s.


**Wat collega Huub Jonker (1e bedrijfsautotechnicus) zegt over het werk:**
  

*“Het motto is hier: liever wat langer aan iets werken, als het maar goed is. Dat is het grote verschil met andere garages. We werken niet alleen aan de vrachtwagens zelf, maar ook aan de opbouw op de wagens, waardoor je ook veel te maken krijgt met hydrauliek en pneumatiek. Als je begint als bedrijfsautotechnicus, groei je makkelijk door naar 1e bedrijfsautotechnicus en diagnosespecialist. Je kunt papieren halen voor verschillende bevoegdheden, zoals keurings\- of tachograafspecialist.”*


**De sollicitatieprocedure:**
  

Deze bestaat uit twee sollicitatiegesprekken en een meeloopdag zodat je een goed beeld krijgt van de werkzaamheden. Maar er is ook de mogelijkheid om eerst een kop koffie te drinken en een kijkje te nemen in de werkplaats.  

  



### **Ga voor de betere wereldbaan!**


Voor verdere informatie over deze functie kan je contact opnemen met Raziye Ugur via telefoonnummer \+31623560662 of r.ugur@hvcgroep.nl.

jobs.title: Verkoopmedewerker
jobs.description:
**Dit ga je doen**


In een Kruidvatwinkel is er altijd wat te doen. En dat is maar goed ook, want jij bent gek op die dynamiek. Moeiteloos schakel je als verkoopmedewerker tussen alle verschillende werkzaamheden. Je zorgt ervoor dat de afgeleverde voorraad verwerkt wordt, de schappen op tijd aangevuld zijn en de winkel er tiptop uitziet. Tussendoor help je klanten of spring je bij achter de kassa. Dit alles doe je in een supergezellig \#vriendenteam met leuke collega’s die net zo van aanpakken houden als jij. Jullie zijn goed op elkaar ingespeeld en maken van iedere werkdag een feestje. En ook na werktijd is er tijd voor ontspanning en doen jullie leuke dingen: soms een drankje, soms een filmpje of een gezellig bedrijfsuitje. Work hard, play harder, toch?! Dankzij dit teamgevoel zorgen jullie er samen voor dat klanten met een lach én een tas vol Kruidvatproducten de winkel weer uit lopen. Werken bij Kruidvat is blij worden van een dagje knallen, met als resultaat tevreden klanten en een lekkere omzet. Dat voelt goed! Dus, waar wacht je nog op?

  

  

**Dit krijg je ervoor terug**

* Een goed startsalaris: afhankelijk van je ervaring tussen de € 2\.361,\- en € 2\.554,\- bruto per maand (vanaf 21 jaar) bij een dienstverband van 37 uur per week. Benieuwd naar hoeveel je ongeveer gaat verdienen? Bereken hieronder je (bruto) maandsalaris.
* We zeiden het al, een superleuk \#vriendenteam vol enthousiaste collega’s.
* Doorgroeimogelijkheden en opleidingen (wij betalen!) aan onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij Kruidvat sta je nooit stil.
* Personeelskorting bij alle winkels van Kruidvat, Trekpleister én ICI PARIS XL in Nederland. Jazeker, deze horen er ook bij!
* En er is meer… als je een nieuwe collega aandraagt, ontvang je een bonus van € 100,\- bruto voor een winkelmedewerker en maar liefst € 1\.000,\- bruto voor een leidinggevende functie.


**Dit ben jij**

* Je bent minimaal 16 jaar oud en hebt (bijna) een middelbareschooldiploma.
* Je hebt ervaring in de detailhandel of horeca, het liefst in een drukke omgeving waar je continu bezig bent.
* Je vindt het niet erg om overdag, ’s avonds, in het weekend, op feestdagen of tijdens schoolvakanties te werken.
* Je weet als geen ander hoe je klanten het beste kunt helpen en adviseren.
* Je wilt graag het erkende diploma Verkoop in de Drogisterij halen (wij betalen!).


Join \#teamkruidvat! Solliciteer direct en laten we kijken of we een ‘match’ zijn.

jobs.title: Cateringmedewerker Booking Campus
Verzorgende IG coördinerend - Locatie Forum II
Klinisch psycholoog Schematherapie voor adolescenten
jobs.description:
**3 redenen waarom deze functie bij jou past:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Je blijft actief betrokken bij de behandeling van adolescenten en hun gezinnen binnen een hoog\-specialistisch behandelprogramma.
* Je bouwt mee aan de zorg van morgen. Je krijgt de ruimte om het behandelaanbod voor adolescenten met persoonlijkheidsproblemen verder te ontwikkelen, innovaties te initiëren en de kwaliteit van zorg blijvend te versterken.
* Je werkt samen met bevlogen professionals binnen een TOPGGz werkomgeving. Samen met collega's draag je bij aan wetenschappelijk onderbouwde, hoog\-specialistische zorg en lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het behandelprogramma.

**Wat wij jou bieden:**
-----------------------

* Een uitdagende en veelzijdige functie voor minimaal 24 uur per week met een zorginhoudelijke rol;
* Een bruto maandsalaris, op basis van 36 uur per week, ingeschaald in FWG 70 conform CAO\-GGZ. De salarisrange ligt tussen de €5\.988,\- en €8\.146,\- afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Heb je momenteel een hogere inschaling? Dan behoud je deze. Ben je afgestudeerd klinisch psycholoog? Dan is inschaling mogelijk in FWG 70/75;
* 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en 8,33% vakantiegeld;
* Ruimte voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling binnen een topklinische organisatie.

**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------


Bij de Viersprong geloven we dat jongeren met ernstige persoonlijkheidsproblemen recht hebben op een beter toekomstperspectief. Met onze klinische schematherapie bieden we hoog\-specialistische behandeling aan adolescenten voor wie eerdere behandelingen onvoldoende resultaat hebben gehad. Als klinisch psycholoog werk je als regiebehandelaar en behandelaar van jongeren en hun gezinnen. Je levert vanuit jouw expertise een belangrijke bijdrage aan de kwaliteit van zorg, de verdere ontwikkeling van het behandelprogramma en de professionele ontwikkeling binnen het team.

* Je bent regiebehandelaar binnen een multidisciplinair behandelteam.
* Je verricht diagnostiek en behandeling van adolescenten met complexe persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en hun gezinnen.
* Je bewaakt en versterkt de kwaliteit van diagnostiek, behandeling en het behandelprogramma, passend binnen de geldende kwaliteitsstandaarden en richtlijnen.
* Je stimuleert innovatie en deskundigheidsbevordering, zodat het programma zich blijft ontwikkelen.
* Je werkt intensief samen met collega's, verwijzers, ketenpartners en andere deskundigen om de zorg voor adolescenten te versterken.

**Naar wie zijn we op zoek?**
-----------------------------

* Je hebt een BIG\-registratie als **klinisch psycholoog** en hebt ruime ervaring binnen de specialistische ggz;
* Je beschikt over aantoonbare inhoudelijke expertise op het gebied van persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en hebt een duidelijke visie op de behandeling van jongeren met persoonlijkheidsproblemen;
* Je bent een sterke samenwerkingspartner met affiniteit voor innovatie en de verdere ontwikkeling van specialistische zorg;
* Je bent in staat complexe interne en externe samenwerkingen vorm te geven en verder te ontwikkelen;
* Je bent minimaal 24 uur per week beschikbaar. Een grotere aanstelling behoort tot de mogelijkheden door inzet binnen andere behandelprogramma's van De Viersprong. We bespreken graag samen wat daarbij past bij jouw expertise en interesses;
* Je hebt sterke reflectieve vaardigheden, bent besluitvaardig en weet collega's te inspireren vanuit jouw vakinhoudelijke expertise.

**Word jij onze nieuwe collega?**
---------------------------------


Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Anouk Schippers, Directeur Landelijke Zorg, via 06 \- 20 37 29 95\.

**De Viersprong \- De werkgever die je verder brengt.**
-------------------------------------------------------


Wist jij dat De Viersprong een TOPGGz\-keurmerk heeft? Dat betekent dat wij behoren tot de top van de gespecialiseerde ggz in Nederland. We bieden bewezen effectieve behandelingen, doen structureel wetenschappelijk onderzoek en blijven voortdurend innoveren. Maar misschien nog wel belangrijker: we zijn een organisatie waar jij écht het verschil kunt maken.


Bij De Viersprong werk je in een groeiende organisatie met grote maatschappelijke waarde. Bij ons is er ruimte voor ontwikkeling, initiatief en creatieve ideeën. Je krijgt de kans om je te verdiepen én te verbreden, of je nu ervaring hebt in de specialistische ggz of niet. Juist de diversiteit aan achtergronden binnen onze teams maakt ons sterker. Wij leren graag van jou!


Samen met het Milieu Platform Zorgsector (MPZ) bouwen we aan een gezonde en duurzame toekomst voor cliënten, medewerkers én de samenleving.


Ben jij net als wij nooit uitgeleerd? Ontdek wie wij zijn en misschien ontdek je tegelijkertijd wel jouw volgende functie. Kijk op www.deviersprong.nl of op onze LinkedIn\-pagina.


De Viersprong verlangt van een nieuwe medewerker bij indiensttreding een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag.

jobs.title: Begeleider gehandicaptenzorg Vijzelmolen C
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Horecamedewerker Horapark
jobs.description:
**Jouw werkplek**
-----------------


Zodra je aankomt rijden in de buurt van je werk, kom je steeds meer tot rust. Midden in het bos staat het Horapark waar verschillende bedrijven gevestigd zijn. Hier verzorg jij alles wat met eten en drinken te maken heeft. Goed om te weten: echt alles is vers. Maar echt vers! Ook verzorgen wij hier receptiediensten om alle gasten te ontvangen!


Naast het restaurant verzorgen wij ook verschillende banqetingparijen. De afwisseling is hier erg groot!

**Jouw team**


Binnen het horapark, werken we met een klein maar hecht team. We staan altijd voor elkaar klaar en zien wanneer iemand hulp nodig heeft. Doordat we receptiediensten, banqetingpartijen en het restaurant verzorgen is letterlijk iedere dag anders!

**Jouw functie**
----------------

*‘Goedemorgen!’* Je bent met het goede been uit bed gestapt en hebt zin om aan de slag te gaan. Als horecamedewerker bij Horapark, Ede maak je het restaurant 100% klaar voor een van de belangrijkste momenten van de dag. Je helpt bij het voorbereiden van alle gerechten en dranken waar jouw gasten op zitten te wachten.


Dan is het etenstijd. Je ontvangt de gasten op een gastvrije manier, zoals alleen jij dat kan. Hierdoor kan jij je dienstverlening personaliseren! En nog leuker; de gasten kennen jou inmiddels ook.


Na etenstijd ga je aan de slag met het opruimen en voorbereiden voor de rest van de dag en morgen. Verder maak je (vergaderende) mensen blij maken met een bakje koffie, tussendoortje of borrel. Door jouw vriendelijke service, is iedereen erg tevreden en kan jij met een voldaan gevoel naar huis.


**Jouw ingrediënten**
---------------------

* Het liefst heb je al wat horeca\-ervaring, maar ook als aanstormend talent kun je bij ons terecht. Je voelt je in ieder geval thuis in de horeca;
* Dat werken in de horeca fysiek best pittig kan zijn weet je;
* Jij zet altijd net dat extra stapje. Vooral wat gastvrijheid en service betreft;
* Liefde gaat door de maag als het om eten \& drinken gaat;
* Bij Vermaat zit veiligheid in het fundament. Onze gasten kunnen rekenen op een voedselveilige omgeving omdat jij het iedere dag serieus neemt;
* Je kan op verzoek een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aanleveren.


*Sluiten de ingrediënten niet helemaal aan bij jou? Bij Vermaat verwelkomen we iedereen en omarmen we onze verschillen. Ervaar jij, om wat voor reden dan ook, een afstand tot werk? Via onze* **Social Return** *pagina komen onze Jobcoaches graag met jou in contact.*

jobs.title: Persoonlijk Begeleider (niveau 5) Dagbehandeling Jeugd
jobs.description:
**Wat ga je doen**
------------------


Voor onze dagbehandeling zoeken wij een persoonlijk begeleider niveau 5 die met energie, warmte en professionaliteit wil bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van jeugdigen met een (licht) verstandelijke beperking en/of gedragsuitdagingen.

**Waarom jij dit wilt**


Omdat je hier meer doet dan begeleiden. Jij bouwt aan vertrouwen, veiligheid en groei. Je ziet kleine stapjes als grote overwinningen en viert ze samen met het kind én het team. Geen dag is hetzelfde\- en dat maakt jouw werk juist zo waardevol.


Krijg jij energie van het begeleiden van jeugdigen in hun ontwikkeling? Wil jij werken op een plek waar je gezien wordt en waar jouw werk ertoe doet?


Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en ontdek hoe waardevol jouw rol kan zijn.


Jij wordt succesvol als Persoonlijk Begeleider niveau 5 in deze behandelgroepen door:

* Mee te bewegen, nabijheid en voorspelbaarheid te combineren. Hierdoor creëren wij een omgeving waarin jeugdigen met een verstandelijke beperking zich veilig kunnen voelen en zich kunnen ontwikkelen
* Collega's te coachen op inhoud van de zorg
* Een voorspelbaar dagprogramma te maken met contact en communicatie als de rode draad
* Beweging, lichaams\- en ontwikkelingsgerichte plannen te maken
* Multidisciplinair te handelen. Dit betekent schakelen met behandelaren, paramedici of therapeuten wanneer nodig.
* Samen te werken met alle betrokkenen, van zorginstellingen, tot collega’s tot verwant van de jeugdige
* Zelfvertrouwen uit te stralen
* Zelfstandig te werken en tegelijkertijd altijd klaar te staan om je collega's te ondersteunen waar nodig.
* De jeugdigen te begeleiden volgens de afspraken uit het ondersteuningsplan.


Als Persoonlijk Begeleider niveau 5 streef je ernaar om samen met de jeugdige het leven zo betekenisvol in te richten waardoor er dagelijks geleerd kan worden van fouten en successen gevierd worden.


Je hebt een groot hart, en je gaat binnen een gedreven team aan de slag met collega's die net als jij in het leven staan. Omdat jeugdigen zich snel ontwikkelen, is intensieve samenwerking met alle betrokkenen rond de jeugdige essentieel. We stemmen daarom regelmatig af met alle zorgprofessionals in onder andere in teamvergaderingen. Voor de jeugdigen werken we integraal samen met ouders en alle betrokken professionals en stemmen onze zorg af tijdens MDO’s. Daarnaast is er ruimte voor overleg vóór of na het dagprogramma.


Belangrijk om te weten is, dat wij altijd achter elkaar staan, vooral wanneer er zich een pittige situatie voordoet. Wij zijn een organisatie die de mens voor op zet. Doormiddel van directe feedback zijn wij met elkaar een lerende organisatie die ervoor staat om voor de jeugdigeen én medewerkers een veilige en prettige omgeving te creëren.

**Wat bieden wij**
------------------

* Je komt te werken in regio Hoorn; via Amsterdam, Haarlem en Alkmaar minder dan 45 minuten rijden;
* Salaris in FWG 45 CAO GHZ;
* Opleidings\- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden;

* Faciliteiten om ‘goed in je vel’ te zitten;

* Leuke bonusregeling van € 350,\- netto bij het aandragen van je nieuwe collega’s.

**Wat neem je mee**
-------------------

* Afgeronde hbo\-opleiding in de richting zorg en welzijn
* Je bent in staat om gedrag te vertalen en de begeleiding hierop aan te passen
* Je beschikt over zelfreflectie en functioneert prima in een team.

jobs.title: AI Consultant
jobs.description:
**About RevoData**


RevoData is a boutique Data \& AI consultancy and proud Databricks partner. We focus exclusively on Databricks, allowing us to go deep and do things properly. We help companies across Europe unlock the value in their data, helping them design and build scalable platforms that support real business use cases.


We foster a no\-ego, no\-nonsense culture where collaboration, proactivity and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.


Sound like your kind of environment? Then keep scrolling!

**About the Role**


You'll join RevoData's FuseAI team — the team behind FuseAI, our Private AI platform. As an AI Consultant, you'll work at the intersection of people, technology and impact. You'll help organisations understand how AI can support their work – giving demos to non\-technical stakeholders, guiding conversations and translating challenges into clear AI solutions.


You'll also get hands\-on building workflows, RAG systems and AI agents on FuseAI, while supporting our sales efforts with your expertise when needed.


This is a consultancy role for someone who enjoys switching smoothly between client\-facing work and technical implementation.

 **Requirements** **About You**


You enjoy helping people understand new technology \- especially those without a technical background. You’re patient, curious, and confident explaining complex ideas in a simple way.


You’re comfortable giving demos to clients across various domains, and you’re able to build trust quickly. At the same time, you like diving into the technical details: experimenting with GenAI, creating workflows and turning business needs into real working solutions. You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly, and collaborate easily with both colleagues and clients.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Build and maintain end\-to\-end AI agents** that automate processes or support employees.
* **Design and implement RAG** systems to deliver reliable, context\-aware AI outputs.
* **Act as a trusted advisor** to clients throughout the engagement \- identify new opportunities for AI to create value and guide them through adoption at their pace.
* **Translate business challenges into practical AI solutions** \- understand the client’s goals, ask the right questions and map their needs to what our platform can deliver.
* **Develop and implement** the Private AI platform at clients.
* **Give demos of our Private AI platform** to clients \- often to non\-technical stakeholders such as government officials or healthcare professionals.
* **Develop and implement** the Private AI platform at clients.
* **Create and optimise workflows** using tools such as n8n.
* **Support sales** with your technical expertise by joining early\-stage conversations, helping scope opportunities.
* **Contribute to best practices and platform development** by sharing ideas, improving architecture, and helping shape how Private AI is implemented across our client base.
* **Act as a trusted advisor** to clients throughout the engagement \- identifying new opportunities for AI to create value and guiding them through adoption at their pace.

**What You Bring**

* A background in **consultancy, data or IT**, with enough experience to navigate client conversations and manage expectations effectively.
* Solid working knowledge of **Python**, and familiarity with **SQL.**
* Experience with **(Gen)AI concepts** such as LLMs, RAG or prompt engineering \- or the ability to learn these quickly.
* Strong communication skills, especially when speaking with non\-technical stakeholders.
* Patience, clarity and confidence when explaining how AI works to people unfamiliar with the technology.
* A proactive, curious mindset and eagerness to explore the latest AI and software engineering developments.
* **Comfort juggling multiple tasks at once**, switching context smoothly, and keeping a clear overview in fast\-moving environments.
* Ability to translate business questions into concrete, technical solutions.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with teammates and clients.
* Fluency in **English \& Dutch.**

**Nice\-to\-haves:**

* Experience with **Kubernetes.**
* Knowledge of **vector databases** (Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus).
* Familiarity with **LLM Ops / MLOps** practices.
* Background in **data engineering.**
* Experience with **workflow/automation tools** such as n8n.

*We are open to hiring at Medior level for this position. For corresponding salary bandings, please scroll to Additional Information below.*

 **Benefits** **What we offer:**

**Tech Playground:** Love experimenting? So do we. Play around with Databricks, Terraform, Terragrunt, Asset Bundles, CI/CD, monitoring \& alerting tools, Cursor and more.

**Unlimited Learning:** Take advantage of our partner academies, weekly workshops, and lunch \& learns.

**Fun Clubs:** Join our climbing club, padel club, language club or start your own club!

**Work\-Life Balance:** We trust you to get the job done \- whether you're an early bird or a night owl. Our hybrid set up includes 2\-3 days at the office. We all work together on Wednesdays at our HQ in NDSM, and the rest is up to you: work from home or join us at the office.

**Wellbeing Budget:** Monthly €75 net wellbeing budget to spend however you like \- some recent spends have included gym memberships, bouldering shoes, a Calm\-app subscription or a trip to the hairdresser!

**Allowances:** Every month work from home, travel \& internet/phone allowance.

**Additional Perks:** Pension plan, lunch at the office, quarterly events, workation option \& a pet\-friendly office in the heart of NDSM!

**We'd love to meet you!**


If you resonate with our technology, culture, and vision, we're excited to meet you! Apply directly through this vacancy, our website, or connect with me on LinkedIn. We appreciate a CV that goes further than listing your job experience. We appreciate a CV that goes beyond your experience – a picture of your pet, a podcast you’re currently enjoying or a fun fact are always welcome!


We value getting to know you better, and our final interview takes place in person at our Amsterdam office. Please note, we do not cover interview travel costs or relocation expenses and cannot provide visa sponsorships as we are not registered as a referee employer.

**Additional info:**

* We'd like this person to start as soon as possible, but exact start date can be discussed during the interview. Apply now and be part of our next chapter of growth.
* We are open to hiring at Medior level for this position. Our Medior salary range is €50,000\-€65,000 per year.

jobs.title: Senior Software Solution Architect – C#/.NET (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Wir suchen**


Sie möchten nicht nur Software entwickeln, sondern technische Lösungen von der Idee bis zum produktiven Betrieb gestalten? **\- Dann sind Sie bei HWS richtig.** Wir sind eine mittelständische Wirtschaftsprüfungs\- und Steuerberatungsgesellschaft aus Baden\-Württemberg. Unsere Arbeit verbindet anspruchsvolle Beratung mit dem klaren Ziel, Prozesse intelligenter, einfacher und digitaler zu gestalten.  

  

Dafür suchen wir einen erfahrenen **Senior Software Solution Architect (m/w/d)**, der unsere Softwarearchitektur maßgeblich mitgestaltet und gleichzeitig nah an der technischen Umsetzung bleibt. Unser technologischer Schwerpunkt liegt auf **C\#** und dem modernen **.NET\-Stack** – ebenso wie auf einer **KI\-basierten Softwareentwicklung**. Wir arbeiten mit **modernen KI\-Werkzeugen** und **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, um Anforderungen zu analysieren, Architekturen und Code zu entwerfen, Tests vorzubereiten und Dokumentationen zu erstellen.  

  

Deshalb suchen wir keine klassische Softwareentwicklung – bei der jede Zeile Code selbst geschrieben wird, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die **KI\-gestützte Entwicklung** professionell steuert: effiziente Prompts formuliert, Ergebnisse kritisch prüft, Qualität sicherstellt und gemeinsam mit dem Team wartbare und zuverlässig betreibbare Softwarelösungen schafft.

#### **Ihre Aufgaben**


Sie gestalten gemeinsam mit unserem Team die technische Architektur unserer digitalen Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung und moderner Softwareentwicklung.


Dabei arbeiten Sie sowohl an internen Anwendungen zur Automatisierung und Digitalisierung unserer Kanzlei als auch an digitalen Produkten und Services für unsere Mandant:innen.


Konkret bedeutet das:

* Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für **Solution Design und Softwarearchitektur** neuer und bestehender Anwendungen und entwickeln daraus tragfähige technische Zielbilder.
* Sie entwerfen und entwickeln Lösungen schwerpunktmäßig auf Basis von **C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core und Web APIs**.
* Sie definieren geeignete Architekturprinzipien, Schnittstellen, Komponenten und Datenmodelle und schaffen damit die Grundlage für **langfristig wartbare Systeme**.
* Sie wählen pragmatisch zwischen **modularen Anwendungen, Services und Integrationslösungen** – passend zur jeweiligen Aufgabenstellung.
* Sie konzipieren die Integration interner und externer Systeme über **REST APIs und weitere Schnittstellen**, beispielsweise zu Finanzbuchhaltung, Dokumentenmanagement, Kollaborations\- oder Datenplattformen.
* Sie entwickeln unsere **GitLab\-basierte Entwicklungs\- und Delivery\-Landschaft**, unsere CI/CD\-Pipelines und Deployment\-Prozesse gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.
* Sie analysieren bestehende Anwendungen und Systemlandschaften, erkennen technische Risiken und entwickeln geeignete **Modernisierungs\- und Migrationsstrategien**.
* Sie bleiben nah an der technischen Umsetzung, entwickeln bei wichtigen Komponenten und Prototypen selbst mit und unterstützen das Team durch **Code\- und Architecture\-Reviews**.
* Sie arbeiten eng mit unseren **Fachbereichen** zusammen, übersetzen fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungen und dokumentieren wesentliche Architekturentscheidungen nachvollziehbar.
* Sie nutzen **KI\- und LLM\-Werkzeuge** von der Anforderungsanalyse und dem Solution Design bis zur Codegenerierung, Dokumentation und Testvorbereitung. Die Ergebnisse prüfen Sie konsequent im Hinblick auf Qualität, Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit, Performance und Compliance.

#### **Ihr Profil**


Unser Tech\-Stack entwickelt sich mit unseren Anforderungen kontinuierlich weiter. Für diese Rolle setzen wir bewusst einen starken Schwerpunkt auf das **Microsoft\- und C\#\-Ökosystem**: **C\# · .NET · ASP.NET Core · Web APIs · REST · Entity Framework · SQL · GitLab · CI/CD · Docker**  

Darüber hinaus begegnen Ihnen moderne Web\-Technologien, Cloud\- und Container\-Plattformen, Automatisierung, Identity \& Access Management, Monitoring sowie KI\- und LLM\-basierte Anwendungen.  




Das macht Sie aus und passt zu HWS:


* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit **C\# und .NET**, idealerweise in einer Senior\-, Lead\- oder Architekturrolle
* Fundierte Erfahrung im **Solution Design und in der Architektur anspruchsvoller Softwarelösungen**
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in **C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, API\- und Backend\-Entwicklung** sowie in Datenmodellierung, Systemintegration und verteilten Systemen
* Praxiserfahrung mit **GitLab, CI/CD\-Pipelines, Docker**, relationalen Datenbanken und ORM\-Technologien
* Erfahrung entlang des gesamten **Software\-Lifecycles** – von der Analyse und Entwicklung über automatisierte Tests bis zu Deployment und Monitoring
* Eine ausgeprägte **Hands\-on\-Mentalität** sowie die Fähigkeit, pragmatische Architekturentscheidungen zu treffen und bei Bedarf selbst produktiven Code zu entwickeln
* Ein **hoher** **Qualitätsanspruch**, den Sie durch Standards, Reviews, automatisierte Tests und Security\-Checks im Team verankern
* Sichere **Deutschkenntnisse** und die Fähigkeit, **technische Zusammenhänge** verständlich zu vermitteln
* Erfahrung mit oder Interesse an **KI\-gestützter Softwareentwicklung**: Sie steuern KI\-Werkzeuge gezielt, formulieren Anforderungen präzise und validieren die Ergebnisse verantwortungsvoll
* Idealerweise Interesse an datenintensiven oder regulierten Prozessen sowie an **Finance, Tax und Compliance** – das notwendige Fachwissen vermitteln wir Ihnen


#### **Warum wir?**

* **Arbeiten von überall in Deutschland:** Wir arbeiten remote und setzen auf eine verlässliche, direkte Zusammenarbeit ohne überflüssige Präsenzpflicht.
* **Echte Architekturverantwortung:** Sie setzen nicht nur vorgegebene Tickets um, sondern gestalten maßgeblich mit, wie unsere zukünftige Softwarelandschaft aufgebaut wird.
* **Hands\-on statt PowerPoint\-Architektur:** Architektur und Entwicklung gehören für uns zusammen. Ihre technischen Entscheidungen müssen sich daher auch im produktiven System bewähren.
* **Ein moderner .NET\-Technologiestack:** C\# und .NET bilden den zentralen technologischen Schwerpunkt unserer Softwareentwicklung.
* **Engineering mit Anspruch:** Automatisierte Tests, GitLab CI/CD, saubere Schnittstellen, Security, Observability und wartbarer Code sind für uns feste Bestandteile professioneller Softwareentwicklung.
* **Technologischer Gestaltungsspielraum:** Sie setzen Technologien gezielt dort ein, wo sie ein konkretes Problem sinnvoll lösen – nicht nur, weil sie gerade im Trend liegen.
* **Kurze Wege:** Sie arbeiten direkt mit den Menschen zusammen, die Ihre Lösungen später einsetzen, und können fachliche sowie technische Entscheidungen wirksam beeinflussen.
* **Raum für neue Themen:** Neben klassischen Geschäftsanwendungen beschäftigen Sie sich bei uns mit Automatisierung, Datenintegration und neuen Möglichkeiten durch KI und Large Language Models.
* **Ein bodenständiges Team:** Sie erwartet ein professionelles und hilfsbereites Team ohne unnötiges Tech\-Theater. Gute Argumente zählen bei uns mehr als Titel.
* **AI\-first Engineering:** Wir entwickeln maßgeblich KI\-gestützt und nutzen LLMs entlang des gesamten Software\-Lifecycles – von der Anforderungsanalyse und Architektur über die Implementierung bis hin zu Testing, Dokumentation und Betrieb.
* **Qualität durch systematische Reviews:** KI\-generierte Ergebnisse übernehmen wir nicht ungeprüft, sondern sichern sie durch automatisierte Tests, strukturierte Review\-Prozesse und klare Qualitätssicherungskriterien ab.

#### **Ansprechpartner**

**Klingt nach Ihrem nächsten Schritt?** Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf sowie – wenn vorhanden – Links zu GitHub, Portfolio, Projektbeispielen oder anderen Arbeiten, auf die Sie stolz sind.  

  

Frau Beatrix Dreher  

  

**HWS Intelligence GmbH**  

Schiffgraben 39 • 30175 Hannover  

\+49 711 78892\-0  

karriere@hws.de

#### **Über uns**


Wir bei HWS glauben daran, dass sich unser Erfolg, auch, wenn er durch Zahlen belegbar ist, letzten Endes an den Menschen misst, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten! Unser HWS Prinzip aus Verstehen, Kümmern, Begeistern macht uns zum Top Ansprechpartner des Mittelstands \- und zum attraktiven Arbeitgeber. Wir sind regional vernetzt, agieren global und bieten das ganze Spektrum an Dienstleistungen rund um Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung und Rechtsberatung an. HWS vereint mit etwa 750 hoch qualifizierten Mitarbeitern die Zuverlässigkeit einer etablierten Marke mit über 100\-jähriger Erfahrung und die Wandlungsfähigkeit einer jungen dynamischen Geschäftsgruppe.

jobs.title: Business Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Helm Operations, we build the software that keeps the world’s maritime operations moving. From tugboats in Vancouver Harbour to offshore service vessels in the North Sea, our customers rely on Helm CONNECT to manage their crews, maintenance, compliance, and day\-to\-day operations — and we don’t take that responsibility lightly.

World\-class software doesn’t happen by chance. It takes people who care deeply about quality, take ownership, collaborate effectively, and continually look for better ways to work. That’s The Helm Way, and that’s where you come in.

As Helm continues to grow internationally, Europe is a key part of our next stage of growth. **We’re looking for a Business Development Engineer based in Central Europe or the UK,** with the ability to work within relevant European business hours, who can help us expand our presence across the region by building relationships with maritime operators, uncovering operational challenges, and showing prospective customers how Helm CONNECT can make a meaningful difference in their businesses.

This is not a traditional sales role. You’ll need the curiosity to understand how maritime businesses operate, the technical confidence to have credible conversations about software and workflows, and the commercial drive to turn opportunities into long\-term customer relationships.

You’ll work closely with our Sales, Product, Professional Services, and Marketing teams to identify opportunities, develop the European market, and help more maritime organizations discover a better way to run their operations.

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable creating momentum rather than waiting for it — someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded, technically capable, and hungry to build something in a growing market.

**Your Mission**

Proactively prospect and generate new business opportunities across Europe through outbound outreach (calls, email, LinkedIn, and other channels)

Qualify inbound leads and route sales\-ready prospects to the appropriate Account Executive

Book and support product demonstrations, with a quarterly target of 30 completed demos

Maintain a disciplined outreach cadence, with a benchmark of approximately 10 qualified contacts per demo booked

Research target accounts and personalize outreach to reflect regional market nuances across European sub\-regions (UK, DACH, Nordics, Southern Europe, etc.)

Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of prospecting activity, pipeline status, and account information in the CRM

Collaborate closely with Account Executives to ensure smooth handoff of qualified opportunities and alignment on target accounts

Use AI and sales enablement tools to improve research efficiency, lead enrichment, and outreach personalization at scale

Represent Helm Operations professionally in all prospect\-facing interactions, building credibility and trust from first contact

**What Success Looks Like**

Consistently achieving the quarterly target of 30 completed demos

Generating $1–2 million in annual pipeline once fully ramped (target: incremental $500,000 for the remainder of 2026\)

Building a reliable, repeatable prospecting engine that keeps Account Executives consistently supplied with qualified opportunities

Establishing Helm as a trusted, responsive partner for prospects across the European market

**Qualifications**

Fluent in English (written and spoken)

1–3\+ years of experience in a Business Development, SDR/BDR, or similar outbound sales role, ideally in B2B SaaS

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging across different cultural and market contexts

Comfortable with high\-volume, target\-driven outbound prospecting

Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and sales engagement platforms

**Bonus points if you have:**

Additional languages such as Spanish, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Portugese

Experience selling into the maritime, shipping, logistics, or industrial/technical B2B markets

Prior experience in a remote, internationally distributed sales team

Familiarity with using AI tools to support prospecting and outreach workflows

**Compensation \& Commission Structure**

Base salary: €45,000 \~ €60,000

**Commission:**

2% on Initial Sale and Professional Services (PS) revenue directly attributable to BDE\-sourced activity, excluding any PS managed by partners

€5 per qualified demo booked and attended

€40 per net\-new sales opportunity created (net\-new only; excludes upsells)

Estimated OTE: \~€57,000 at target performance (30 demos/quarter, 50% demo\-to\-opportunity conversion, 35% company win rate)

**Why You’ll Love Working at Helm**

We live by our core values:

Together We Win  
Collaboration is our superpower. We achieve more by sharing knowledge, supporting one another, and working toward common goals.

Own It  
We take initiative, follow through, and deliver on our commitments.

Care Deeply  
We care about our products, our customers, the quality of our work, and each other.

Enjoy the Ride  
We celebrate wins, learn through challenges, and make space for connection and joy along the way.

Eye of the Tiger  
We bring a healthy hunger for challenge, take proactive action, and embrace opportunities to learn and grow.

Perks and Benefits

* A 100% remote working environment.
* Flexible working hours with overlap during core business hours.
* Base salary of €45,000–€60,000 base \+ commission
* Paid vacation and your birthday off.
* Comprehensive benefits from your first day.
* Fitness reimbursement.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan eligibility after six months.
* Learning and professional development pathways.
* An inclusive culture with remote\-team activities and events.

The salary offered will depend on the successful candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market considerations. The actual salary may be higher or lower than the range posted.

Total On\-Target Earnings include base salary plus a target performance bonus.

*As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence tools to support certain stages of our recruitment process, which may include résumé screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and candidate communications.*

*These tools help us improve efficiency, support consistency, and enhance the candidate experience. All hiring decisions are made by qualified people, and we monitor our processes to support fairness and compliance with applicable requirements.*

Research has shown that women and members of underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed qualification.

This posting describes what we are ideally looking for, but we encourage you to apply even when you do not meet every requirement. Everyone brings different strengths and experiences, and we hire for both demonstrated capability and future potential.

Helm is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer where everyone is welcome.

Each person brings a unique story and perspective, and we believe our diverse mix of minds, backgrounds, identities, and experiences is where our greatest ideas come from.

We welcome people of all races, ethnicities, ages, religions, abilities, genders, gender identities, gender expressions, and sexual orientations. We want everyone to feel able to bring their authentic selves to work, share our values, shape our vision, drive innovation, and contribute to a culture we celebrate every day.

We sincerely thank everyone who applies. Due to the volume of applications received, we will contact candidates whose experience most closely aligns with the requirements of the role.

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Advisor
jobs.description:
**Onwards Together!**
---------------------


Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi\-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  

  

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Location: Germany (Remote)**
------------------------------

**Our Team’s Vision:**
----------------------


Customer Success Advisors exist to help customers **sustain value**.


We serve as our customers’ strategic business partners, building trusted relationships that ensure they continuously realize the outcomes that drove their investment in Illumio. Through executive engagement, success planning, lifecycle management, and cross\-functional leadership, we help customers measure success, overcome business obstacles, and identify opportunities to deepen the value Illumio delivers over time.


Customer Success Advisors orchestrate the expertise of the broader Illumio organization. Working alongside Technical Account Managers, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Product Engineering, and our partner ecosystem, they bring together the right people at the right time to help customers achieve their business objectives. By aligning customer priorities with Illumio’s capabilities, CSAs ensure every engagement contributes to long\-term customer success.


Joining the Customer Success Advisor team means becoming part of an organization dedicated to customer advocacy, trusted partnerships, and measurable business outcomes. If you’re passionate about building executive relationships, leading through influence, coordinating across teams, and helping customers achieve lasting success, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both our customers and Illumio’s continued growth.

**Your Impact:**
----------------


As a Customer Success Advisor (CSA), you are a critical part of the Customer Success Organization reporting to the Director of Customer Success. Your role will be directly tied to value generation for our customers, by helping them develop the right strategy to onboard, adopt, and successfully utilize Illumio's products to achieve their desired outcomes. The results of your efforts should lead to healthy, adopted, referenceable customers that achieved value\-based outcomes and are eager to expand their use of Illumio across their organization.

* Develop cross\-functional knowledge that spans IT Security, IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Application Portfolio Management practices. Your ability to partner with all teams within Illumio (like Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product Management, Engineering, Office of the CTO) to drive a strategic roadmap for your customers will be vital to your success.
* Customer Adoption \- inspect customer adoption issues and run specific plans to increase adoption health where required to ensure that all customers are wildly successful with Illumio's platform.
* Renewals \- tie adoption health to renewal and ensure that value is being delivered. You will be expected to forecast your upcoming renewals whilst managing the process from start to finish.
* Expansion \- partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and ensure we realize the expansion sales potential within your portfolio. Identify growth opportunities in your portfolio of accounts to improve NRR (Net Retention Rate) for the company.
* Establish “trusted advisor” relationships with the executive stakeholders and technical teams on the customer side while working seamlessly with our account team to extend Illumio’s reputation and position as a vendor.
* Establish, confirm, and document the “definition of success” with the customers executive sponsors through quarterly ‘Executive Business Reviews’.
* Build a strategic roadmap for every customer that defines how they should consume and adopt Illumio’s products to meet their desired outcomes.
* Monitor the Adoption Health across all accounts within your portfolio.
* Marshall the support of our cross\-functional organization to successfully onboard a customer quickly and with the highest quality possible.
* Identify product or feature gaps, coordinate responses and timelines with the Illumio product team and successfully orchestrate their delivery.
* Capture and document Customer Use Cases, value stories, and other useful information to help contribute to, and increase the depth of our Customer Success repository.

**Your Toolkit:**
-----------------

* 5\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, or related, customer\-facing role
* Ideally you will have worked within the Cyber Security or Enterprise SaaS space
* Proven ability to build trust and communicate effectively with C\-Suite, VP, and Director\-level contacts, along with day\-to\-day users of the platform
* Excellent communication skills verbal, written and presentation
* Detail\-oriented with the ability to set priorities and be flexible in an ever\-changing environment


\#LI\-SL1 \#LI\-REMOTE

**Our Commitment**


Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

*All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E\-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third\-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.*

*For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

You’ll take Business Development Representative (BDR)\-sourced opportunities and run point on Enterprise and Mid\-Market deals, turning Anova’s IIoT tank\-monitoring data into a business case that drives real decisions for fuels \& lubricant distributors leadership teams. You’ll lead executive\-level discovery and value\-based presentations that quantify ROI, partnering closely with Sales Engineers on technical discovery, demos, and objection handling, and with Customer Success Managers to ensure what you sell actually delivers once it’s live.

* Finalize contract terms and pricing to close deals, partnering with Sales Engineering on data collection and integration handoff

* Travel as needed to meet with prospects and customers and represent Anova at industry events

 **What you’ll need to succeed:**

  

**Minimum Requirements \-**


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise or mid\-market B2B sales, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
* Experience managing a full sales cycle in complex, multi\-stakeholder deals (6\+ month cycles)
* Experience with value\-based/consultative selling and delivering ROI\-driven presentations to executive\-level stakeholders
* Experience negotiating and finalizing contract terms and pricing
* Proficiency with Salesforce (or comparable CRM) for pipeline and forecast management
* Ability to travel to meet with prospects/customers and represent Anova at industry events
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering across sales engineering, customer success, or technical teams to close and grow accounts
* Self\-starter with strong time and territory management skills
* Full professional proficiency in English language, both oral and written

  


**Preferred Qualifications \-**


* Experience selling into the fuels, lubricants, or oil \& gas distribution industry
* Experience in adjacent industries such as supply chain, logistics, chemical distribution, or other industrial verticals
* Experience in IIoT, industrial technology, SaaS, or telemetry/monitoring solutions
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger)
* Experience owning renewal/expansion motions in addition to net\-new logo acquisition
* Adept at learning and positioning new technology hardware/cloud\-based platforms against competitive alternatives

We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

jobs.title: Sales Director - Chemical
jobs.description:
**Make a measurable and mission\-critical impact.**


**Join us on the** **Sales** **team as a** **Sales Director**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. **Start your journey with Anova today!**

  


You’ll take Business Development Representative (BDR)\-sourced opportunities and run point on Enterprise and Mid\-Market deals, turning Anova’s IIoT tank\-monitoring data into a business case that drives real decisions for a chemical distributor’s leadership team. You’ll lead executive\-level discovery and value\-based presentations that quantify ROI, partnering closely with Sales Engineers on technical discovery, demos, and objection handling, and with Customer Success Managers to ensure what you sell actually delivers once it’s live.

 **Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the full sales cycle for Enterprise and Mid\-Market prospects, converting qualified opportunities sourced by the Business Development Representative (BDR) team into closed\-won business
* Land new logos across Anova’s target verticals by partnering with BDRs to qualify, develop, and advance inbound and outbound pipeline
* Make data\-driven recommendations that connect Anova’s IIoT tank\-monitoring and telemetry capabilities to each prospect’s inventory, logistics, and asset\-utilization challenges
* Lead executive\-level discovery and value\-based presentations during land and expansion phases that quantify the ROI customers will gain
* Build and manage an accurate pipeline and forecast, advancing Enterprise and Mid\-Market deals through every stage to consistently hit quota
* Kick off training and enablement with the customer (hardware, install, \& mobile apps) that the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will complete — Sales Director (SD) not responsible for training itself
* Completes tier 2 and 3 support requests if escalated by CSM
* Coordinates with Sales Engineer and/or CSM to run product demonstrations, and remove technical barriers to closing
* Maintain deep expertise in Anova’s IIoT product portfolio, competitive landscape, and industry best practices to position the platform against alternatives
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date opportunity and account data in Salesforce to support pipeline visibility and forecasting
* Finalize contract terms and pricing to close deals, partnering with Sales Engineering on data collection and integration handoff
* Build renewal plans beginning 6 months out from contract end, flagging account risks or expansion opportunities and securing renewal terms ahead of forecast
* Travel as needed to meet with prospects and customers and represent Anova at industry events

 **What you’ll need to succeed:**

  

**Minimum Requirements \-**


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise or mid\-market B2B sales, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
* Experience managing a full sales cycle in complex, multi\-stakeholder deals (6\+ month cycles)
* Experience with value\-based/consultative selling and delivering ROI\-driven presentations to executive\-level stakeholders
* Experience negotiating and finalizing contract terms and pricing
* Proficiency with Salesforce (or comparable CRM) for pipeline and forecast management
* Ability to travel to meet with prospects/customers and represent Anova at industry events
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering across sales engineering, customer success, or technical teams to close and grow accounts
* Self\-starter with strong time and territory management skills
* Full professional proficiency in English language, both oral and written

 **Preferred Qualifications \-**


* Experience selling into the chemical distribution or chemical manufacturing industry
* Experience in adjacent industries such as supply chain, logistics, oil \& gas, or other industrial verticals
* Experience in IIoT, industrial technology, SaaS, or telemetry/monitoring solutions
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger)
* Experience owning renewal/expansion motions in addition to net\-new logo acquisition
* Adept at learning and positioning new technology hardware/cloud\-based platforms against competitive alternatives

  


**ABOUT ANOVA**



We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

  



We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

 **If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.**

  

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: SDET (C#)
jobs.description:
At NTT DATA, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. As a $30\+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader, we co\-innovate solutions with clients and partners globally for business and societal impact. Serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100, with experts in over 70 countries, we encourage experimentation and recognize great work. Proudly a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion annually in R\&D. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network. Make this the place where *you* grow.


* Collaborate closely with delivery teams, business stakeholders, analysts, and developers to understand requirements, define test scope, and ensure quality expectations are met.
* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated and exploratory tests across Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Power Pages, portal journeys, and Azure\-integrated solutions.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks and test suites using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Spec Flow and programming language as C\#.
* Integrate automated testing into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing, quality gates, and rapid feedback.
* Investigate test failures, manage defects through resolution and retesting, and communicate quality risks, dependencies, and release readiness.
* Contribute to test strategy, engineering standards, automation improvements, quality reporting, and maintenance of test documentation.


We are looking for an Automation Test Engineer who can take a requirement or user story, understand what needs to be tested, and apply the right mix of technical testing, automation and exploratory testing to give the team confidence in the quality of what is being delivered.


You should be comfortable using engineering standards, automation frameworks and CI/CD practices to make testing more efficient and repeatable. You will be expected to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, contribute to quality planning, and support the resolution of defects in a collaborative Agile delivery environment.


Depth in test automation, Dynamics 365/Power Platform delivery and CI/CD based quality assurance matters more to us than breadth across every testing tool. The right person will be hands\-on, collaborative, quality\-focused and comfortable working in a public sector delivery environment.

  

  

**Must Have**


* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Proven experience in Agile delivery environments, working closely with Developers, Business Analysts, and Test Engineers.
* Hands\-on test automation experience using tools such as **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress**, or similar, with programming experience in **C\#,**
* Knowledge of **BDD practices** and tools such as **Spec Flow** or **Cucumber**.
* Experience designing, developing, executing, and maintaining automated test suites for enterprise applications, including **Dynamics 365, CRM, or portal\-based solutions**.
* Strong understanding of test design and execution across **functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration testing**.
* Experience using **Azure DevOps** for test management, source control, CI/CD pipelines, reporting, and defect tracking.
* Ability to derive test scenarios from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, while managing test data, environments, dependencies, and defects.
* Self\-sufficient approach to delivering testing activities, producing clear test evidence, reporting outcomes, and supporting release readiness decisions.


**Nice to Have**


* Experience defining test scope, estimating effort, and selecting risk\-based testing approaches.
* Experience building or enhancing automation frameworks and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates.
* Experience with **API and integration testing** using tools such as **Postman, REST frameworks and hands on performance testing using Jmeter or load runner**.
* Understanding of modern engineering practices including branching strategies, pull requests, peer reviews, accessibility testing and continuous quality improvement.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot or other AI\-assisted development/testing tools to improve productivity.
* Certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, SAFe, ISTQB, Microsoft Power Platform or relevant automation/testing certifications.


We offer a range of tailored benefits that support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. Our Learning and Development team ensure that there are continuous growth and development opportunities for our people. We also offer the opportunity to have flexible work options.


You can find more information about NTT DATA UK \& Ireland here: https://uk.nttdata.com/


We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in the fair treatment of all our employees and commit to promoting equity and diversity in our employment practices. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We actively collaborate with individuals who have disabilities and long\-term health conditions which have an effect on their ability to do normal daily activities, ensuring that barriers are eliminated when it comes to employment opportunities. In line with our commitment, we guarantee an interview to applicants who declare to us, during the application process, that they have a disability and meet the minimum requirements for the role. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. Join us in building a truly diverse and empowered team.


We are delivering Dynamics 365 Customer Service solutions for a public sector client, extended with Power Pages, Power Automate and related Azure components.


The Automation Test Engineer will play an important role in helping the team deliver reliable, well\-tested and maintainable solutions. You will develop and maintain technical test suites, use appropriate tooling and engineering approaches to design and execute tests, and support the team in identifying and reducing delivery risk.


You will work closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Test Leads and client stakeholders to determine what needs to be tested, how it should be tested, and how test outcomes should be recorded, reported and used to improve quality.


You will take direction from the Test Lead and wider delivery leadership, but you will be expected to work independently on assigned test activities, challenge constructively where appropriate, and bring practical suggestions to improve test coverage, automation quality, continuous feedback and release confidence.


The role involves a significant element of working from home, but there will be periods where occasional travel and working on client sites is needed. The role must be UK based due to client IT and security restrictions.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

A Trust Officer is responsible for the effective administration and oversight of a portfolio of sophisticated private client fiduciary structures across multiple jurisdictions. Structures may include trusts, companies and other wealth\-holding vehicles governed by a range of applicable laws. As Trust Officer you will act as a key point of contact for clients, beneficiaries, bankers, wealth advisers, investment managers, lawyers, tax advisers and other professional intermediaries and will support senior fiduciaries and management in the delivery of a high\-quality fiduciary service.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship Management**

* As a Trust Officer you will be responsible for the management and administration of a portfolio of complex trust and corporate structures for multinational ultra\-high net worth client base of individuals, corporates and family offices.
* Develop, maintain and optimise professional relationships with clients, intermediaries and internal contacts through delivery of a consistent and seamless client experience to maximise client retention.
* Play a constructive role within our global business, assist the team and act as a principal day\-to\-day contact for designated clients and their professional advisers.
* Respond to client requests promptly and professionally while ensuring that requests are considered from the perspective of the trustee's fiduciary responsibilities.
* Coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to deliver a seamless client experience.
* Identify significant changes in client circumstances and ensure that potential fiduciary, tax, legal, regulatory or reputational implications are appropriately considered and escalated.




* Maintain the highest level of trust and company administration to minimise business risk and to adhere to a culture of compliance with policies and appropriate risk management.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Work collaboratively with wealth advisors, bankers and peers to ensure adherence to policies and procedures while delivering a seamless client experience.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. Ensure structures are administered in accordance with applicable governing documents, laws and regulations and J.P. Morgan policies, procedures and controls.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written required. Confident when dealing with clients and professionals.
* Ability to work under pressure to achieve deadlines and meet client and business expectations.
* Ability to analyze trust documents for legal, tax, administrative and investment issues and coordinate delivery of services.
* Oversee investment decisions including working with investment advisors. Ensure that the Trust investment objective is appropriate for the needs of the Trust and applicable fiduciary law. Ensure the Trust is compliant with its investment guidelines / mandate.
* Ensure compliance with all local and international anti\-money laundering and Know you Customer requirements.
* Assist with the onboarding of new clients in partnership with Wealth Advisors and the New Business Team.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching and support to Trust Officers and junior team members and review work where appropriate.
* Maintain high standards of client service while ensuring that fiduciary independence, governance and control requirements are consistently maintained.




**Qualifications and Experience**

* Significant experience in private client trust and fiduciary administration, preferably involving complex and internationally connected structures. Minimum 7 years of experience in the roll.
* Strong understanding of trusts, companies and other private wealth structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Sound understanding of fiduciary principles, governance, AML/KYC and risk management requirements.
* Degree or equivalent professional qualification preferred plus STEP qualification.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with sophisticated clients, advisors and senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgement, manage competing priorities and identify matters requiring escalation.
* Strong commitment to J.P. Morgan's standards of integrity, risk management, controls and client service.

Trimble Transportation provides the mobility, enterprise, and visibility tools that move freight across North America. Our TMW Suite TMS platform is the backbone of dispatch operations for energy carriers — managing orders, dispatch, tank readings, pricing, and delivery for bulk fuel and petroleum logistics.

  

Right now, we’re doing something our customers have been waiting for: replacing the legacy Windows desktop application (Suite Dispatch TMS) with a modern, browser\-based experience that dispatchers can access from anywhere. This is a greenfield React build, not a reskin. We’re building the next\-generation TMW Suite Dispatch UI from scratch, shipping 7 screens in 18 months, and going live with real dispatchers on June 1 2027\.

**Here’s what you’d be doing day to day:**  

You’ll be embedded in one of four pair\-squads (2 developers \+ 1 embedded generalist), building production React screens that fuel dispatchers will use to run their daily operations. Each squad owns specific screens end\-to\-end from data service integration through UI polish and Playwright testing. Every Friday, your squad demos working software to stakeholders. No spec theater, no sprint reviews six weeks from now. Weekly demos, weekly accountability, weekly progress.  

The architecture is straightforward: your React UI talks to CloudHub (a tenant\-routing gateway), which dispatches to a per\-tenant OData API, which connects through a CloudHub Connector (CHC) to the customer’s on\-prem SQL database. You’re building a fast, reliable, accessible front\-end that makes fuel dispatchers more efficient.

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

* Build Production React Screens: Own screens end\-to\-end: data service layer, Redux state management, UI components, and Playwright \+ axe\-core tests. Build responsive layouts (1280/1440/1920px) using MUI X DataGrid, Trimble Maps SDK, and the team’s shared design system
* Update and Enhance the Backend Services: Integrate with the CloudHub/OData/CHC API stack, wire up real data from customer SQL databases through the tenant\-routing gateway. Create new services to ensure the new React screens provide the same functionality as the existing Fuel Dispatch on premise application.
* Ship Working Software Weekly: Demo functional, tested features every Friday \- not mockups, not prototypes, not slide decks. Pair with your squad’s embedded generalist on PR reviews, accessibility checks, and test coverage. Maintain CI/CD discipline: main is always deployable, PRs are feature\-scoped, weekly tags cut for demos.
* Solve Real Dispatcher Problems: Build drag\-and\-drop planning interfaces, real\-time map synchronization, threshold\-based alerting, and inline validation engines. Optimize for dispatcher workflows: keyboard navigation, WCAG accessibility, loading skeletons, and error states that tell users what went wrong and what to do next. Performance\-tune data grids for large datasets with server\-side pagination and column virtualization.
* AI\-Augmented Development: Use Cursor and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, generate test scaffolding, and refactor code. Contribute to the team’s shared patterns and component library as the design system evolves.

**Our Tech Stack:**

* the app scaffold React \+ TypeScript \+ Vite
* sortable, filterable, server\-paginated grids MUI X DataGrid
* live truck/station pins, route visualization, bidirectional map\-grid sync Trimble Maps SDK
* shared state across screens (orders, dispatch status, planner sync) Redux Toolkit
* E2E and accessibility testing in CI Playwright \+ axe\-core

 the API layer (tenant routing per\-tenant OData on\-prem connector* SQL) CloudHub / OData / CHC
* authentication via token forwarding Trimble Identity SSO
* daily development tooling, not optional Cursor / AI assistants
* source control and CI/CD GitHub \+ GitHub Actions

**Your Essential Skills \& Experience:**

* 3\+ years building production React applications with TypeScript — not tutorials, not side projects, production apps that real users depend on
* Strong component architecture: you think in composable, testable components with clean prop contracts and proper state management
* Experience with data\-heavy UIs: grids, tables, filters, server\-side pagination, real\-time updates
* Comfort with REST/OData API integration — you’ve wired up front\-ends to real backends and debugged the full request/response chain
* CSS/styling proficiency: responsive layouts, design system integration, consistent cross\-browser rendering
* Git workflow fluency: trunk\-based development, feature branches, clean commit history, PR reviews
* Ability to work in a pair\-squad model — tight collaboration with one other developer and an embedded generalist, shipping weekly

**Bonus Points for:**

* Drag\-and\-drop implementation experience (dnd\-kit, react\-beautiful\-dnd, or similar)
* Experience with AI coding assistants Cursor in daily development workflows
* Familiarity with MUI (Material UI) component library and theming
* Previous experience modernizing legacy desktop applications into browser\-based UIs
* Background in .NET/C\# OData APIs (helpful for debugging the API layer)
* Logistics, transportation, or energy industry domain knowledge you understand what a dispatcher does and why their screen matters

  

Location: UK, Remote

**Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us:**

* At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact.
* We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data\-driven insights that reduce waste.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

  

React, TypeScript, Front\-End Engineer, Software Developer, Redux, Material UI, Playwright, Greenfield, Transportation, Logistics
