jobs.title: Staff .Net Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**Reapit – Who are we?**


Reapit is the original end\-to\-end business technology provider for estate agencies of all sizes. We’ve been helping sales and lettings agents build relationships and grow their businesses for more than 25 years.


Our technology empowers property professionals across Europe, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand to work with buyers, sellers, tenants, and landlords to deliver a dream home experience.


Worldwide, over 100,000 agents across more than 15,000 branches use Reapit to run their businesses, manage properties, collect rent, engage clients, and provide outstanding customer service every time.

**What you’ll be doing**


Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you’ll operate as a highly senior, technically hands\-on backend engineer, embedded into a squad and owning delivery of substantive, cloud\-native services end\-to\-end. Ad\-hoc client interaction, supporting requirements discovery and technical solutioning where needed.

* Architecting, building and shipping complex, high\-performance distributed services in C\# and .NET Core 8/9 – primarily serverless on AWS Lambda – setting the technical bar for the squad and owning delivery of substantive feature sets end\-to\-end.
* Designing data models and persistence patterns across Aurora RDS MySQL and DynamoDB – picking the right tool for the workload, tuning for performance at scale, and modelling for both transactional and high\-throughput access patterns.
* Building resilient, event\-driven systems with SQS and related AWS messaging primitives – idempotency, retries, dead\-letter handling, and clean separation of concerns across services.
* Owning each feature’s solution end\-to\-end – partnering with Business Analysts who capture high\-level problems and workflows, then driving product thinking, scoping, trade\-offs and delivery yourself.
* Leveraging Claude Code and advanced agentic workflows at pace – orchestrating sub\-agents, managing context, running parallel workstreams and embedding AI\-native engineering patterns into everyday delivery.
* Designing clean, well\-versioned, well\-documented APIs that other engineers enjoy consuming – treating developer experience and contract stability as first\-class concerns.
* Inputting into architecture and technical direction in collaboration with Principal Engineers – making considered, well\-reasoned decisions on service boundaries, data design, messaging patterns, consistency guarantees and performance.
* Championing a high\-quality engineering culture – test coverage, peer review, CI/CD discipline via GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code, secure coding, observability and performance – aligned to the Reapit Global Technology Strategy, Reapit Connect and agentic tooling.
* Mentoring and up\-levelling engineers around you through pairing, PR review, architectural guidance and practical coaching on AI\-assisted development.

**Who we’re looking for**


At Reapit, we prioritise hiring individuals who share our values and possess the right attitudes and behaviours for success.


Whilst all the listed qualities are desirable, don’t worry if you don’t meet all of them, we’d still like to hear from you.

* A proven senior\-to\-staff\-level backend engineer with deep, current expertise in C\# and .NET Core 8/9 – you can architect and lead design of distributed REST API microservices at scale.
* Authority in AWS serverless architecture – Lambda\-first, with strong working knowledge of API Gateway, SQS, Step Functions, EventBridge and IAM, and a track record of shipping production workloads on this stack.
* Deep data expertise across Aurora RDS MySQL and DynamoDB – complex schema and access\-pattern design, query tuning, indexing, single\-table vs multi\-table trade\-offs, and a pragmatic view on consistency, scaling and cost.
* Proven track record designing event\-driven systems with SQS (and adjacent AWS messaging) – idempotency, ordering, retries, dead\-letter handling and operational robustness.
* Strong API design sensibility – versioning, documentation, throttling, backwards compatibility and an obsession with the developer experience of the services you own.
* A strong product brain. You’re comfortable operating without a traditional Product Owner – partnering with BAs on high\-level problems, then making sensible product trade\-offs, prioritising ruthlessly and owning the solution through to delivery.
* Strong communication skills and comfortable with ad\-hoc client interaction – able to join a requirement or technical solutioning session, ask the right questions, and translate outcomes into shippable work.
* A proven track record with Claude Code and advanced agentic workflows – you can evidence shipping real work via multi\-agent patterns, orchestrating sub\-agents, managing context, defining custom commands/skills and scaling AI\-assisted delivery across a team.
* Rigorous engineering standards – fluency with Git\-based workflows, trunk\-based development, CI/CD (ideally GitHub Actions), Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK or Terraform), comprehensive testing (unit, integration and contract), and a genuine commitment to observability, performance and secure\-by\-default coding.
* Technical leadership without the title – a track record of lifting teams through pairing, mentoring, PR review and example, rather than through line\-management.
* A pragmatic, outcome\-oriented mindset – biased to shipping, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to make sensible calls on scope, technical debt and sequencing under time pressure.
* Nice to have: hands\-on experience with OpenSearch and/or AWS AppSync – both feature in our stack and would accelerate time\-to\-value, but neither is essential.

**What your impact and success looks like**


As a Backend Engineer we expect your success and impact over the stages of your contract with us to look something like this:

**Within 1 month:**

* Fully onboarded onto the Reapit stack – Reapit Connect, the relevant .NET services and AWS environments – shipped first production endpoints and / or services.
* Established trusted working relationships with the Director of Engineering, Principal Engineers, Business Analysts and the relevant squad.
* Configured Claude Code and our approved agentic tooling to our internal standards, and started running meaningful work through multi\-agent patterns.
* Built a clear, independent view of the target services, data model, database schemas, messaging topology and immediate delivery priorities – and surfaced any early risks or recommendations.

**Within 3 months:**

* Owning end\-to\-end delivery of substantive services – taking from BA\-level problem statement through to production on Lambda, Aurora and DynamoDB, with you driving the product trade\-offs as well as the engineering.
* Recognised as a go\-to technical voice within the squad – inputting into architectural decisions alongside Principal Engineers, raising the quality bar on PRs, and unblocking complex backend, data and messaging problems.
* Meaningfully influenced our wider engineering practice – patterns you’ve introduced for agentic delivery, Claude Code usage, serverless design or data modelling.
* Shipped APIs and services that are visibly well\-designed, well\-documented and performant – other engineers find them pleasant to consume, and they hold up under production load.
* Left a well\-documented, well\-tested, maintainable footprint – so that whether the contract is extended or handed over, the work continues to deliver value without you in the room.

**What’s in it for you?**


We operate a Flexible Working Policy and there is no expectation around in\-person attendance, beyond occasional ad\-hoc project meetings in our Solihull or London offices.


You can expect an industry competitive day rate, available on request.

**Don’t tick all the boxes? Neither do we**


We care about our industry and want it to become a more inclusive and diverse place to work. So, we’re driven by hiring not only by experience and relevance for the role but by sharing our values and the right attitudes and behaviours for success.


We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.


We feel we have an empowering environment where everyone is supported and respected, and we want you to feel this too. We welcome new ideas, thinking and approaches, whilst listening to all our employees.

To undertake decontamination science duties in providing a specialized decontamination of medical devices service contributing to the clinical care of the patient \- to carry out the receipt, disassembly, cleaning, reassembly, packing and sterilization of reusable medical devices and record all tasks in the tracking and tracing database.
  
  

To ensure that all products manufactured in the Decontamination Services department within the Trust are fit for purpose and produced in a timely and efficient manner in accordance with the Quality Manager System (QMS) relevant to the area and to work as part of a team and undertake duties as directed by the management team of the Trusts decontamination facilities.
  
  

To work in all areas of the decontamination facilities at both hospitals (Chelsea and Westminster Hospital) and weekend as and when required
  
  

1\. To reprocess reusable medical devices, disassemble, clean, disinfect, check, assemble, sterilize, dispatch and track in a controlled environment.
  
  

2\. To work in accordance with Departmental Policy, Standard Operating Procedures and Quality Management System.
  
  

3\. Report any discrepancies to the team leader immediately.
  
  

4\. Complete the relevant documents for any non\-conformances.
  
  

5\. To contribute to ensuring that quality assurance and production controls systems are maintained in accordance with standard work instructions.
  
  

6\. To provide a collection and delivery service to the Decontamination Departments' customers
  
  

7\. To inform the Decontamination Technician Supervisors of any raw material shortages and ensure stock is rotated.
  
  

8\. To receive raw materials and distribute raw materials to the production area, ensuring that all materials have been booked out in accordance with the quality procedure.
  
  

9\. Under limited supervision meet the demands of the Department’s workload whilst consistently achieving high quality standards which will be measured by in\-process checks and non\-conformance reports.
  
  

Our Trust is one of England's top\-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—along with award\-winning clinics across North West London.
  
  

Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1\.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A\&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use.
  
  

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid.
  
  

We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045\. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring.
  
  

1\. To undertake initial investigation into non\-conformances reports as instructed
  
  

2\. To use manual dexterity and concentration for the disassembly and reassembly of the reusable medical devices in accordance with Manufacturer’s instructions
  
  

3\. To operate decontamination equipment and carry out routine tests in accordance with the Planned Preventative Maintenance Schedules, Quality Standards and Guidance
  
  

4\. Attend regular departmental team meetings.
  
  

5\. To attend any training as required.
  
  

6\. To undertake duties consistent with the responsibility of the grade and needs of the service
  
  

7\. Required to work weekends, bank holidays and participate in the department’s on\-call schedule.

Please Note: We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a high volume of applications; therefore, we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

  

*All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory right‑to‑work checks. Candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK. At the present time TfL is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.*

*Hybrid working within this role enables a balance of 50 per cent of time split between the office and home over a 4\-week period.**Hybrid working arrangements can evolve subject to business requirements****.***

  

**About the Role**


Transport for London is seeking an experienced Energy and Carbon professional to join the Sustainability, Energy and Carbon team on a 12\-month fixed\-term contract or secondment.


This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering TfL's Net Zero ambitions and supporting the decarbonisation of one of the UK's largest and most complex organisations.


As TfL continues its journey towards net zero operations, this role will help shape the strategic direction of energy and carbon initiatives across the business. Working with a wide range of stakeholders, you will lead and support programmes focused on reducing energy consumption, lowering carbon emissions, improving energy efficiency, and driving sustainable outcomes across TfL's operational estate.

  

**What You'll Be Doing**


* Leading the development and delivery of energy and carbon reduction initiatives across TfL.
* Supporting decarbonisation programmes for buildings and operational assets.
* Identifying opportunities to improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions.
* Analysing energy and carbon data to inform decision\-making and drive performance improvements.
* Providing expert advice on energy management, sustainability and carbon reduction.
* Working closely with procurement teams to embed environmental requirements into contracts and supplier relationships.
* Building strong relationships across the business to influence positive environmental change.
* Supporting the delivery of TfL's wider environmental and sustainability objectives.
  

**About You**


We're looking for a motivated and knowledgeable energy and carbon specialist with a proven track record of delivering sustainability initiatives within a large and complex organisation.

  

**Essential Experience**


* Experience developing and delivering energy efficiency and decarbonisation programmes.
* Experience in energy and carbon reporting, monitoring and target setting.
* Experience providing technical advice on energy and carbon matters to a range of stakeholders.
* Experience working on projects that reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions.
* Experience supporting organisational change and influencing stakeholders.
  

**Essential Knowledge**


* Strong understanding of energy management and energy efficiency best practice.
* Knowledge of carbon management and decarbonisation strategies.
* Understanding of climate change, UK energy policy, and the challenges associated with achieving net zero.
  

**Essential Skills**


* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong project management and organisational capabilities.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high\-quality outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
  

**Why Join Us?**


This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to London's environmental future. You'll work on high\-profile decarbonisation initiatives, influence strategic decisions, and play a key role in helping TfL achieve its ambitious net zero targets.

  

**Application Process**


* Please apply using your CV only
* Think carefully about the skills, knowledge and experience in the advert and cover this in your CV
* PDF format preferred and do not include any photographs or images
  

**Equality, diversity and inclusion**


We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and aim to reflect the diverse communities we serve. We believe that a diverse workforce enables us to deliver better services and outcomes. Our goal is to make our recruitment as inclusive as possible. As a Disability Confident Leader, we actively encourage applications from disabled people. As part of the Disability Confident scheme, we aim to offer an assessment or interview to candidates who apply via the scheme where the minimum essential criteria for skills, knowledge and experience has been met. In some circumstances, it may not be practical to offer an interview or assessment to every candidate who applies through the scheme and meet the minimum essential criteria; in these situations, we select candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job rather than interviewing all who meet them.


Across all recruitment activity, we recognise that selection methods may vary depending on the nature and scale of the campaign and will be applied fairly, consistently and proportionately in line with our Disability Confident commitments.
  

  

**Benefits**


In return for your commitment and expertise, you will enjoy excellent benefits and scope to grow. Rewards vary according to the level of role but mostly include the below:  

  



* Final salary pension scheme
* Free travel for you on the TfL network
* Reimbursement of 75% of the cost of a standard class Ticket for National Rail travel from home
* 30 days annual leave plus public and bank holidays
* TfL is committed to work\-life balance, operating a hybrid working approach where business and role requirements allow
* Private healthcare discounted scheme Tax\-efficient cycle\-to\-work programme
  

Retail, health, leisure and travel offers
* Discounted Eurostar travel

We will make every effort to give you as much notice as possible, however some interviews/assessments could be organised at short notice.

  

**Vetting Process**


At Transport for London, safety, trust and fairness sit at the heart of how we recruit. Our Vetting Charter (https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/careers/our\-vetting\-process) explains the checks we carry out before you join us, helping ensure we create a safe, inclusive and reliable network for everyone who depends on our services. We simply ask that the information you provide is honest and accurate so we can progress your application smoothly. If something doesn’t match or can’t be verified, we may not be able to move forward with your application, but we’ll always treat you with transparency, respect, and clear communication throughout.

jobs.title: Housekeeper
jobs.description:
Join our Women’s Health team as a Housekeeper and play a vital role in creating a safe, welcoming and well\-organised environment for women, babies and families. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in maintaining high standards and thrives in a busy healthcare setting.
  
  

You will be a key member of the multidisciplinary team, helping to ensure the ward runs smoothly by supporting patient experience, maintaining stock supplies, promoting cleanliness and coordinating with support services.
  
  

We are looking for a reliable, proactive and organised individual with excellent communication skills and a commitment to delivering outstanding customer service. In return, you will work in a supportive team environment where your contribution is valued and where you can make a real difference to the experience of our patients and their families every day.
  
  

As a Housekeeper, you will be a valued member of the ward team, helping to ensure a positive experience for patients, families and staff through the delivery of high\-quality non\-clinical support services. You will take responsibility for coordinating ward supplies and maintaining stock levels, ensuring clinical and non\-clinical areas remain organised, safe and operationally ready.
  
  

You will work closely with colleagues across nursing, midwifery and support services to help maintain a clean, welcoming and well\-maintained environment, supporting infection prevention standards and the efficient running of the ward.
  
  

The role requires excellent organisational and communication skills, attention to detail, the ability to prioritise workload and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. You will also support meal service provision, monitor environmental standards, escalate maintenance concerns and contribute to continuous service improvement.
  
  

This is an important role for someone who is approachable, reliable and committed to delivering an excellent experience for women, babies and their families while supporting the safe and effective delivery of care.
  
  

University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH) is one of the most complex NHS trusts in the UK, serving a large and diverse population. We provide academically led acute and specialist services, to people from the local area, from throughout the United Kingdom and overseas. Our vision is to deliver top\-quality patient care, excellent education, and world\-class research.
  
  

We provide first\-class acute and specialist services across eight sites:
  
* University College Hospital (incorporating the Elizabeth Garrett Anderson Wing)
* National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery
* Royal National ENT and Eastman Dental Hospitals
* University College Hospital Grafton Way Building
* Royal London Hospital for Integrated Medicine
* University College Hospital Macmillan Cancer Centre
* The Hospital for Tropical Diseases
* University College Hospital at Westmoreland Street


We are dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of many complex illnesses. UCLH specialises in women’s health and the treatment of cancer, infection, neurological, gastrointestinal and oral disease. It has world class support services including critical care, imaging, nuclear medicine and pathology.
  
  

We are committed to sustainability and have pledged to become a carbon net zero health service, embedding sustainable practice throughout UCLH. We have set an ambitious target of net zero for our direct emissions by 2031 and indirect emissions by 2040\.
  
  

For the full Person Specification and more information regarding the main responsibilities of this role, please refer to the attached Job Description.
  
Please note, due to anticipated high volumes of applications, this vacancy may close earlier than the listed closing date. You are advised not to delay submitting your completed application
  
  

Come and be a part of the best NHS trust in England to work for, according to our staff\*
  
  

* UCLH top trust to work at in England \- In the most recent NHS staff survey UCLH had the highest percentage of staff who said they would recommend us as a place to work, out of all general acute or acute/community NHS trusts in England – for the third year in a row.


UCLH recognises the benefits of flexible working for staff – To find out more, visit: Flexible working .
  
  

To discover more about what makes UCLH a great place to work, visit: Why Choose UCLH?

JOB DETAILS
  
  

**JOB BAND:** D
  
**CONTRACT TYPE:** Permanent, Full\-time
  
**DEPARTMENT:** BBC Studios Creative Services
  
**LOCATION:** London Television Centre – Hybrid
  
**PROPOSED SALARY RANGE:** Up to £55,000 plus £5,441 London Weighting depending on relevant skills, knowledge and experience. The expected salary range for this role reflects internal benchmarking and external market insights.
  
  

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS
  
  

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought\-after TV, audio and digital content.
  
  

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.
  
  

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
  
Join BBC.com as a Senior Designer and play a key role in shaping the creative direction of its growing international subscription business. You'll lead the development of impactful brand and campaign creative across digital channels, combining strategic thinking with hands\-on design execution. Working closely with editorial, marketing, product and UX teams, you'll create audience\-focused campaigns, champion brand excellence and help drive subscription growth on a global scale.
  
  

WHY JOIN THE TEAM
  
This is a unique opportunity to influence how millions of people discover and engage with BBC content around the world. You'll work at the intersection of creativity, storytelling and digital product growth, collaborating with talented multidisciplinary teams on high\-profile campaigns. With exposure to strategic decision\-making, stakeholder leadership and brand development, it's an ideal role for a Senior Designer’s next step.
  
  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT:**  

Lead the creation of high\-quality design and campaign assets across web, social, CRM, paid media and subscription marketing channels.
  
Develop compelling creative concepts and visual storytelling that drive audience acquisition, engagement, retention and subscription growth.
  
Champion and evolve BBC brand standards, ensuring consistency and excellence across all customer touchpoints.
  
Partner with editorial, marketing, product, UX and growth teams to translate insights and objectives into effective creative solutions.
  
Manage multiple creative projects from concept through to delivery, ensuring quality, efficiency and continuous improvement.
  
Build strong stakeholder relationships, presenting creative work confidently and influencing decision\-making through expert design guidance.
  
Provide day\-to\-day leadership, mentoring and direction to the Motion Designer, helping to maintain high creative standards across the team.
  
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
  
  

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**  

Significant experience in a Senior Designer, Graphic Designer or Brand Design role, ideally within media, publishing, digital products, subscription businesses or content\-led brands.
  
A strong portfolio showcasing branding, campaign development, digital marketing and visual storytelling.
  
Expert knowledge of design principles, including typography, layout, visual hierarchy, photography and brand systems.
  
Proven experience creating high\-performing creative assets across digital channels, including web, social, CRM and paid media.
  
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with experience working within digital\-first environments.
  
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, present ideas and build effective working relationships across multiple teams.
  
Experience leading projects and supporting, mentoring or coaching junior creatives.
  
  

**DESIRED BUT NOT REQUIRED:**  

Experience working within subscription, membership or audience growth\-focused businesses.
  
Basic motion graphics knowledge and an understanding of animation\-led creative.
  
Experience using AI\-powered creative tools and emerging technologies to enhance workflows and output.
  
Understanding of digital products, UX principles and performance marketing.
  
Experience contributing to the evolution of brand systems and creative frameworks.
  
Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance brand, audience and business objectives.
  
Passion for storytelling, journalism and creating work that reaches global audiences.
  
  

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  

Please include a link to your portfolio as part of your application.
  
  

We appreciate your interest in this position and understand how important this opportunity is to you. Due to the high volume of interest we may need to close the application period earlier than anticipated. This step is necessary to ensure we can provide a high level of attention and service to all applicants. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.title: Sustainability Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Sustainability Coordinator
  

**Contract Type:** Permanent
  

**Salary:** £29578\.70 per annum
  

**Working Hours:** 35 hours per week, full time
  

**Working Pattern:** Monday to Friday,
  

**Location:** Arlington, Camden
  

  

**If you share our values and are excited about making a significant impact at Riverside, please ensure you attach a current CV and covering letter. At Riverside we recruit to potential not just on skills and experience, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the essential criteria on the job description.**  

  

Please note that whilst we will accept applications on the basis of any form of valid legal permission to work in the UK, we will be surrendering the Riverside Sponsorship licence, so for the avoidance of doubt, we are unable to apply for any further sponsorships whether on behalf of existing colleagues or candidates.
  

  

**The difference you will make as a Sustainability Coordinator**  

Support the Sustainability and Investment Planning Team with the implementation of sustainability objectives. Support the research, development and implementation of actions, processes and projects that enable the Group to achieve its sustainability targets.
  

  

**About you**  

We are looking for someone with
  

* A relevant qualification, or working towards a qualification, in sustainability, environmental management, housing, construction or a related discipline.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to understand customer needs, resolve issues and identify practical solutions that deliver positive outcomes.
* A personal commitment to diversity, treating others with dignity and respect, with a genuine desire to understand and meet diverse customer needs and aspirations.

  

**Why Riverside?**  

At Riverside, we’re a housing association with a difference – enhancing the everyday for all our customers. For 90 years, we’ve been revitalising neighbourhoods and supporting communities by providing the homes they need to live full, fulfilling and rewarding lives.
  

We have a portfolio of over 75,000 affordable residential and retirement homes across the UK. Our work ranges from homelessness services to social care, employment support to retirement living, and we need the best people on board to help us.
  

  

Working with us, you’ll enjoy:
  

* Competitive pay \& generous pension
* 28 days holidays plus bank holidays
* Flexible working options available
* Investment in your learning, personal development and technology
* A wide range of benefits

  

**Diversity and Inclusion at Riverside:**  

We are inclusive. At Riverside, we value diversity in all its forms. We foster a workplace where all individuals are respected, empowered, and heard. Our commitment to inclusivity drives our success and enriches the lives of our customers and colleagues.
  

  

Riverside is a Disability Confident Employer and operates a Guaranteed Interview Scheme for any applicant who declares they have a disability. If the applicant meets the minimum requirements for the role (as set out in the role profile and/or person specification) they will be guaranteed an interview.
  

  

**Applications may close before the deadline, so please apply early to be considered.**  

  

**Role Profile**  

* Support the delivery of the Group’s Climate Responsibility Strategy and Healthy Homes Plan.
* Coordinate the management of Riverside’s externally owned solar photovoltaic (PV) portfolio and act as the primary point of contact for managing agents. Liaise with customers, colleagues, contractors and managing agents to support enquiries, secure timely access arrangements, and facilitate maintenance activities. Maintain accurate records, correspondence and activity logs, ensuring that actions, access arrangements and outcomes are appropriately documented and evidenced in accordance with organisational procedures.
* Coordinate and promote continuing professional development (CPD) opportunities on sustainability\-related topics across the organisation, supporting colleagues to develop the knowledge and skills required to contribute to Riverside's sustainability objectives.
* Answer energy\-related enquiries and requests effectively, providing clear, supportive and accurate advice, action or signposting, and escalating complex queries through the appropriate channels to ensure effective resolution.
* Maintain accurate records using appropriate systems and databases, ensuring data integrity and quality so that regular analysis and reporting can be completed as required.
* Assist with the management and reporting of budgets, including processing payments and ensuring Asset Management expenditure is managed in line with the Group’s financial controls.
* Assist in the management and resolution of customer complaints.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and procedures.
* Ensure requirements and proposed solutions are captured effectively during meetings, and follow up with attendees to confirm that they are clearly understood and align with business processes, standards and service quality.
* Monitor implementation progress, report on risks and keep relevant reporting lines updated.
* Support sustainability colleagues in the development, delivery and monitoring of projects, including undertaking research.

**Areas may include:**  

* Retrofit, including energy efficiency measures, funding streams and data analytics
* Energy efficiency advice and affordability
* Climate resilience, Biodiversity and nature\-based recovery solutions
* Electric vehicle charging and fleet decarbonization
* Sustainability reporting and metrics, including SECR, and ESG reporting
* Sustainable procurement and supply chain sustainability measures and carbon emissions
* Net zero carbon in new and existing homes
* Renewable energy and low carbon heating systems
* Healthy and Modern Homes
* Indoor air quality, including damp and mould issues and ventilation measures and strategies
* Hazard prevention in homes
* Liaise effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including customers,colleauges and third party suppliers providing advice ,support and building constructive working relationships.
* Ensure effective communication and engagement activities are delivered to key stakeholders, with progress updates and key messages communicated regularly.
* Carry out research to support self\-development and increase understanding across the business of innovative products and procedures, the impact of new and upcoming policy, and changes in the operating environment.
* Use this insight to contribute to the development, review and effective application of sustainability policies and procedures, identifying where changes are required in response to legislation, policy updates, or customer and stakeholder needs.
* Contribute to the production of accurate and timely reports for key stakeholders.
* Respond flexibly to changes in work priorities and undertake other duties as required to support the effective operation of the service.
* Ensure data protection requirements are met in accordance with Group policy, procedures and statutory requirements.
* Ensure health and safety requirements are met in accordance with Group policy, procedures and statutory requirements.

**Person specification**  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**  

**Essential**  

* Knowledge of, or an interest in, sustainability, construction, renewable energy, housing or a related sector.
* A relevant qualification, or working towards a qualification, in sustainability, environmental management, housing, construction or a related discipline.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to understand customer needs, resolve issues and identify practical solutions that deliver positive outcomes.
* A personal commitment to diversity, treating others with dignity and respect, with a genuine desire to understand and meet diverse customer needs and aspirations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to build positive working relationships with colleagues and customers, including the ability to persuade and influence others.
* An excellent team player who can work flexibly to meet business requirements.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel.
* Academic or practical working knowledge of at least one of the sustainability areas listed above or a willingness to learn

**Desirable**  

* Experience of supporting the delivery of a corporate sustainability strategy across a large and varied portfolio of assets.
* Understanding of building physics.Experience of using a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems
* Proficient in analysing and evaluating complex information, measuring the impact of initiatives, developing appropriate strategies and action plans, and presenting findings clearly to a range of audiences.
* Knowledge of EPCs, retrofit, renewable energy or net zero programmes

jobs.title: Senior Consultant/Associate - Climate Change & Air Quality
jobs.description:
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Consultant to join Savills’ Environment \& Infrastructure Team. The ideal candidate will have experience in either climate change and/or air quality, and be looking to expand their technical and commercial skillset to meet current project needs and further grow our GHG impacts and air pollutant modelling services.
This role will be delivering climate change and air quality assessments for major development and infrastructure projects across the UK. You will support the preparation of planning and consenting documentation, including projects within the NSIP and DNS regimes, while contributing to wider environmental services such as EIA, Health Impact Assessment and sustainability advice. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will provide technical and strategic consultancy across sectors including renewable energy, carbon capture, transport, water and utilities.
Working alongside Savills’ broad spectrum of planning, environmental, sustainability and land agency experts, this is an excellent opportunity to help develop our service offer. Savills expects regular office presence and encourages internal networking and team building and we are currently looking to strengthen our presence in the Environment \& Infrastructure team hubs of London and Brighton.
. Please ensure you read this before applying.
What we offer you:
Career and Professional Development
25\-30 Days Annual Leave, depending on grade
Life Assurance
Private Medical Scheme
Virtual GP
Global Mobility Scheme
Rewards Platform
Company Pension Scheme
Enhanced Incremental Annual Leave
Team Overview
Savills is the UK’s leading real estate service provider. We work with property and infrastructure of all types, ranging from the world’s most iconic rural estates through to the country’s leading urban developments and the full range of infrastructure that services this. Our clients come from both the public and private sectors and we work with organisations of all sizes.
Savills’ Environment \& Infrastructure Team was established in 2021 with a focus on infrastructure projects. Based in our planning division, we support our colleagues and clients with the challenges of consenting essential infrastructure, with a primary target sector of net zero, including carbon capture, renewables, hydrogen and water. We also provide specialist technical services in climate change, health and air quality to all types of projects such as new towns, commercial hubs, logistics and datacentres. We work closely with Savills Earth, our specialist sustainability division, which includes experts from Engineering \& Design Consultancy, Property Management, Energy Consultancy, Social Value, Energy Procurement, Environmental Economics and Research.
The team has a number of existing appointments on Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects (NSIPs) across various project sectors including CCUS, hydrogen, renewables, water, waste water, railfreight, power transmission, and ports. We have a strong history of advising on NSIPs, DNSs, Section 36 projects, SIPs and similar, as well as conventional TCPA projects. Our climate change and air quality team also supports the whole range of urban masterplanning, commercial and industrial projects nationally across all Savills’ planning teams.

We do not pay agency fees when speculative and unsolicited CVs are submitted to Savills or any of our employees other than via our careers website and through our recruitment process. If this is not adhered to, agency fees will not be paid.
Submission of any unsolicited CVs or proposals to Savills will be deemed evidence of full and unlimited acceptance of this approach.

jobs.title: Logistics Operator
jobs.description:
**Nestlé Waters \& Premium Beverages**

**Location: Buxton, Derbyshire**

**Permanent, Full Time**

**Salary:** **£34,231 per annum (Inclusive of shift allowance)**

**Shift pattern: 4 on 4 off (2 days, 2 nights)**

 **Some of our fantastic benefits**

  

* Comprehensive pension scheme – up to 12% employer contribution
* Potential, discretionary annual bonus
* Generous holiday entitlement
* A focus on professional development and growth

  

Are you ready to kick\-start your career in the world of logistics? We have the perfect entry\-level position for aspiring logistics professional.

  

We are looking for Logistics Operators to join our dedicated logistics department at our Nestlé Waters \& Premium Beverages site in Buxton, Derbyshire.

  

At Nestlé Waters \& Premium Beverages, we believe water is the natural choice for healthy hydration: good for our bodies and good for the planet. So, we make it easy for consumers to enjoy natural source waters and our range of water products enhanced with other natural ingredients. In everything we do, we work hard to protect the purity nature brings; from taking care of the environment that our waters are sourced from, to accelerating our pathway to net zero carbon and managing our business sustainably into the future.

  

We take pride in championing inclusion and diversity. We proudly signed the Business in the Community Race at Work Charter, are committed to Disability Confidence, and have been recognised as a Times Top 50 Employer for gender equality for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are a headline partner of Diversity and Inclusion in grocery.

 **Your Impact**

  

As a Logistics Operator, you will play a vital role in ensuring the efficient and accurate handling of goods within our logistics operations. Your primary responsibility will be to support the flow of materials and products through various processes, contributing to the overall success of our supply chain. You will be expected to uphold safety and quality standards while demonstrating a commitment to continuous improvement.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Safety Compliance:** Ensure high safety standards are adhered to maintain a safe working environment.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Follow inbound and outbound schedules by retrieving, marshalling, and loading pallets according to defined procedures.
* **Material Handling:** Load or unload trailers by operating suitable material handling equipment through loading docks or bays.
* **Support for Production:** Assist with factory activities to achieve key performance indicators, such as delivering packaging materials to the production line in a timely manner.
* **Quality Assurance**: Ensure high quality and good manufacturing practices are met by effectively carrying out the daily cleaning plan as per defined procedures.

 **Your ingredients for success**

  

We welcome individuals with a passion for logistics and a willingness to learn and grow in an automated warehouse. No prior experience is required, making this role ideal for those eager to develop their skills within warehousing and logistics.

 **Key Skills and Experience:**

* **Teamwork and Communication:** Excellent teamwork and communication skills are necessary to collaborate effectively with colleagues and support overall operational goals.

BBC EXTEND
  
  

This role is advertised as part of our BBC Extend programme for disabled people. To apply for this role you should identify as deaf, disabled or neurodivergent and must meet either the definition of disability in the Equality Act (2010\) , or the definition of disability in the Disability Discrimination Act (1995\) if applying in Northern Ireland. You’re broadly defined as disabled under both acts if you have a physical or mental impairment that has a substantial and long\-term negative or adverse effect on your ability to do normal daily activities. This definition includes both apparent and non\-apparent conditions and impairments, and medical conditions such as Cancer, HIV or Multiple Sclerosis.

The BBC are fully committed to providing workplace adjustments to help eliminate barriers in the workface that disabled people face. To do this, we have our own dedicated BBC Access and Disability Service that provides assessments and support throughout employment with us. If you are successful in applying for this role and require workplace adjustments, we will work with you to get your adjustments in place.
  
  

If you’d like more information on BBC Extend, please visit the BBC Extend webpage. (EXTEND code: EX2324\).
  
  

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS
  
  

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought\-after TV, audio and digital content.
  
  

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.
  
  

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
  
Join BBC.com’s growing creative team and help bring world\-class journalism, storytelling and products to life through bold design and motion graphics. Working across subscription marketing, audience engagement and content promotion, you'll create impactful creative assets that support growth, retention and discovery across global audiences, collaborating closely with marketing, editorial, product and creative colleagues.
  
  

WHY JOIN THE TEAM
  
This is an opportunity to shape the future of BBC.com as it continues to expand its international subscription offering. You'll work on high\-profile campaigns, reach audiences around the world, and collaborate with talented creatives, marketers and editorial teams. With a strong focus on innovation, storytelling and emerging technologies, you'll have the chance to develop your skills while helping deliver trusted content from one of the world's most recognised media brands.
  
  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT:**  

Create standout graphic design that bring BBC stories, products and campaigns to life across digital, social, video and CRM channels. Apply and motion graphics to bring digital assets to life to increase engagement
  
Design high\-impact creative that supports audience growth, engagement, retention and subscription objectives across BBC.com.
  
Turn creative briefs, audience insights and editorial priorities into compelling visual storytelling and campaign assets.
  
Develop storyboards, animations and motion content that enhance user experiences and maximise audience engagement.
  
Collaborate with colleagues across editorial, marketing, product, UX and growth teams to deliver effective, audience\-focused creative solutions.
  
Present and refine creative work through stakeholder feedback, contributing ideas that strengthen campaigns and the wider brand experience.
  
Embrace emerging technologies, AI tools and industry best practice to continuously innovate while maintaining the highest standards of quality, accessibility and BBC brand integrity.
  
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
  
  

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**  

Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, Digital Designer or Motion Designer, ideally within media, publishing, digital products or other content\-led organisations.
  
A strong portfolio demonstrating digital campaigns, motion graphics, animation and visual storytelling.
  
Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.
  
Strong motion graphics and animation expertise, creating engaging content across digital, social and marketing channels.
  
Experience developing creative assets for web, social media, video, CRM and performance marketing campaigns.
  
Excellent understanding of design principles, including typography, branding, layout, visual hierarchy and audience\-focused storytelling.
  
Strong communication, collaboration and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
  
  

**DESIRED BUT NOT REQUIRED:**  

Working knowledge of Figma and collaborative design workflows.
  
Experience working within established brand systems and design frameworks across multiple platforms.
  
Experience developing storyboards and motion\-led creative concepts.
  
Experience using AI\-powered creative tools to enhance efficiency and creative output.
  
Experience using Premiere Pro and working with video production workflows.
  
Knowledge of 3D animation software such as Cinema 4D.
  
Passion for storytelling, innovation and creating work that reaches global audiences.
  
  

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply.
  
  

Please include a link to your portfolio as part of your application.

**Project Assistant**  

**Salary \- from £37,760 per year with excellent benefits package and fantastic career progression opportunities.**  

**Location: Edinburgh Park or Cambuslang**  

**Permanent / Full Time**

**Closing Date: 17/09/26**

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

ScottishPower’s RIIO\-T3 Business Plan is a £12 billion investment to upgrade and expand the electricity transmission network across Central and Southern Scotland from 2026 to 2031\. This exciting investment plan aims to connect up to 19GW of clean energy, support over 11,000 jobs, and accelerate the UK’s journey to Net Zero by 2035\.


**Role**

Support the Project Managers, Project Development Managers and Project Teams, responsible for providing support for the development of SP Energy Networks Transmission projects portfolio.


The role holder will work alongside project managers and project development managers to assist with key project management responsibilities including financial administration as well as supporting the onboarding and training of new staff in key systems. The role holder will become a recognised super user of Financial/Contract Management System.


**What you’ll be doing**

*The jobholder will be responsible for the following tasks:*

Raising purchase requisitions/orders and calling off framework contracts


Lead financial training for SPT Project staff as required.


Maintain department User Guides


Assist Project Managers in updating financial forecasts, completing accruals and receipting invoices.


Raising and populating sourcing requests for Shared Services/Networks tenders


Generate weekly/monthly financial reports


Responsible as business expert for financial systems to ensure users have an available point of reference for system \& process issues


Responsible for delegated purchasing process within SPT Projects


Responsible for direct payment process for legal, wayleaves etc.


Financial breakdowns/reconciliations of projects and individual contracts.


Weekly drop\-in sessions for SAP PM/Delegated purchasing


Project Manager onboarding (IT Setup/SAP Overview) sessions


Project setup activities in various systems

  

  

**What you’ll bring**

We are looking for individuals with good inter\-personal and communication skills and the ability to form effective working relationships with other individuals, departments and businesses.


To be successful in this position you will need to demonstrate:


* HND or equivalent in business discipline/related area and/or relevant experience
* Significant experience of financial management systems (SAP)
* Experience in a financial role for major construction or utility construction projects
* Ability to multitask and work efficiently to meet deadlines
* High degree of IT literacy
* Strong communication skills

***What’s in it for you***

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family’s wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action – our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world – today and tomorrow. That’s why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase – perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Share Schemes
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers – save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes – to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing support
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more

***Why SP Energy Networks***

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network – connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It’s a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland’s ambition to be Net Zero by 2044\. And we’re taking it very seriously.


We’re investing £10 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy.


With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.


Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you’ll fit right in.


We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .

jobs.description:
**Wellbeing Ambassador – Clinical Exercise Physiologist or Physiotherapist**  

We are looking for a Clinical Exercise Physiologist or Physiotherapist to join the Wellbeing Team at Riverstone, working across our retirement community residences in Kensington, Fulham, and Hampstead. At Riverstone we are creating exceptionally designed developments exclusively for people over 65\. It’s not just about a place to live, but a new way of living that enables them to live the life they want to live. We want this to be a lifestyle full of choice, with wellbeing at its heart, that enables people to be active and social, and continue learning until any age. These are choices and that’s why we purposefully call the role ‘Wellbeing Ambassador’ – you champion these choices, based on understanding our residents needs and how best to engage and encourage them in realising the benefits. Riverstone are leading the way on what it means to age well, and you will be at the forefront of best practice in preventing physical and mental frailty. Our wellbeing programme is evidence based and led by our wellbeing director who is an experienced geriatrician. From carrying out comprehensive assessments with personalised goal\-plans, delivering bespoke programmes improving physical and mental health, through to being a trusted confidante of our residents, every day is different.
  

And all of this takes place in our beautifully designed, state of the art wellbeing spaces.
  

You will also develop relationships and work closely with our trusted CQC registered partners including care agencies, nursing agencies and private doctors.
  

**This role is right for you if…**  

You are a registered Exercise Physiologist or Physiotherapist who wants to take your professional healthcare experience and knowledge and step out of the conventional sectors to be part of creating a new lifestyle choice for older adults.
  

You have a genuine and deep\-rooted interest in the wellbeing of others and enjoy building long\-term relationships.
  

You enjoy working as part of a team, and thinking outside of a traditional ‘health’ mindset, to explore what is truly possible.
  

You believe that movement is medicine and are passionate about helping older adults live stronger, healthier, and more independent lives.
  

You are a creator, not a follower.
  

Retirement living is a new and rapidly expanding sector of which we are setting the standard in central London. In this role, you’re part of a team developing an approach to health and wellbeing that is genuinely ground\-breaking.
  

**Key responsibilities of this role include \-**  

Be part of the team who carry out regular CGA (comprehensive geriatric assessments) with our residents, work with them to develop bespoke wellbeing packages, and support them to achieve goals that they may set.
  

Get to know the people who live at Riverstone. Lead the relationship with care providers who work with our residents; co\-ordinate with other health providers to access expertise as required to help them to meet their health needs.
  

Oversee the delivery of evidence\-based exercise programmes, support and develop the Fitness Instructors, and use resident data to measure outcomes, drive continuous improvement, and enhance resident wellbeing.
  

Work hand in hand with our sales team, meeting potential residents when they are making the decision about whether Riverstone is right for them, and helping them to understand the safety net that we offer.
  

Co\-ordinate and deliver health and wellbeing learning to residents and Riverstone Team
  

Adhere to clinical governance and quality processes within the residences, including safeguarding, Infection Control and Health and Safety. A rewarding role.  

  

Starting salary from £52,000, plus performance\-related bonus
  

40\-hour week, Monday to Friday
  

Some of the benefits that you will have access to include:
  

Pension and life assurance
  

Annual health check
  

Free daily main meal at work
  

Access a range of discounts and cashback from hundreds of retailers on every day (and special day) items.
  

**About Riverstone**
  

Riverstone’s ambition is to create exceptional London living for people over 65\. Riverstone is addressing the needs of a new generation of older Londoners with a best \-in\-class product that will extend and enhance the independent lifestyles they enjoy. It will allow them to stay in the neighbourhoods they love and enable them to live the life they want to live. With high specification apartments in central locations, Riverstone's residents will benefit from first \-class facilities, a like\-minded community, hotel\-like hospitality and \- when needed \- highly personalised, discreet care. Our two exceptionally designed developments in Fulham and Kensington opened in 2022\. Our third site, on the Bishops Avenue in Hamstead is opening late 2026\. Riverstone is backed by Goldman Sachs, which is supporting the business’ ambition to build a portfolio of residences in prime central London locations.
  

If you are our future Wellbeing Ambassador, please apply! INDHEADOFFICE

-----------------

### **Job summary**


Do you want a career with a difference? Where you can have a real impact working with government departments and the wider public sector. If yes, then a career at the Government Actuary's Department (GAD) could be for you.


At GAD our mission is to support effective decision\-making and robust reporting within the public sector as the first\-choice provider of actuarial and specialist analysis, advice and assurance. The departments work covers valuation work and policy support in relation to investment, credit risk, insurance and contingent liabilities, pension schemes, financial risk, and social security. We also provide financial modelling and quality assurance.


We offer great working benefits including a world\-class pension, flexible working options and a career where your learning and development is taken seriously.


You will be a key consultant advising on investment and/or credit risk. The purpose of the role is to support our engagement and delivery of advice to help the public sector make more effective and informed decisions. The work is significantly more varied than in a typical actuarial consultancy, with opportunities to work on high\-profile public sector priorities and develop innovative solutions.


Further information on GAD is provided in the attached pack.

**N.B. GAD may work with recruiters on this campaign provided prior agreement is reached for this specific campaign**

### **Job description**


The role is in our Policy and Assurance unit. You will be based in one of the teams in that unit although we would expect you to support other teams and undertake a wider variety of work as required (see Key responsibilities 5\). Below sets out the range of work that GAD undertakes with respect to Investment and Credit Risk. There is scope for consultants at GAD to specialise in one area, or to work across multiple areas.


Investment


GAD provides advice in relation to invested funds held or sponsored by public sector bodies, and on government policy relating to investments held in the private sector, often in the context of pension arrangements. We are looking to hire an investment specialist to work alongside actuaries, trainee actuaries and analysts to enhance the support we can provide to our clients on investment issues.


GAD consultants regularly work in a much more diverse range of areas than a typical actuarial consultancy, working closely with both policy makers and operational staff to deliver effective public policy. The work is varied, interesting and has purpose, working in the best interests of the UK public. Recent projects have included:

* DB and DC pensions  advice in relation to funded public sector Defined Benefit (DB) pension scheme investments, public sector bodies Defined Contribution (DC) and Additional Voluntary Contribution (AVC) arrangements and wider pensions policy.
* Sizewell C  working with the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero and stakeholders to develop the funding and investment framework for a fund that will eventually be used to decommission the Sizewell C infrastructure.
* Pensions Investment Review  advising the Department for Work and Pensions on its productive finance agenda and how defined contribution pensions can contribute.
* Climate scenario analysis  setting assumptions and carrying out analysis of investment portfolios for funded public sector pension schemes to comply with Taskforce for Climate Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) reporting.
* Personal Injury Discount Rate  supporting government bodies as they review the rate of return that a personal injury claimant is assumed to earn if investing their damages award.


Credit Risk


GAD provides advice and support to a range of departments and wider public sector bodies on credit risk arrangements and modelling. These arrangements can arise from situations where government addresses gaps in private sector coverage, is trying to stimulate investment or is otherwise subject to credit risk.


The type of credit risk modelling is varied, and could relate to:

* expected credit loss calculations for financial guarantees and loans
* economic capital modelling
* stress testing
* other insolvency modelling for events which could impact government.


GADs role may involve:

* Quantifying and communicating risk
* Policy development  how credit risk arrangements can help meet policy objectives and be structured to reduce risk to government
* Quality Assurance  reviewing credit risk related models produced by other areas of the public sector


The work may involve consideration of niche, novel or remote risks, working with clients and third parties to incorporate specialist knowledge from subject matter experts to determine appropriate advice.


Current and previous areas of advice include:

* Assessment of implicit liabilities related to insolvency of key entities in line with Guidance for managing governments implicit liabilities
* Modelling of the credit losses arising from guarantees given to support multi\-lateral development banks
* Quality assurance of economic capital models subject to the Financial transaction control framework \- GOV.UK


General


The exact area a successful candidate will work in will be discussed prior to an offer being made and will be informed by the expertise and interests of the individual.


Regardless of the area of work, you will be expected to work closely with clients, scope out advice needs and deliver high value advice. The ability to apply investment and/or credit risk principles to novel policy areas and develop innovative solutions is essential.


Business development is an essential component of the role: you will help to build GADs reputation within the public sector, increasing awareness of your area of expertise and supporting the development of new client opportunities through networking, profile raising and building relationships with stakeholders across the public sector.


As part of your role, we expect you to help grow and develop both your own skills, and those of junior colleagues to help meet the evolving nature of our work. You will also help develop the investment and/or credit risk capabilities within GAD, sharing your knowledge and experience with others.

### **Person specification**

* Motivating and team building

 Agile working within other GAD teams from time to time during key periods.

Alongside your salary of £66,361, Government Actuary's Department contributes £19,224 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
As well as competitive salaries, we offer a substantial package of benefits:

* Exceptional learning and development opportunities that you can explore alongside your day\-to\-day work.
* 25 days annual leave per year, increasing to 30 days after 5 years service. In addition, we offer 9 days public and privilege days leave per year (pro rata for part time staff)
