**.buttontext4bc4727dd4226544 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext4bc4727dd4226544 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#fd4f00 !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

We’re the UK's largest ports operator with a network of 21 ports around Britain. We handle around one quarter of the UK's seaborne trade and contribute £7\.5 billion to our economy every year.
  
  

It’s a story we’re proud of but it doesn’t end there. We’re transforming our business and embracing the future.We offer a vast range of roles spanning the UK, all rooted in a culture that welcomes diversity, fosters talent, encourages internal movement and progression, and places safety as our number one priority.
  
  

**Type:** Permanent/full time
  
  

**Location:** Southampton / hybrid working
  
  

About us
  
  

We are ABPmer, a marine consultancy and survey company that specialises in understanding one of the most complex environments on earth.
  
  

We are involved in all marine and coastal sectors, from ports to offshore wind, flood risk management to marine habitat creation and restoration. Our technical teams work across industry for all kinds of clients, supporting developers, government and its regulators, statutory nature conservation bodies and non\-governmental organisations, with a diverse portfolio of projects and services; no two projects or days are the same.
  
  

Known for our technical ability, professionalism, and service excellence, we have been helping clients sustainably manage, operate and develop in the marine environment for over 75 years. Our quality of service and customer care is due to our staff and our culture. We offer an environment focused on collaboration, continuous learning and career progression.
  
  

We are seeking a hands\-on Principal level technical authority and expert in ArcGIS systems to lead the development and integration of geospatial and digital delivery across the business. Working across our Environment, Survey, Maritime and Modelling technical teams, you will design, deliver and assure high\-quality geospatial solutions for client projects, while shaping ABPmer's geospatial strategy, standards, tools and digital capabilities.
  
  

The role combines expertise in ESRI’s ecosystem (desktop, mobile and web), automation, spatial data management and the marine environment. You will lead on complex technical delivery, develop efficient and repeatable workflows, provide technical assurance and peer review, mentor colleagues, support bids and client engagement, and drive innovation in marine spatial analysis, data services, dashboards, web applications and digital products. The role also includes line management responsibility.
  
  

Discover more about us.
  
  

About you
  
  

You are a highly organised, proactive, collaborative and self\-motivated individual with excellent geospatial and digital skills which you can apply to a range of marine and coastal projects. You are highly skilled in:
  
  

Advanced knowledge of ESRI products including ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online, with extensive experience delivering geospatial solutions in a consultancy or commercial environment.
  
Strong capability in Python, ArcPy, ArcGIS API for Python and ModelBuilder, developing automated, repeatable workflows for analysis, data management, QA/QC and reporting.
  
Proven experience designing and supporting web GIS applications and services, including Experience Apps, Dashboards, StoryMaps, Survey123 and Field Maps (inc. SWEET).
  
Advanced skills in spatial analysis, cartography, data visualisation and geospatial data management, including marine and coastal applications.
  
Experience in AI driven processes, geodatabase design, SQL/spatial databases, data integration and analytical workflows relevant to marine/coastal consultancy.
  
Strong understanding of data governance, quality assurance, metadata, coordinate systems and geospatial best practice.
  
Ability to provide technical leadership and assurance on complex projects, including solution design, peer review, risk management and delivery to programme and budget.
  
Proven track record in business development, client engagement and proposal/tender preparation, translating technical capability into client value.
  
Experience with cloud\-based geospatial solutions and Microsoft Azure would be advantageous.
  
Strong communication, leadership and mentoring skills.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

You will have a degree or postgraduate qualification in GIS, Information Technology or a closely related subject
  
A minimum 10 years’ experience, preferably in a marine/built environment consultancy
  
  

Why join us?
  
  

**Our people:** We are a friendly, welcoming team focussed on collaborative working. Our culture means you are encouraged to chart your own course to excellence
  
**Our projects:** We deliver a diverse portfolio of projects allowing you to apply your expertise to an array of interesting projects and locations.
  
**Our flexibility:** We understand the importance of a good work\-life balance offering flexible arrangements as standard including hybrid\-working.
  
**Your career development:** We offer a programme of continuous professional development supported by tailored, formal and on\-the\-job training and mentoring.
  
**Your benefits:** As part of Associated British Ports Group you benefit from a contribution\-matched pension plan, private medical and dental insurance, a paid professional subscription, and local and national retail discounts.
  
**Our team is growing:** With the Net Zero revolution we continue to grow to meet the high demand for our bespoke services. Join us as we embark on a new journey.
  
  

Want to see what it’s like to work for the UK’s largest port operator? Our virtual work experience programme gives you an inside look at trade, sustainability, safety, and careers in one of the UK’s most vital indutries\- https://www.talentxp.co.uk/track/e2e029cd
  
  

**Additional Information:**  

When joining ABP you will find an environment that is both welcoming and challenging. We reward our employees well and offer a generous remuneration package, employer pension, private health insurance and a range of other benefits.Please note that ABP undertake random screening for substance abuse and operate a zero\-tolerance policy. A medical will be required before starting this position also.
  
  

We are an equal opportunities employer and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their background, which helps us to provide a diverse and inclusive working environment. As part of our recruitment process, all successful candidates will be subject to pre\-employment screening to Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). Please note your consent will be required and further information on this check can be found using the following link: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united\-kingdom\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels/national\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels

jobs.title: Retail Sales Advisor - Merthyr
jobs.description:
Ref
1324

Location
Merthyr Tydfil
Employment type
Full\-time

£48,300 to £53,950
Description
**Retail Sales Advisor**


**Role Overview**


Our Retail Sales Advisors are at the heart of our business acting as our biggest brand ambassadors. Often the first point of contact for customers visiting our network of showrooms, they are both inspired and empowered to support our customers in growing their homes by assisting them in choosing the perfect pieces of furniture and accessories from our broad range of products. They achieve this with every customer by being commercially minded and adopting a consultative sales approach using their expert knowledge of our comprehensive product range to deliver an exceptional experience on every occasion.


This commitment to high performance is recognised and rewarded through our generous, industry\-leading uncapped commission scheme, which ensures that all our Retail colleagues are rewarded for their dedication and hard work.


**About The Role**


Core Responsibilities


* Provide all customers with an exceptional customer experience by sharing their expert knowledge of Oak Furnitureland's extensive product ranges and services.
* Follow the Retail Sales Model to make recommendations based on customer needs, supporting the right purchasing decisions to be made.
* Contributes towards improving Oak Furnitureland’s customer satisfaction scores, including Net Promoter Score and Trust Pilot ratings, increasing customer loyalty and brand perception, influencing repeat business and new sales opportunities.
* Consistently achieve personal sales and performance KPIs and targets, supporting the overall showroom team to collectively achieve outstanding business performance.
* Adopting a one\-team approach by working closely with the Store Manager and Assistant Manager to create an inclusive team culture aligned with our purpose and values, and always displaying our expected behaviours.
* Collaborate with other business areas to create and maintain a compliant and up\-to\-date retail environment by working proactively with the Visual Merchandising and Facilities \& Maintenance Teams to provide a safe and inviting showroom that showcases Oak Furnitureland products and services to the highest standards.
* Positively engage with Partnering 4 Performance, enabling the shaping of personal objectives and robust development plans that support both individual and business growth plans.
* Deliver business, divisional, and showroom ways of working, always adhering to Oak Furnitureland processes, policies, and procedures.
* Remain up\-to\-date and commercially aware of internal and external factors that may impact business trade and customer experience.
* Utilise all training materials and business communications to keep own knowledge of Oak Furnitureland products and services up to date enhancing both personal and business sales performance.
* Using Oak Furnitureland systems, ensure all customer information is processed compliantly, efficiently and correctly following all procedures and policies.
* Encourage and deliver a seamless omnichannel customer journey by recommending and using digital resources and marketing tools to help customers make informed purchase decisions.
  

Skills and Experience


* Extensive experience working in customer\-facing environments, demonstrating in\-depth knowledge and understanding of retail sales and delivering an exceptional customer journey, ideally within furniture or similar consultative\-based sales environments.
* Knowledge of using sales models and following sales processes, enabling personal targets to be achieved.
* Highly skilled at questioning and listening techniques, adopting a persuasive communication style with the ability to influence, generate, and build positive relationships.
* Demonstrable knowledge and experience of working within successful high\-performing teams.
* Experience in consistently achieving stretch personal and team goals and KPIs.
* Understand the link between customer experience and key metrics such as NPS, Trust Pilot, repeat business, and new sales opportunities.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge and awareness of the furniture industry\-associated products and services and understanding of Oak Furnitureland’s USPs and competitors.
* Understanding of the regulatory frameworks associated with this sector and role, with relevant experience enabling the following and delivering of set policies and procedures.
* Knowledge and awareness of purchasing motivations and the internal and external factors that could influence purchasing decisions.

Our Retail Sales Advisors work towards a store target, offering uncapped commission rates of up to 4% on all sales.


Working Hours


This is a full\-time role working 40 hours per week, 5 out of 7 days, with one weekend off every six.


This position may suit individuals with previous skills or experience gained from the following roles: Sales Associate, Sales Consultant, Retail Associate, Sales Professional, Sales Consultant or Sales Executive.


**Benefits**


* Exclusive Employee Discounts: Enjoy unbeatable savings on all Oak Furnitureland products after completing your probation period.
* Generous Holiday Allowance: Benefit from 20 days of holiday each year (excluding Bank Holidays), giving you ample time to relax and recharge.
* Celebrate Your Special Day: Take an extra day off to celebrate your birthday or another special occasion important to you!
* My Rewards Programme: Unlock incredible savings and enjoy exclusive discounts on essentials and luxuries, from dining out and grocery shopping to entertainment, holidays, and gym memberships.
* Competitive Pension Scheme: Secure your future with a 4% employee contribution, matched by the company.
* Comprehensive Life Assurance: Receive free coverage worth at least twice your annual salary, ensuring peace of mind up to age 65\.
* Continued Development: Enhance your skills and support your future career advancement with ongoing training and growth opportunities within the company.
* Supportive Employee Assistance Programme: Access professional counselling services via phone or in person whenever needed.
* Convenient Free On\-site Parking: Enjoy the convenience and ease of free parking at our location.

**Company Information**


Oak Furnitureland launched in 2006\. Our brand was built on ensuring our customers could access high\-quality hardwood furniture at affordable prices, and we were predominantly known for our range of well\-crafted cabinetry.


Fast\-forward to today, and you’ll discover our commitment to using quality materials and creating furniture built to last hasn’t changed. We still offer great value for money, too, but what you’ll discover now is an evolution that’s seen us expand our categories and styles of furniture so that we can offer something for every home.


Not only do we offer fantastic pieces of furniture for the home, but we are also a great place to work. It is one where colleagues are valued, feel connected to the business, and are provided with an environment where they can flourish, contribute, and develop their careers.


To support us, we are guided by our company's purpose of ‘helping people make their house a real home’, which is underpinned by our values:


* We are adaptable
* We are experts
* We are authentic
* We are one team
* We put our customers first.

**Equal Opportunities Employer**


Our mission is to build an open and inclusive work environment where all colleagues have equal opportunity and access to development, progression and growth. We strive to recruit and retain diverse talent representative of our customer demographic.


We have an inclusive environment where everyone can be themselves and are driven by the same purpose and values. As we endeavour to create a workplace that reflects our diverse customer base and the communities in which we live and work, we strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to minority and underrepresented groups. We are committed to fairness in how we hire new colleagues and if you require any additional support to help you through the process, we’re happy to make the necessary adjustments for anyone who needs them.


Please know that any offer is subject to references and a DBS check.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing EMEA - International Private Bank
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The J.P. Morgan Private Bank sits within Global Wealth Management, a division of Asset \& Wealth Management, and is focused on working with ultra\-high net worth (UHNW) individuals, families, and foundations. The Private Bank offers comprehensive financial and wealth solutions that integrate sophisticated investment management, wealth advisory, capital markets, trust and banking capabilities


Asset \& Wealth Management (AWM) Marketing's overall goal is simple: to be a trusted partner and advisor to the business that helps drive strong results. In support of that goal, we are focused on five key priorities — bringing the brand to life through our client experience; simplifying how we position our products and advice; disrupting and modernizing our content strategy by being digital first; and boosting revenue with data\-driven acquisition and deepening strategies. Our collaborative organization has approximately 500 team members sitting in locations around the world.


The EMEA Marketing team provides strategic marketing services to the Private Bank business across EMEA. Based in London, this role is responsible for developing and implementing an EMEA\-wide marketing strategy that supports and amplifies the business' growth plans, whilst cultivating and developing a strong team focus and inclusive culture. With a focus on acquiring clients both regionally and in specific markets and defined verticals, as well as to deepen relationships with existing clients, including supporting the daily investment marketing needs of the business. This is an integral role to the business and will be a member the International Private Bank Marketing Management team and sit on the wider EMEA leadership team.


**Job Responsibilities**

* To drive the strategic direction of the EMEA Marketing team in achieving business growth, operational excellence as well as talent acquisition and retention in partnership with regional and global business partners
* To build and lead the EMEA Marketing team with a collaborative culture and fully connected with the international and global marketing organization
* To formulate holistic marketing strategies to raise brand awareness, acquire new clients and deepen relationships with existing clients, based on the deep understanding of regional priorities (business objectives, segmentation and priority markets and verticals)
* A strong focus on digital marketing with a data first approach to digital tools, applications, and maturity models
* To partner with practice and solutions leaders to deliver practical tools to drive credit and investment flows
* Lead the dialogue on content segmentation, persona and personalisation experiences
* Application of AI to improve operational efficiencies and innovate strategically
* Strong team leadership to foster positive culture and grow the team in\-line with the strategic growth of the business in region
* A deep focus on local marketing strategies, ensuring a tailored approach market\-by\-market, with local business objectives, local language, cultural nuance and audience segmentation at the core
* Laser\-focussed approach on driving new lead generation \& client acquisition/conversion, through marketing strategies including paid media, partnerships \& content strategies
* To define, measure and evaluate KPIs on all initiatives including, as relevant, brand awareness, new leads generated, gross new clients, increases in product penetration, investment flows and share of wallet. To liaise with regional and global counterparts to share best practice and implement global solutions across the region
* To undertake marketing campaigns, activities, and initiatives through a digital and data led mindset
* To work closely and cross\-functionally with market managers and business partners in the region and across the globe
* To undertake all activities to the highest quality and regulatory standards to ensure that we conduct first\-class business in a first\-class way.
* To partner with other regional heads on IPB led initiatives

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Marketing professional, strategic thinker and all\-round marketer with strong understanding of the EMEA competitive landscape. Ability to inspire, challenge and influence
* Long\-standing experience and business acumen to create country marketing strategies and promptly establish priorities and communicate expectations
* Exceptional relationship and stakeholder management with proven track record of successfully operating in a sophisticated marketing organization
* Record\-proving team leadership experience, with proven ability to grow and manage teams across a broad spectrum of levels and experience. Demonstrated ability to coach, motivate and manage teams in a collaborative culture
* Successful record of delivering work with measurable business results on time and on budget
* Experienced in marketing acquisition and deepening experience gained within a Private Bank / FS / Other related industry environment
* Marketing strategy experience
* Deep understanding of Ultra\-High\-Net\-Worth Individuals, Family Office and Multigenerational Wealth
* Strong digital marketing and data acumen, with proven track record and experience of delivering digital marketing campaigns and initiatives
* Ideally strong knowledge of the Private Bank industry (or similar) in EMEA
* Creative mind with the ability to formulate strategy and solid project management capabilities to take this to execution

**ABOUT US**
  

  

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first\-class business in a first\-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long\-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan Asset \& Wealth Management delivers industry\-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

Description:
**Company overview**

  

As the agency\-model execution services arm of the Nomura Group, Instinet Incorporated subsidiaries provide brokerage services to clients in over 65 markets around the world. Through its advanced suite of electronic trading strategies, experienced high\-touch trading group, top\-ranked Commission Management services, award\-winning desktop trading platform, and unparalleled access to insightful analytics, content and unique liquidity, Instinet helps institutions lower overall trading costs and ultimately improve investment performance. Over the course of its 50\+ year history, Instinet has introduced a range of now industry\-standard trading technologies, and has been an innovator at the forefront of the market's evolution. For more information, please visit www.instinet.com.

  

**Department Overview**

  

Financial Data \& Business Analysis will be responsible for the ownership, analysis, control and governance of financial, liquidity and business\-cost data supporting Instinet Europe Limited’s Clearing \& Settlement Services business and relevant activities within Business Control.

  

The role will sit within Business Operations and provide dedicated analytical ownership of the financial economics of the Clearing \& Settlement Services business, ensuring that the relationship between client activity, transaction volumes, clearing and settlement activity, liquidity utilisation, infrastructure costs, client charges and business profitability is understood, appropriately controlled and accurately represented.

  

**Role Description**

  

The successful candidate will take ownership of the financial and analytical data provided by Business Operations to Finance for client invoicing and other financial processes, together with oversight of relevant NPE and associated business costs. The individual will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to understand underlying cost and revenue drivers, investigate material movements and provide meaningful analysis to support business management and decision\-making.


In addition, the role will have responsibility for relevant financial data, modelling, EUCs and analytical activities undertaken within Business Control.

  

Key objectives critical to success (and not limted to):

  

* Own the financial and analytical data supporting the Clearing \& Settlement Services business.
* Lead the development, maintenance and governance of liquidity\-related data, reporting and analytical models.
* Business Operations oversight of the financial and transactional data supplied to Finance for client invoicing.
* Business Operations oversight, monitoring and analysis of relevant NPE and associated costs of operating the Clearing \& Settlement Services business.
* Financial models and material EUCs operated within Business Operations for Clearing \& Settlement Services and relevant Business Control activities.
* Take ownership of key financial data, analytical models, reporting and End User Computing (EUC) tools that support Business Control activities.
* All aspects of Business and Management Information
* Develop strong working relationships with stakeholders across Business Operations, the Front Office, Business Control, Finance, Treasury, Technology, Product and other relevant functions.
  

**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:**

  

* Degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Business or a related discipline.
* ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA or equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience within an investment bank, broker\-dealer, agency brokerage, clearing or financial\-market infrastructure environment.
* Knowledge of cash equities, clearing and settlement and the associated trade lifecycle.
* Understanding of CCPs, CSDs, custodians, exchanges and associated infrastructure charging models
* Significant prior experience in financial analysis, business analysis, management information, financial control, product control or a comparable analytical role within financial services.
* Strong quantitative and financial analytical capability with demonstrable experience analysing large and complex financial or transactional data sets.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience developing and maintaining complex financial models and EUCs.
* Experience analysing revenues, costs, invoices and business profitability, with strong understanding of financial data controls, reconciliations and data\-quality management.
  

**Nomura Competencies**


**Explore Insights \& Vision**


* Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.

**Making Strategic Decisions**


* Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.

**Inspire Entrepreneurship in People**


* Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.

**Elevate Organizational Capability**


* Engage proactively in professional development and enhance team productivity through the promotion of knowledge sharing.

**Inclusion**

Respect DEI, foster a culture of psychological safety in the workplace and cultivate a "Risk Culture" (Challenge, Escalate and Respect).  

*

The UK Government have taken steps to reduce net migration to the UK by limiting the number of overseas workers coming to the UK for employment. Please note that whilst we are able to consider applications from overseas workers from outside the UK (who require a Tier 2 Skilled Worker visa) we can only employ them if we can provide evidence that this is a genuine vacancy for a qualified role.

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**

Nomura is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to ensuring we best reflect the diversity of the communities we serve creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. We welcome all applications and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnership, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

  

If you require any assistance or reasonable adjustments due to a disability or long\-term health condition, please do not hesitate to contact us.

  

Nomura is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer – Transformers
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations – Glasgow, Perth, Inverness or Aberdeen.


**Salary:** £59,800 \- £89,800 \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



At SSEN Transmission, we are building a smarter, more flexible network for net zero, delivering clean, secure and affordable electricity for generations to come.



Network Engineering, within the Asset Management and Operations Directorate, provides the technical governance that ensures our Transmission network is designed and operated safely, reliably and in line with relevant legislation.



We're looking for a Principal Engineer – Transformers to define technical policy, influence industry standards and support innovative projects across our high\-voltage transmission network.


**You will**


* Write, maintain and own technical specifications and guidance notes for electrical wound plant, including grid transformers, super\-grid transformers, HVDC converter transformers, shunt/series reactors and earthing/auxiliary transformers used on the Transmission network.
* Review existing specifications and update them based on lessons learned from projects and developments in technology.
* As part of the Technical Authority, review test plans to ensure technology and equipment selected is adequately tested, proven and validated, and review proposed suppliers to confirm their suitability for use on the transmission network.
* Witness testing of transformers in manufacturers' facilities, carry out technical audits of manufacturing facilities and provide Subject Matter Expert input to design reviews carried out by the Design Authority.
* Provide technical consultancy services across SSEN Transmission, support the development of colleagues, share specialist knowledge and represent SSEN Transmission at industry body events such as ENA, IEC or CIGRE working groups.


**You have**


* A degree in Electrical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline, alongside Chartered Engineer status with a relevant institution or working towards chartered status.
* Expert\-level experience in the design, specification and application of transmission voltage wound plant, including grid transformers, super\-grid transformers, HVDC converter transformers, shunt/series reactors and earthing/auxiliary transformers.
* The ability and experience to technically assess issues and problems, critically evaluate a range of technical solutions and apply an in\-depth understanding of the requirements for design, planning, installation, operation and maintenance of wound plant.
* Detailed knowledge and understanding of National Grid, British and European Standards, with capability and experience in writing technical specifications, guidance notes and work instructions for wound plant.
* Experience in the manufacturing and testing of transmission voltage wound plant and equipment would also be advantageous.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Assistant Shop Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**


As an Assistant Shop Manager in Mind Retail, you'll work alongside the Shop Manager and the wider shop team, inclusive of volunteers, to deliver sales and profit targets for your shop, where every item sold fights for mental health. The money raised from our charity shops funds Mind's vital mental health support services, helping the 1 in 4 of us that experience a mental health problem in their lifetime.


You'll also work with the team to produce excellent shop standards and deliver outstanding customer service \- creating a hub for the local community. Our Assistant Managers also take full responsibility whilst the Shop Manager is away for the day\-to\-day running and overall performance of the shop.


As Assistant Shop Manager, you'll also be invested in, and supported to grow. We actively look for opportunities to learn so we can do better for the people who need us. With development programmes and a vast programme of workshops, you'll be able to take ownership for your own personal and professional development. You'll be able to make a real difference and will play an important role in the fight for mental health, helping us to respond to the mental health emergency.


We're looking for someone who:


* is passionate about retail
* has the ability to lead and motivate others
* can plan and prioritise their own workload and the workload of the team
* has a strong customer focus
* can demonstrate our values and behaviours, which are at the core of all we do

If you haven't got management or supervisor level experience, don't worry! We're just as interested in people who want a career in retail, are prepared to work hard and are eager to learn.


We need great people like you to help us in the fight for mental health. Will you join us?

  

**About our benefits**


As Assistant Shop Manager, you'll receive the fantastic benefits below:


* Competitive hourly pay, which is in line with the Real Living Wage
* 25 days' paid holiday per year (pro\-rata for part\-time employees)
* Development workshops \& courses, to help build your career
* Comprehensive, personalised induction programmes, tailored to your role when you join us
* A huge variety of additional qualifications \& development programmes for anyone looking to grow their skills
* A strong commitment to work\-life balance
* Family friendly policies \& enhanced pay
* A competitive pension scheme \& life assurance, available to all our employees
* 25% staff discount in all Mind shops
* Access to exclusive discounts at over 160 retailers through our employee savings app
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Interest free season ticket loan

jobs.title: Tax (ATT-CTA) Graduate Programme - Starting March 2027
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

**Overview**  

We are Dixon Wilson. A specialist firm of accomplished accountancy and tax advisors offering a bespoke and personal service to private clients, their families, trusts and businesses. Determined problem solvers since 1888, we are proud to be an independent firm. Proactive, curious, and nimble – this is Dixon Wilson through and through. Our heritage is important to us. What we’ve learnt from our past we bring with us to create our future.  

  

**Who we Are**  

As a ﬁrm, we depend on having great people. People who are able to solve the complex challenges of our clients, and keep up with the pace of how we operate. People who guide our purpose by demonstrating three important values that sit at our core: Seek the solution, Solve together, Be curious.  

As people are at the heart of what we do, we place a strong emphasis on ensuring our staff enjoy the work they do to remain happy, engaged and motivated.  

We have 15 Partners and approximately 180 employees in total. The technical expertise of our partners and staff is outstanding. This is supported by the number of industry and professional prizes awarded to the firm and staff. We are one of only 12 ‘tier 1’ private client teams in the country.
With over 60 trainees at varying stages of a training programme, the firm recognises the importance of life beyond learning. Our active social committee, with support from our partners, delivers a wide range of social and charitable activities such as our annual charity poker night, chess evenings, monthly drinks, netball, cricket and tennis to name a few! These events are a great way to get to know colleagues at all levels.

Our office in London, occupying the ground, upper floors and roof terrace of a modern development on Chancery Lane, is an impressive and enjoyable location to work, with views across the city### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Your career in Private Client Tax at Dixon Wilson**
Our private client tax team believe that everyone has a responsibility to conduct their affairs ethically. As a result, we assist personal tax clients to make sure they pay the appropriate amount of tax. We provide legitimate, robust tax advice that holds up to scrutiny from tax authorities. We pride ourselves on our ability to ensure that our clients remain compliant with current legislation.  

By joining our three\-year graduate programme we will fund and support you as you study towards the ATT \& CTA qualifications. On successful completion of the ATT exams and with two years' practical tax experience, you will qualify as a Taxation Technician (Association of Taxation Technicians). Following this, you will continue your studies to qualify as a Chartered Tax Advisor and become a member of the Chartered Institute of taxation. The CTA is a globally recognised qualification and the pinnacle in professional tax expertise.  

You’ll gain hands\-on experience from day one. As part of one of our multi\-disciplinary teams, you’ll start by supporting personal tax compliance for a diverse range of UK and international clients, including both individuals and trusts. As you progress, you'll get involved in various advisory projects covering complex financial matters for our private clients. You’ll be guided and mentored by experienced managers, developing the technical expertise and insight that make our private client tax team so highly regarded and technically adept.  

**What we look for:*** Candidates with an **achieved 2\.1 or higher and 120 UCAS points minimum** (300 points under the old UCAS system)
* Good **numeracy skills**
* Strong listening, written and oral **communication skills**
* A **collaborative, team player** attitude
* **Adaptability** when exposed to new situations and scenarios
* A genuine **interest in pursuing a career in private client tax**
* An **aptitude to deliver** a first\-class professional service to our clients
* The **ability to balance the demands** of work and study
* **Committed to succeed** in professional examinations
* **A curious mind** and an **eagerness to learn**
* **Solution oriented** and enjoys problem solving


Our three\-year graduate tax programme will recognise, reward and nurture your talent. Within an inclusive culture that values collaboration, learning, and a commitment to problem solving.  

  

If you believe that you have the required qualities and commitment, please apply now to start with us in March 2027 \- we welcome and look forward to your application.  

  

If successful, applicants must be available to start on 22 March 2027; if you are unable to commit to that start date, please wait and apply for the March 2028 intake.  

  

When submitting your application please also upload copies of your degree and A Level (or equivalent) certificate(s) or transcript. Alternatively, email copies to careers@dixonwilson.co.uk  

  

Please note closing date: 31 October 2026, however this role may close earlier than 31 October 2026 if all positions are filled.### **About Dixon Wilson**


**Founded in 1888, Dixon Wilson is one of the leading firms of Chartered Accountants. Our office is based on Chancery Lane in the City of London.**  

  

We specialise in the provision of tax, accountancy and advisory services to high net worth private clients, including their families, trusts and businesses. We are proud of our longstanding independence and have avoided any change that would compromise the service we provide to our clients. As a result we are highly regarded both within and without the profession. A significant part of our business spans the corporate world, and increasingly has an international dimension.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Nurse
jobs.description:
We are excited to announce a wonderful opportunity to join the Clinical Trials Centre at St Mary's, ICHT. We are looking for a dedicated and passionate Band 5 Clinical Research Nurse to support our HIV and Sexual Health clinical research studies on a one\-year fixed\-term contract.
  
  

Post qualification nursing experience is essential to this role and therefore it is not suitable for newly qualified nurses or those who have yet completed their preceptorship.
  
  

This role involves onsite working only. You will be based primarily at St Mary's Hospital, Paddington, with the potential to travel to Hammersmith and Charing Cross Hospitals as needed, to assist with commercial and non\-commercial research studies.
  
  

The role also includes day to day monitoring and maintenance of the clinic and equipment, and the opportunity to manage wider team projects such as the Patient Reported Experience Survey as mandated from the NIHR, as well as clinical audits.
  
  

You will need to collaborate with the Principal Investigators (PIs), the wider Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) as well as the Study Team in order to efficiently manage a caseload of studies. Excellent communication skills are required.
  
  

Prior knowledge and clinical experience of research delivery in a healthcare setting and clinical experience or knowledge about HIV and Sexual Health would be advantageous.
  
  

The post holder will support the aims of the Trust and the NIHR clinical research network to improve the speed, quality, and integration of clinical research, through the successful delivery of clinical research in the NHS.
  
  

The post holder will support the co\-ordination and management of clinical research projects, collaborating with key personnel throughout the Trust and network to ensure continued care and support for patients involved in clinical trials.
  
  

The main focus of the role will be in supporting the delivery and development of the research portfolio through identification of suitable participants, co\-ordination, recruitment, performance and maintenance of study documentation.
  
  

The post holder will ensure that any research undertaken safeguards the well\-being of research participants and is conducted to ICH Good Clinical Practice standards.
  
  

At Imperial College Healthcare you can achieve extraordinary things with extraordinary people, working with leading clinicians pushing boundaries in patient care.
  
  

Become part of a vibrant team living our values \- expert, kind, collaborative and aspirational. You’ll get an experience like no other and will fast forward your career. Benefits include career development, flexible working and wellbeing, staff recognition scheme. Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and improving the working lives of our staff and will consider applications to work flexibly, part time or job share. Please talk to us at interview.
  
  

Environmental sustainability
  
Climate change and poor air quality is a health emergency that harms people’s health and wellbeing and widens health inequalities. The Trust is also committed to reducing its impact on the environment by reducing our greenhouse gas emissions to Net Zero by 2045\. All our employees have a role to play, and we have an active green network that supports staff to act in ways that ensures that our services are efficient, sustainable and reduce our impact on the environment www.imperial.nhs.uk/about\-us/our\-strategy/green\-plan .
  
  

The full job description provides an overview of the key tasks and responsibilities of the role and the person specification outlines the qualifications, skills, experience and knowledge required. For both overviews please view the Job Description attachment with the job advert.

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on\-premises. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
  

  

If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at \+1\-510\-713\-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Sales Support Administrator
jobs.description:

===========


Quilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation.
  

  

Quilter oversees £157\.4 billion in customer investments (as of August 2026\). It has an adviser and customer offering spanning financial advice, investment platforms, multi\-asset investment solutions, and discretionary fund management. The business is comprised of two segments: Affluent and High Net Worth.  

  

Affluent encompasses the financial planning business, Quilter Financial Planning, the Quilter Investment Platform and Quilter Investors, the multi\-asset investment solutions business.
  

  

High Net Worth includes the discretionary fund management business, Quilter Cheviot, together with Quilter Cheviot Financial Planning – offering a highly personalised service to private clients, charities, trustees, and professional partners. Quilter Cheviot has presence throughout the UK, Ireland and Channel Islands.
  

  

At Quilter we never stand still. ==================

Regulated/Non\-Regulated: Non\-Regulated

PepsiCo generated nearly $92 billion in net revenue in 2024, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi\-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo’s product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.


Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with pep\+ (PepsiCo Positive). pep\+ is our strategic end\-to\-end transformation that puts sustainability and human capital at the centre of how we will create value and growth by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for planet and people. jobs.title: Principal Financial Reporting Accountant
jobs.description:
About the Role  

Ready to be the person who turns numbers into decisions?


At EDF, we're looking for an experienced finance professional who loves seeing the bigger picture behind the data. You'll be at the heart of our Customers Finance team, helping senior leaders understand performance, shape strategy, and make decisions that support both our business and Britain's journey to net zero.


This is a role where your expertise will be valued, your insights will be heard, and your work will influence decisions at the highest levels. Because at EDF, Success is Personal.

**The Opportunity**


As a Principal Financial Reporting Accountant, you'll play a key role in ensuring our financial reporting is accurate, insightful, and supports effective decision\-making across the business. Working within our Financial Control \& Reporting team, you'll lead the production of performance reporting, forecasting, budgeting and regulatory submissions, while partnering with senior stakeholders across Finance and the wider business.


You'll be the trusted expert helping leaders understand what the numbers are saying today, and what they could mean tomorrow. Whether you're consolidating financial results, leading planning cycles, supporting regulatory reporting, or driving improvements in reporting processes, you'll have a genuine impact on how the business operates.


You'll join us on a salary starting from **£60,000 per annum**, with the potential for an annual bonus. This is a hybrid role ideally based in **\#London**, working from our Nova North office up to one day per week.


Beyond the day job, you'll gain exposure to senior leaders from the outset, work in a team that genuinely supports development, and can shape improvements across a fast\-moving, evolving business. If you're looking for a role where you can make your mark rather than simply produce reports, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

**Who You Are**

To be shortlisted, you need to offer:

* A full accounting qualification or working towards completion (ACA, ACCA or CIMA)

Alongside a starting salary from **£60,000 per annum**, potential for an annual bonus, and a market\-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Flipdish**
------------------



At Flipdish, we're turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple\-to\-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that's anything but.


**About the role**
------------------



You'll join Flipdish's Success organisation, owning and growing a focused portfolio of restaurant clients while acting as a proactive technical problem solver for the wider team. You'll partner closely with Strategic Account Management, Customer Support, Product, Sales, and Activations to improve customer satisfaction, retention, product adoption, and commercial growth.



This role blends commercial account ownership with technical curiosity. You'll be as comfortable discussing business goals, negotiating growth opportunities, and preventing churn as you are investigating customer issues, clarifying root causes, and translating technical context into clear commercial impact.



Success in this role looks like a healthy and growing account portfolio, earlier identification of churn risks, faster and clearer escalation management, and a stronger feedback loop between customers, Success, Support, and Product.


**What you'll own**
-------------------


* Own a focused portfolio of restaurant clients; build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and take responsibility for account health, satisfaction, retention, and commercial growth.
* Grow account value through consultative conversations; identify opportunities to increase subscription revenue, net fees, product adoption, and use of relevant Flipdish products and features.
* Monitor customer health, usage, order performance, adoption, and engagement signals; act early on churn risks and optimise each customer's online ordering, app/web, loyalty, and retention setup.
* Own the Success escalation pipeline into Support and Product; investigate issues, provide clear customer and commercial context, and ensure urgent or complex cases are triaged, prioritised, tracked, and followed through to resolution.
* Act as the technical bridge for the wider Strategic Account Management team; support issues beyond your own portfolio and turn recurring customer pain points into structured feedback, trend reporting, and actionable Product or Support themes.
* Use Salesforce, Looker, Flipdish Portal dashboards, customer health scores, QBRs, and account\-performance data to diagnose problems, develop account plans, identify growth opportunities, and report on churn risk, escalation volume, themes, and resolution times.
* Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility—prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.

  


**What success looks like**
---------------------------



Within your first three months, you will have:


* Built a strong working knowledge of Flipdish products, tools, customer challenges, and Success processes.
* Taken ownership of a defined account portfolio, established regular contact with key customers, and created clear plans for account health, retention, and growth.
* Identified and acted on meaningful churn risks, product issues, optimisation opportunities, and commercial growth opportunities using customer and performance data.
* Earned the trust of Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Support, and Product as a reliable technical liaison with strong organisation, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Reduced friction between Success, Support, and Product by improving escalation quality, visibility, prioritisation, and communication through to resolution.

**About you**
-------------



You'll thrive in this role if you:


* Have experience in technical account management, Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Support, implementation, or a similar customer\-facing role.
* Can combine commercial account ownership with strong technical troubleshooting instincts, investigating likely root causes before escalating.
* Understand the commercial drivers of retention, churn prevention, upsell, product adoption, and account growth.
* Can manage a portfolio of accounts while also helping the wider team resolve urgent or complex technical customer issues.
* Communicate clearly and can translate technical detail into practical customer impact, commercial risk, and useful context for internal teams.
* Are highly organised, with strong documentation habits and consistent follow\-through across account actions and escalations.
* Use data confidently to understand customer health, diagnose problems, prioritise action, and make evidence\-based recommendations.
* Work effectively across Support, Product, Sales, Activations, and Success, taking initiative without needing constant direction.
* Stay calm under pressure and take a consultative, solution\-focused approach with frustrated customers or urgent issues.
* Bring low ego, curiosity, and a willingness to learn while constructively challenging unclear thinking or ineffective processes.


The following would help you stand out:


* Experience in restaurant, hospitality, e\-commerce, payments, or hospitality technology.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Salesforce, Looker, customer\-health tooling, or similar analytics and CRM platforms.
* Experience supporting SaaS implementations, integrations, product troubleshooting, or structured technical escalations.

  


**What you get**
----------------



We're a growing startup, and we understand that amazing incentives attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you're smart, ambitious, and hard\-working, we'll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!


* Hub model (hybrid): A healthy blend of hub and home working, with two days per week from our London Bridge office
* Time off: 25 days' annual leave \+ public holidays \+ company days, including seasonal Summer Fridays
* Private healthcare: UK cover, including Vitality private health insurance
* Pension: UK retirement savings support
* Equity (ESOP): Share options, so you can share in Flipdish's long\-term success
* Team connection: Regular team meet\-ups and company events
* Wellbeing extras: Bike\-to\-work and wellness benefits

**Interview process**
---------------------



Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process.



* **Recruiter screening call (15–30 minutes)**


* **Hiring manager interview (45–60 minutes)**


* **Competency / technical stage**


* **Reference checks**


**Our culture**
---------------



At Flipdish, we're on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that's powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.



Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We're an AI\-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes—faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations—so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.



Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people\-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other and create the space for people to grow, with balance rather than burnout. We're focused on impact and team energy, not "being seen". You'll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.



If you'd like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.


**Don't be shy. Apply.**
------------------------



We know imposter syndrome can be a thing—don't let it be. We want enthusiastic people from all backgrounds. If you feel like you're up for working with us, get in touch.



If you need assistance during the hiring process, reach out—we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Substations
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations – Glasgow, Perth, Inverness or Aberdeen


**Salary:** £59,800 \- £89,800 \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



At SSEN Transmission, we are building a network for Net Zero \- one that's smarter, more flexible, and equipped to support the future of energy. Our mission is to deliver clean, reliable investment in the network that provides long\-lasting benefits for generations to come.



Our Network Engineering team sits within the Asset Management and Operations Directorate. We are responsible for ensuring that engineering activities across our Transmission projects and business areas are safe, technically sound and fully supported. We carry out Design and Technical Engineering Governance for the Transmission business, ensuring our network operates safely, reliably and in compliance with the relevant legislation.



As part of our journey, we are looking for a Principal Engineer \- Substations to join our specialist team. This is a key role where you will help shape technical policy, influence industry standards, and support the delivery of innovative, future\-ready projects across our high\-voltage transmission network.


**You will**


* Own and maintain technical specifications and guidance notes for substation designs, including substation earthing systems.
* Continuously improve existing specifications based on lessons learned and emerging technologies.
* Collaborate with other engineering disciplines, including Civil, LV/MV systems, Cables and Overhead Lines, while working closely with asset management and operations teams.
* Support the Design Authority and act as part of the Technical Authority, providing expert input into substation design reviews to ensure compliance with technical specifications and suitability for the transmission network.
* Represent SSEN Transmission at industry events and working groups, share best practice, offer technical consultancy across the business and mentor peers to support team development.


**You have**


* A degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with Chartered Engineer status or active progress towards it.
* Strong experience in the design, specification and application of transmission voltage substations.
* The ability to critically assess technical challenges and evaluate a range of solutions, with a solid understanding of the design, planning, operation and development requirements of the transmission network.
* Familiarity with SSE Transmission, National Grid, British and European Standards, and experience writing technical specifications, guidance notes or work instructions.
* Relevant exposure to the design, manufacturing, testing, installation or maintenance of transmission voltage plant and equipment, plus a passion for engineering excellence and helping shape the future of the UK’s transmission network.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.

Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. * Proactive approach to problem solving and a customer first approach
* Highly commercial and results focussed \- significant experience of reducing cost whilst improving standardisation
* High drive with strong attention to detail. Can cope with a high degree of ambiguity, uncertainty and change
* Strong resilience with the ability to keep focussed on the big picture and end goal
* Previous experience of refurbishment and maintenance management is desirable
* Ability to positively influence multiple stakeholders across countries and cultures

You are reading the right advert if you are looking for:

**Circa £50,000 DOE \+ benefits**

**Warwick based, hybrid \- 3 days pw onsite/ 2 WFH**

  



***At National Gas, the work we do matters.***

  



As Britain's national gas network, we help keep the lights on, businesses running, and homes warm by maintaining the critical infrastructure that transports gas across Great Britain. While providing the energy security Britain relies on today, we're also helping transform the network for a clean energy future.

***Join us and help secure Britain's energy.***

**About the role:**

This Finance \& Governance Analyst position works within our Innovation team **ensuring the National Gas Innovation portfolio is financially controlled, effectively governed and able to demonstrate measurable value**. The role manages **portfolio budgeting, forecasting and reporting; coordinates project sanction, contracting and regulatory reporting**; and maintains clear visibility of **project performance and benefits from idea through to implementation**. Working across Innovation, Finance, Legal, Procurement and project teams, the role provides **accurate analysis, robust assurance and practical improvements to the systems and processes** that enable successful innovation delivery.

**Key accountabilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Manage portfolio **budgets, forecasts, accruals and financial reporting**, working with Finance and project teams to **maintain accurate information and provide clear insight on performance, risks and variances**.

* Knowledge of regulated innovation funding mechanisms, including NIA, SIF, UIOLI and Net Zero Reopeners.
