jobs.title: Head of Participant Interests
jobs.description:
We are Allwyn UK, part of the Allwyn Entertainment Group – a multi\-national lottery operator with a market\-leading presence across Europe which includes: Czech Republic, Austria, Greece, Cyprus \& Italy.
 

While the main contribution of The National Lottery to society is through the funds to good causes, at Allwyn we put our purpose and values at the heart of everything we do. Join us as we embark on a once\-in\-a\-lifetime, largescale transformation journey by creating a National Lottery that delivers more money to good causes.


We’ll talk a bit more about us further down the page, but for now – let’s talk about the role and who we’re looking for…

  



**A bit about the role…**


Lead Allwyn's Participant Interests strategy by combining regulatory excellence, customer insight, digital innovation and external best practice to create safe, sustainable player experiences that support commercial growth and maximise returns to Good Causes


The Participant Interests team leads the business on responsible play. We are considered subject matter experts and work extensively with internal and external stakeholders to identify, address and manage PI activities that align with our world\-leading ambition and our regulatory requirements. We work closely with commercial functions to enable the business to achieve its ambitious commercial goals and unlock growth opportunities. We are outward looking, always seeking to learn about best practice from other companies and external stakeholders, and managing reputational risks associated with PI.

 **What you’ll be doing…**

* Act as the organisation's expert on emerging external trends, regulation, responsible play, digital consumer protection and player wellbeing, translating insights into strategy and action.
* Develop and embed PI strategy and plans aligned to international best practice and doing “all we can”
* Partner with Product, Digital, Marketing and Commercial teams to design responsible\-by\-design customer experiences and identify opportunities that drive customer trust, engagement and sustainable growth.
* Where necessary, provide independent challenge and strategic guidance to commercial teams, ensuring growth initiatives are balanced against participant protection obligations, customer wellbeing considerations and reputational risk
* Lead on the evaluation and improvement of the PI plan, aligned to overall strategy
* Work cross\-functionally to embed PI initiatives and requirements aligned to overall strategy, and in alignment with licence requirements
* Lead the PI team’s annual planning process and strategic development
* Line manage the two Senior PI Managers, who are responsible for day\-to\-day delivery
* Ensure cross\-functional projects are compliant with the requirements of the Responsible Gaming Framework and strategy
* Ensure key internal and external stakeholders and governance groups, e.g. PPSG, PPAG are included in decision making and kept up to date with progress (including proposing agendas, preparing materials, briefing Execs ahead of external stakeholder meetings etc.)
* Utilise data, behavioural insight and technology to measure effectiveness and develop innovative participant protection interventions. Lead on functional compliance and risk activities
* Prepare high quality materials for Exec\-level forums, Board and Gambling Commission

 **What experience we’re looking for…**

* Proven track record of leading customer protection, responsible play or consumer risk strategies, leveraging data, insight and external best practice to influence business outcomes
* An excellent understanding of consumer protection practices and the gaming industry
* Experience in developing strategies
* Experienced at presenting information and constructing clear reports and persuasive arguments
* Involvement in meetings with senior and executive management, including leading discussions
* Ability to analyse data at a high level
* Previous experience of managing and leading projects
* Knowledge and practical experience of working with external benchmarks
* Excellent stakeholder management skills

 **Key Measures of Success:**

* Overall plans delivered on time, high quality and on budget
* PI plan effective at meeting licence conditions and unlocking growth opportunities
* Risk and compliance activities completed on time
* Excellent internal stakeholder relationships and positive external stakeholder relationships as required

 **About us:
‍**

We’ve developed ground\-breaking technologies, built player protection frameworks, and have a proven track record of making lotteries better.


Innovation \- We pride ourselves on it! We’re constantly looking for new ways to excite our customers, bringing new products to enjoy which is all underpinned by our responsible play values and making them accessible to all.


Giving back – Did you know that playing the lottery generates around £30m a week for charities and good causes in the UK? Our aim is to have doubled this number by the end of the first 10 year licence


Sustainability – Our aim to be net zero by 2030 which would make us the first lottery provider globally to achieve this


Inclusion and accessibility – We are making all parts of The National Lottery inclusive – whether you play a game in a store or online.  



If you need any assistance or adjustments to this job description or in the application process, please contact a member of the talent team at careers@allwyn.co.uk and we’ll be happy to help.  



\*\*Being the custodians of the National Lottery license is a big responsibility, so all of our roles are subject to extensive background checks\*\*

  



At Allwyn, we’ve put together a range of inclusive benefits and policies to support our colleagues at every stage of their lives and careers. Here’s a list of some of the fantastic benefits we offer…


* Company bonus scheme
* Matched pension contributions up to 8\.5%
* 26 days annual leave \+ 2 Life Days (and bank holidays)
* Complimentary Private Medical
* Life Assurance
* Enhanced Maternity \& Paternity leave
* £500 wellness allowance
* Access to nutritional advisor and personal trainers
* Discounted Health Assessments
* Complimentary Financial coaching

  



Our benefits and policies reflect our commitment to wellbeing and inclusivity and are enhanced with features that benefit our colleagues (and their families). By offering a variety of benefits that support our colleagues, we continue to create a place of work where people feel rewarded and can succeed.

  



**A place of belonging…**

We want to create one of the UK’s most inclusive organisations – where people can bring the best of themselves, to do their best work, every day, for the benefit of good causes.


Allwyn is an Equal Opportunity Employer which prides itself in being diverse and inclusive. We do not tolerate discrimination, harassment, or victimisation in the workplace. All employment decisions at Allwyn are based on the business needs, the job requirements, and the individual qualifications. Allwyn encourages applications from individuals regardless of age, disability (visible or hidden), sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

jobs.title: Pharmacist
jobs.description:
Package Description

On top of your salary, we also offer:

* Location benefits including relocation support (up to £8k) and Welcome to Well bonus (£5K net payment) – varies depending on location, please check with our Resourcing Team
* GPhC / PSNI and DBS/ PVG fees paid
* Fully supported career development
* Opportunity to become an LPC representative
* Bonus scheme
* Pension Scheme
* Generous holiday allowance
* Employee discount


We can offer consistent rotas and geographical coverage that suits you.


But there is much more we offer in terms of developing and growing your career.


You’ll be supported in your role by an Area Operations Manager and a Regional Operations Manager, with regular structured pharmacy visits


We have invested in new technologies for our pharmacies including a new PMR system and centralised dispensing to allow you to focus on providing quality care and services to our customers.


We are focussed on mental health and wellbeing which is why we’ve put all our field managers through the Mental Health Awareness course to raise awareness and enable a greater level of support when working in our pharmacies.


So you’ll have much more than just a salary package, its about you as a person and your professional career too!


Overview of the role

We are looking for an experienced Pharmacist to join the team and make a difference at our pharmacy in Calne.


This community pharmacy is commutable from surrounding cities/ towns/ villages and is located on a. high street. It has a good relationship with the local GP surgery/health centre.

**How our pharmacy makes a difference:**

* It dispenses up to 2000 items a week,
* It provides a wide range of services including blood pressure, ABPM, pharmacy first, nms, flu covid, meningitis B, travel vaccines and a range of private services.
* It provides services to 5 substance misuse patients.
* It dispenses 90 community blisters mainly dispensed from our central hub.


This pharmacy is open Monday \- Friday 8\.30am \- 6pm.


The dynamic team at this pharmacy is comprised of 5 qualified pharmacy assistants/ dispensers working a mixture of full and part time.


The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate must possess an MPharm degree or equivalent and management experience is desired but not essential. You will be required to have your GPhC registration upon your start date.

*Well are proud to be a diverse and inclusive employer. If you have any specific requirements, we'll do everything we can to support you. Whether it is to find a pharmacy that is accessible, or if it is a flexible position you are looking for, we can help find the role that is right for you. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process, we will be happy to accommodate you*.


About The Company

For over 70 years, we’ve been looking after the health and wellbeing of communities across the UK. Well Pharmacy (part of Bestway Healthcare) is the second largest pharmacy chain in the UK with c.760 pharmacies and a team of around 7,000 colleagues based across our Community Pharmacies, Online Pharmacy, Healthcare Services Centre, Community Drivers, Bestway Medhub \& Wardles team and our Support Centre team.


Our mission is to be here for the wellbeing of our patients and customers, to provide the best community pharmacy experience in the UK for everyone, for our patients, our customers, our people, and our NHS.


The pharmacy of the future will look very different from the one we know today. It will play a huge role in transforming primary healthcare and we will play a central role in bringing it to life.


We will use our clinical expertise and technological ambition to take advantage of the potential this future has to offer us. Making medicines, advice, services and care available in the places and spaces that people need and want it most.


We want to be a great business. To be recognised as delivering a community pharmacy experience that is the best there is. To do this we want our teams to feel proud about the positive impact they make, feel valued as part of a close\-knit and expert community, and feel confident in their role in a business that is stable, innovative, and caring.

**‘Together we make a difference’**

jobs.title: Social Worker (Substance and Alcohol Team)
jobs.description:
Job Introduction

Make a real difference in one of England's most beautiful counties and help shape brighter futures for those who need it most in Northumberland.  

  

At Northumberland County Council, we’re committed to delivering a high\-quality service to vulnerable adults and their loved ones across the County and we’re looking for professionals who share our vision.


This is an exciting opportunity for experienced Social Workers with post qualification experience, or social workers who have successfully completed the ASYE Programme to join Northumberland County Council Adults, Ageing \& Wellbeing Directorate. This is your chance to join a forward\-thinking organisation that values collaboration and is committed to delivering high\-quality support and better outcomes or the people we work with.


We have an opportunity available in the Substance and Alcohol Team (SaAT).

**About the role**  

At Northumberland County Council, we take pride in our dedicated employees who are passionate about improving the lives of adults in our communities, ensuring they feel safe, healthy, happy, and independent.


You’ll be part of a team dedicated specifically to supporting adults affected by substance and alcohol misuse, making a real difference to some of the most vulnerable individuals in our communities. You will support service users to improve wellbeing and try to promote and achieve abstinence and recovery contributing to safer and healthier communities across Northumberland.


This role offers the chance to work collaboratively with health professionals from specialist services, voluntary sector partners, and community services to deliver person\-centred support. You’ll develop expertise in complex safeguarding and substance misuse interventions, with access to comprehensive training and development opportunities.


In this role, you will conduct comprehensive assessments and enjoy a healthy balance of autonomy and support. You’ll manage your own caseload while receiving regular supervision and consistent guidance from your Team Manager. A clear understanding of the Care Act and the Local Authority’s statutory duties is essential.

**What we are looking for:**

* Enthusiastic, qualified Social Workers with a commitment to continuous development


If you bring these skills and values, we invite you to join a progressive and innovative organisation that truly values its employees.


Additional benefits of working for Northumberland include the support of our dedicated Adult Social Care training team, who provide a wide range of career development opportunities to help you grow and progress in your role. From specialist workshops to structured pathways, we are committed to investing in your professional development including the option to undertake specialist accredited training such as the Approved Mental Health Professional and Practice Educators qualifications.

**For this position you must have the following:**

* Degree in Social Work \& registered with Social Work England
* Successfully completed the UK Skills for Care ASYE programme
* It is an essential requirement of the role that the post holder has a valid UK driving licence and is either a car owner or can use a car for work purposes.

  

For further information on this position, please contact Jo Brennan, Senior Manager on JoAnn.Brennan@northumberland.gov.uk or Kate Nickson, Team Manager on Kate.Nickson@northumberland.gov.uk

jobs.description:
**Job title:** Senior Data Science Manager (Energy Management)
  

**Location:** ScottishPower HQ, Glasgow (Hybrid)
  

**Salary:** Competitive salary, bonus, car allowance \+ private family healthcare
  

**Permanent**

***Help us create a better future, quicker***

As Senior Data Science Manager within the Global Energy Management (GEM) Centre of Excellence, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of data solutions that support ScottishPower's energy management business. This is an exciting opportunity to lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of innovative data platforms that enable business\-critical decision making, support machine learning capabilities, and help drive our journey towards Net Zero.


Working at the intersection of data science, architecture, and business strategy, you'll influence the future direction of GEM's data landscape while leading complex programmes and external delivery teams in a dynamic and evolving environment.


***What you'll be doing***

Reporting to the GEM Centre of Excellence Manager, you'll lead the architecture, design, delivery, testing, and ongoing development of data solutions across the energy management function. You'll work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, translate business challenges into scalable data solutions, and ensure data is provided in an efficient, secure, and sustainable way.


You'll assess the current data landscape and develop a strategic migration roadmap that simplifies and modernises existing platforms. You'll act as product owner for data architecture and solutions within GEM, oversee delivery through external development and support partners, manage a portfolio of projects, and represent GEM's data strategy at senior leadership and enterprise\-wide forums. Machine learning and data visualisation capabilities form an important part of the technology landscape you'll shape and evolve.


***What you'll bring***

You'll bring extensive experience in data science, data architecture, data migration, and modern data engineering practices. You'll have a strong understanding of how to design scalable solutions that turn complex business requirements into valuable, actionable insights.


You'll also have experience with:


* Data warehousing, database design, and schema development
* Azure ML, Synapse, AWS, SQL, and Unix\-based environments
* Data governance, master data management, and testing frameworks
* Machine learning, statistical analysis, and data visualisation techniques
* Leading and managing external delivery teams and third\-party suppliers
* Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies
* Delivering strategic technology and data transformation programmes

Experience within energy trading or energy management environments would be advantageous.


You'll be a degree\-qualified leader who can influence stakeholders at all levels, manage complex portfolios, and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


***What's in it for you***

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you'll enjoy a bonus opportunity, private healthcare, and a salary sacrifice pension scheme where we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action, our benefits are designed to help you do just that. Benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave

* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans

* Shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, plus employee travel insurance offers

***Why ScottishPower***

ScottishPower is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. With a commitment to generate all of our energy from renewable resources and a drive to create the energy infrastructure of the future, we're at the forefront of the journey to Net Zero and investing over £6m every working day to make this happen.


With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals within a global organisation.


Inclusion, diversity, and social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Whatever your background, you'll fit right in.


ScottishPower is committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process. If you need support, please contact careers@scottishpower.com.

jobs.title: Engineering Team Leader - UK
jobs.description:
Role



Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Engineering Team Lead is accountable for the leadership, technical direction, and end\-to\-end delivery of an engineering team responsible for key components of the StarCompliance Enterprise SaaS platform.



This role combines strong technical leadership with people management and delivery accountability. Success is achieved through the capability and output of the team, while maintaining sufficient technical depth to guide design, challenge decisions, and support complex engineering work.



You will own the full lifecycle of the software and services within your team's domain, from design and development through deployment, operation, modernisation, and continuous improvement.



StarCompliance is moving towards an AI\-first, agentic software development model. You will lead this transition within your team, establishing ways of working where engineers and AI agents collaborate effectively across the software development lifecycle.



**How We Think About AI**



AI is a foundational part of modern software engineering at StarCompliance.



We expect Engineering Team Leads to:



* Embed AI\-assisted and agentic development into everyday engineering workflows.
* Enable appropriate engineering tasks to be safely delegated to AI agents.
* Ensure AI\-generated changes are tested, validated, secure, and auditable.
* Use AI to improve delivery speed, quality, automation, and engineering capacity.
* Continuously adopt new AI capabilities where they provide measurable value.
AI\-generated output remains engineering output, and teams remain accountable for everything they deliver.



### **Responsibilities**



Engineering Leadership \& People Development



* Own the technical direction of systems and services within the team's domain.
* Lead design decisions and ensure alignment with StarCompliance architecture and engineering standards.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge designs and resolve complex problems.
* Drive modernisation, simplification, and reduction of technical debt.
* Ensure scalability, security, resilience, performance, and maintainability are built in.

  


Technical Leadership



* Own the technical direction of systems and services within the team's domain.
* Lead design decisions and ensure alignment with StarCompliance architecture standards.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge designs and support complex problems.
* Drive modernisation, simplification, and reduction of technical debt.
* Ensure scalability, security, resilience, performance, and maintainability are built in.

  


AI\-First \& Agentic Engineering



* Lead adoption of AI\-assisted and agentic engineering practices.
* Structure work so engineers and agents can deliver effectively together.
* Increase the proportion of development activity that can be safely automated.
* Establish automated validation and guardrails for AI\-generated changes.
* Measure AI adoption through improvements in throughput, quality, and engineering capacity.

  


Delivery, Quality \& Operations



* Own end\-to\-end delivery and ongoing health of the team's products and services.
* Translate product priorities into clear and achievable engineering outcomes.
* Balance feature delivery with quality, resilience, security, and technical sustainability.
* Ensure software is tested, deployable, observable, supportable, and production\-ready.
* Drive automation across testing, CI/CD, deployment, and operational processes.
* Use engineering and production data to improve quality and delivery effectiveness.

  


Quality, CI/CD \& Operational Excellence



* Ensure engineers own the quality of the software they create.
* Embed appropriate automated testing and quality controls throughout the SDLC.
* Drive high levels of CI/CD automation and low\-risk, repeatable deployments.
* Ensure services provide effective telemetry, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
* Use production data and incidents to drive continuous engineering improvement.

  


Platform \& Collaboration



* Build solutions using modern Azure, cloud\-native, and reusable platform capabilities.
* Partner with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and Product.
* Work across team boundaries to resolve dependencies and systemic engineering issues.
* Communicate delivery, technical risks, and trade\-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Contribute to engineering\-wide standards, forums, and improvement initiatives.
### **Skills and Experience**

* Significant software engineering experience, including technical and people leadership.
* Strong experience with C\# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core.
* Strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, and modern integration patterns.
* Strong experience with microservices, containers, and distributed systems.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with event\-driven architecture and asynchronous messaging.

Coodes LLP has been named one of the UK’s leading law firms in the 2026 Chambers and Partners Guide, the Chambers High Net Worth Guide, and Legal 500, with top rankings across multiple departments.


We’re proud of our Investors in People Silver accreditation, recognising our commitment to supporting long\-term, rewarding careers. Whether you're just starting out or looking to take the next step, we will help you thrive.


Our values, professionalism, integrity, teamwork, fairness, enterprise, and excellence, are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where everyone’s contribution is valued.


While our history is long, our mindset is modern. We’re known as one of the most progressive firms in the region, with a strong reputation for innovation and excellence in client service.


At Coodes, you will work alongside some of the region’s most respected legal professionals, delivering outstanding service to clients across the South West. Whether your passion lies in private client work, commercial law, litigation, or support services, you’ll find a home here.


Ready to take the next step in your legal career? Join a firm where tradition meets innovation and where people come first.


Due to continued growth and an increasing demand for our services, an exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Senior Secretary to join our highly regarded Family Law Department.


This role offers the chance to become a key member of a well\-established and supportive team, providing high\-quality secretarial and administrative support to our Family Law solicitors while helping to deliver an exceptional client experience.


As a Senior Secretary, you will play a vital role in ensuring the efficient day\-to\-day operation of the Family Law Department. You will provide comprehensive secretarial support, manage competing priorities, and act as a trusted point of contact for clients and colleagues.


Working closely with fee earners, you will contribute to the smooth progression of matters while maintaining the high standards of service for which Coodes is known.


**What You Will Do**


* Provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to Family Law solicitors and fee earners.
* Prepare and manage legal documents, correspondence, court bundles and client files.
* Coordinate diaries, meetings and appointments, acting as a key point of contact for clients and third parties.
* Support the efficient running of the department through file management, billing and general administration.


**Experience and Qualifications You Need**


* Previous secretarial experience, ideally within a legal or professional services environment.
* Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office and document management systems.
* Professional communication skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.


**You Will Love This Role If**


* You enjoy working in a busy, professional and client\-focused environment.
* You take pride in delivering high\-quality work and exceptional support.
* You thrive as part of a collaborative and supportive team.

* You can manage multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* You demonstrate initiative, reliability and a positive team\-focused approach.


The role offers exceptional opportunities for personal development and advancement within a well\-established team.


Our Family Law department is one of the largest in the county and offers a full range of family law services, including divorce, financial proceedings, domestic violence and injunctions, and children matters in both private and public law.


**Additional Benefits Include**

* Annual bonus scheme
* Medical cash plan

jobs.title: Communications & Marketing Director (Volunteer)
jobs.description:
**Here at Youth4Youth**, we have built a strong, tight\-knit community of individuals passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute significantly to the impact we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department they work in or the time they are able to commit.

**Our services** primarily offer a peer\-support network to young people across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor of a similar age who they feel more comfortable speaking with.


If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse but like\-minded individuals, collaborating to increase the Charity's reach and improve the support available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are **remote workers,** but that doesn't stop us from keeping in touch and maintaining a strong, positive culture amongst our whole team.


**About the role**


Lead Y4Y’s strategic communications and digital presence during a transformational growth phase. Following our 15th Anniversary and the launch of our digital Chat Portal, this role owns our brand narrative, drives user engagement for our out\-of\-hours safety net, and amplifies our commercial and advocacy initiatives.

 **Responsibilities**

* **Key Responsibilities**


	+ Strategic Brand Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated comms strategy promoting Y4Y’s digital mentoring, commercial ventures (Y4Y UniHub, Everyone Feels), and the Changemaker Programme.
	+ Campaign \& Content Management: Drive high\-converting digital marketing campaigns across web, social, and email channels to reach both young people in need and key corporate/funder audiences.
	+ PR \& Media Engagement: Collaborate with our Board Trustee (PR/Crisis Lead) to secure national and local media coverage, positioning Y4Y as a thought leader in early\-intervention mental health.
	+ Data\-Driven Insights: Monitor engagement analytics across digital touchpoints to optimise messaging, grow our subscriber base, and support fundraising efforts.

**Skills**

* Proven track record in marketing strategy, digital communications, or PR (agency or in\-house).
* Strong understanding of digital tools, social platforms, and brand storytelling.
* Ability to craft persuasive, impact\-driven messaging that avoids "begging bowl" tone.


Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you are only a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

**Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth**


We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in\-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

* Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions
* Becoming a member of a strong network of like\-minded individuals, spread across the UK, with whom you can connect and collaborate both within and outside of the Charity
* Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non\-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers
* Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

**The hiring process**


Our hiring process typically has two stages

* Video or Written Application (when applicable)
* Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator or CEO.

*Some roles may have extra stages, but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.*


Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Pensions \& Insurance Administrator

**Location:** Port of Grangemouth

**Hours:** 22\.5hrs per week, worked across five days. The final working pattern will be agreed with the successful candidate to meet business and operational requirements.

**Compensation:** £17,357 (£27,000 FTE)

  

At Forth Ports, we keep trade, logistics, and infrastructure moving. Every day, our teams support the flow of goods, materials, and services that businesses and communities rely on, helping to power economic growth across the UK and beyond. Our people are at the core of everything we do, and their expertise, commitment, and innovation drive our success.


With our commitment to reach carbon neutrality by 2032 and Net Zero by 2042, we're investing heavily in sustainable and digital technologies, including major growth in offshore wind and greener port operations. For you, this means joining a business that's evolving, ambitious, and making a real difference.

**About The Role**


Reporting to the Head of Risk \& Pensions, the Pensions \& Insurance Administrator plays an important role in supporting the effective administration of the Group's pension schemes and insurance arrangements. The role is responsible for delivering a professional, accurate and confidential service to employees, pension scheme members and external stakeholders, ensuring that day to day activities are completed efficiently and in line with regulatory requirements.


Working closely with internal departments and external providers, the successful candidate will support member communications, maintain accurate records, coordinate insurance administration activities and contribute to ongoing process improvements and departmental projects.

 **Key responsibilities:**

* Provide ongoing and effective administration of the Forth Ports DC Plan, ensuring all processes are completed accurately and within required timeframes
* Respond to pension scheme member queries in a professional and confidential manner, providing clear information and signposting to the appropriate provider or adviser where required
* Act as the primary point of contact with third\-party DB administrators, to ensure accurate and timely information flow for members of the Forth Ports Group Pension Scheme
* Maintain accurate pensions and insurance records, ensuring data is kept up to date, securely stored and handled in line with data protection requirements
* Handle day\-to\-day insurance matters, including regular vehicle updates, audits and Employer’s Liability claims as they arise
* Support ad hoc projects, such as Group Life renewals and annual data uploads as well as contributing to process improvements within the department
* Maintain and update procedure notes, process documents and standard communications to support consistent pensions and insurance administration

 **What we're looking for:**


We're looking for an organised and detail\-oriented administrator with experience in pensions, insurance or a similar regulated environment. You'll be comfortable managing a varied workload, handling confidential information with discretion and building positive relationships with colleagues, scheme members and external providers.


This is a part\-time opportunity and would suit someone looking for flexibility while remaining actively involved in a professional and rewarding role. We're looking for someone who can work their hours across the week to provide consistent support to the department and its stakeholders.

 **Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated pensions and insurance administration experience, ideally with a relevant recognised professional qualification
* Excellent numeracy and IT skills, including proficient Excel skills and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workloads effectively, both independently and as part of a team, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
* High level of accuracy in record keeping, data entry and compliance with regulatory requirements
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with colleagues, trustees, external providers and scheme members
* Full Driving Licence, valid in the UK
* Full UK Working Rights

 **What Forth Ports can offer you**


At Forth Ports, our people are our priority, and we are committed to creating a flexible, open, and supportive working culture. As part of our team, you will enjoy

* A competitive salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Generous annual leave entitlement
* Defined contribution pension scheme with up to 16\.5% joint contribution plus life assurance at 4x salary
* In‑house Occupational Health — Provides professional workplace health advice, support, and guidance for employees across all sites
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — Delivered through *Health Assured*, offering 24/7, 365‑day confidential wellbeing support via the Wisdom app or telephone access, covering mental health, financial advice, legal guidance, and emotional wellbeing
* Physiotherapy Support — Access to physiotherapy sessions through three external providers in Scotland, plus an onsite physiotherapist once per week in Tilbury
* An annual Christmas thank you gift of a complimentary turkey or meat\-free alternative for all employees
* GymFlex health club memberships offering discounted access to gyms including Nuffield Health, PureGym, Anytime Fitness, The Gym Group, and selected local gyms
* Cycle to Work scheme to support affordable, sustainable commuting
* On\-site free parking available for all employees
* Attractive family\-friendly policies, including enhanced maternity cover
* Employee discount platform providing savings on UK\-wide restaurants, retail, car rentals, days out, and holidays

  

We value diversity and inclusivity, and we are an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.


As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant, we are committed to ensuring that members of the Armed Forces community are treated fairly and are not disadvantaged in their civilian careers because of their service.


We welcome applications from veterans, reservists, cadet force adult volunteers, and military spouses/partners, and we actively support flexible and inclusive recruitment practices.

 **How to Apply:**


Please submit your CV and a cover letter when submitting your application via the ‘Apply Now’ link.

**Required Criteria**

* Demonstrated pensions and insurance administration experience, ideally with a relevant recognised professional qualification
* Excellent numeracy and IT skills, including proficient Excel skills and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Full Driving Licence, valid in the UK
Full UK Working Rights

**About The Company**


Over our 50 years of experience we have witnessed our ports grow to become important assets to support and deliver growth both for the UK and local economies.


The growth impact has been achieved due to the continued investments in our infrastructure, making sure that our ports are able to continually develop their services and support the growth of many industries.


Our people have played a significant role. They have delivered the highest quality of service through their expertise, loyalty and flexibility and, without them, we could not have built the strong reputation and the long term agreements with many customers that we have today.

**Company Culture**


Welcome to Forth Ports Careers. As a leading port operator, we employ over 1,100 people across our ports in Scotland and the Port of Tilbury in London.


A career in a port business is very rewarding. There is real variety within each role and significant opportunities for promotion and career development. Don’t just take our word for it; view the “Some of our People” section and the video below to gain insight into the kinds of jobs our employees do, how they’ve grown with us, and what motivates them each day.

jobs.description:
**.buttontext6d0b46980d8b0627 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext6d0b46980d8b0627 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#16726d !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

Disability Practitioner
  
**Requisition ID:** 29724
  
  

**Location:**  

Newcastle, GB
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
**Contract Type:** Fixed Term
  
**Working Pattern:** Full Time

**.buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#16726d !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

**Salary:** £36,636 to £38,784 with progression to £46,049 per annum
  
  

Newcastle University is a great place to work, with excellent benefits. We have a generous holiday package; plus the opportunity to buy more, great pension schemes and a number of health and wellbeing initiatives to support you.
  
  

**Closing Date:** 25 September 2026
  
  

The Role
  
  

University Health and Wellbeing is seeking to appoint an exceptional candidate to the post of Disability Practitioner, in a fixed\-term post to cover a period of maternity leave.
  
  

This is an exciting opportunity for a dynamic individual to join the Disability team. This role provides specialist professional advice and guidance to students, applicants and colleagues and to work creatively to remove barriers for disabled students, to raise awareness and promote a positive, respectful and inclusive culture to enable access, progress and retention for disabled students.
  
  

University Health and Wellbeing provide information, advice and guidance on a wide range of support issues, to enable students to maximise their potential whilst at University. The service is free, confidential and available to all students.
  
  

The role is campus\-based. There is opportunity for flexible hybrid working dependent on service need. The fixed working hours are Monday to Friday, 9am\-5pm.
  
  

We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Confident employer which means that we offer an interview to any applicant applying under the scheme that meets the essential criteria for a role.
  
  

Interviews to be held in October 2026\.
  
  

If, having read the job description and person specification, you require information that is not covered, please contact Sandy Alden by email sandy.alden@ncl.ac.uk. You can also find further information about the Student Wellbeing Service online.
  
  

To apply, please complete the 3 mandatory questions attached to this vacancy along with a copy of your CV and cover letter evidencing how your skills and experience align to the person specification as outlined in job description.
  
  

Successful candidates will require satisfactory disclosure from the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS). People Services colleagues will support you with this during onboarding.
  
  

Key Accountabilities
  
  

To act as a central point of contact for future and current disabled students, including long\-term mental health conditions.
  
To provide advice and information to students and key stake holders, on the provision of support services and facilities within and external to the University.
  
Manage a varied, complex and sensitive caseload of future and current disabled students, including those with long\-term mental health conditions, who want to access disability support, often working with them over a long period of time.
  
Identify and respond to risk, and to refer appropriately to internal and or external services.
  
Apply knowledge and understanding of the additional mental health vulnerabilities of those from minority or marginalised backgrounds and the experience and action needed to support them effectively.
  
With equal efficacy offer a blend of individual present\-in\-person and digital meetings to identify relevant support and adjustments options, facilitate any ensuing communication with academic schools and other key stakeholders to resolve barriers to reasonable adjustment and support needs.
  
Provide advice, guidance and information, including advice on Disabled Students Allowances.
  
Undertake assessments of student needs and deliver one to one or small group interventions to help students develop effective strategies that support healthy behaviours, and positive engagement with study.
  
Proactively liaise with colleagues within the Examinations Office to implement additional examination arrangements for disabled students.
  
When directed plan, coordinate and participate in staff development activities.
  
To facilitate improvements in provision for disabled students, by holding a knowledge lead responsibility, in a wide range of settings by keeping abreast of issues affecting disabled students and participation within a variety of working groups.
  
To complete and maintain record keeping in a timely fashion, adhering to the Service policy and data protection requirements.
  
Contribute to the evaluation of the impact of support provided to students.
  
As identified by and with support of line manager undertake regular personal training and continuing professional development in order to remain updated with the knowledge of legislation and relevant research in disability related issues.
  
To keep abreast of internal and external developments that may impact upon support for disabled students. This includes, but is not exclusive to, government strategy, and sector best practice initiatives.
  
Adhere to and comply with the provisions of the Data Protection Laws along with the University’s Data Protection Policies.
  
To act as a consultant, and at times trainer, to university staff to provide support as they work with disabled students and students with long\-term mental health conditions and vulnerabilities.
  
To liaise with both external bodies and internal colleagues to assist in providing adequate support for disabled students, including long\-term mental health conditions and vulnerabilities. Refer and track referrals to other agencies as appropriate, to ensure students do not “slip through the net”.
  
To participate in promotion of the Student Health and Wellbeing activity, open days, receptions, Welcome Week which, from time to time, may require working out\-of\-hours i.e. evenings and weekends (only very occasional).
  
  

The Person (Essential)
  
  

Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
  

Knowledge of and familiarity with the application of relevant legislation and the implications of this in an HE setting.
  
Understanding of the effects of a range of mental health difficulties, and disabilities on individuals, family, friends, staff and potential impact on student University experience.
  
Experience and/or training in the application of cross\-cultural mental health support.
  
Capacity to deal with a highly sensitive caseload and work collaboratively with others to create effective performance within a team.
  
Be able to evidence knowledge of the principles of inclusivity, diversity and equal opportunities.
  
Ability to interpret and apply knowledge of policies and procedures.
  
Evidenced based advice and guidance skills.
  
A highly flexible working style.
  
Strong attention to detail.
  
Excellent communications skills.
  
Ability to exercise initiative and judgement in the appropriate management of student support and the ability to work independently.
  
**Highly competent IT skills:** Word, Excel, Email, Internet, Databases.
  
Ability to manage time and resources effectively by prioritising and organising a high volume, complex and varied workload.
  
Management of own caseload.
  
Experience of working with groups.
  
Presentation and/or training skills and experience, delivering to a diverse audience.
  
  

Attributes and Behaviour
  
  

Takes the initiative to ensure future success of the University and area by presenting new ideas and approaches.
  
Accepts the reality and requirements of change as part of achieving organisational goals.
  
Is supportive of others during change.
  
Anticipates change and prepares for it. Accepts change and ‘runs’ with it.
  
Establishes effective management control systems.
  
Effective at organising and managing complex workload.
  
Uses own and others’ time effectively.
  
Plans workload and tasks in a systematic way.
  
Sets own priorities in conjunction with University, team and area objectives.
  
Considers large amounts of complex information quickly and identifies key issues.
  
Recognises urgency and takes decisive action when required.
  
Confidently deals with a broad range of information.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

A recognised degree or equivalent qualification and/or experience.
  
A relevant professional Qualification such as Advice and Guidance, Registered Nurse Mental Health/ Social Worker/ Occupational Therapist, or Autism practice etc.
  
  

Newcastle University is a global University where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. As a University of Sanctuary, we aim to provide a welcoming place of safety for all, offering opportunities to people fleeing violence and persecution.
  
  

We are committed to being a fully inclusive university which actively recruits, supports and retains colleagues from all sectors of society. We value diversity as well as celebrate, support and thrive on the contributions of all of our employees and the communities they represent. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams, we believe that success is built on having teams whose backgrounds and experiences reflect the diversity of our university and student population.
  
  

At Newcastle University we hold a Gold Athena Swan award in recognition of our good employment practices for the advancement of gender equality. We also hold a Race Equality Charter Bronze award in recognition of our work towards tackling race inequality in higher education REC. We are a Disability Confident employer and will offer an interview to disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role as part of the offer and interview scheme.
  
  

In addition, we are a member of the Euraxess initiative supporting researchers in Europe.

jobs.title: Private Client Compliance - Client Delivery and Technology - SM
jobs.description:
**About the role:**

Our Tax Compliance team delivers technology\-enabled compliance services to a prestigious client base. We combine technical excellence with automation and innovation, working across the UK and with overseas delivery centres to provide an outstanding client experience.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager for a hybrid role combining private client portfolio leadership with technology\-enabled process improvement. Approximately 50% of the role will focus on managing high\-net\-worth individuals, trusts and partnerships, with responsibility for high\-quality, commercially effective and well\-controlled delivery.


The remaining 50% will connect PCC’s operational needs with the wider Compliance Services Technology and AI teams. Using your understanding of private client compliance to simplify, standardise and automate delivery, and translate business challenges into practical, scalable solutions.

**What your days will look like:**

* Lead a portfolio of high\-net\-worth individuals, trusts and partnerships, building trusted relationships and anticipating client needs.
* Own end\-to\-end compliance delivery, including complex reviews, timetables, budgets, billing, quality and risk.
* Analyse PCC processes, controls and hand\-offs to identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation, automation and AI.
* Translate business challenges into clear requirements, process maps, user stories, success measures and scalable solutions.
* Partner with Technology and the Compliance Services AI Programme to design, test and progress governed solutions.
* Coach colleagues and build team capability across technical delivery, technology adoption and continuous improvement.
**This role is for you if:**

* Strong private client tax expertise and experience managing comparable portfolios; CTA, ACA or equivalent qualification.
* Proven ownership of end\-to\-end delivery across deadlines, budgets, quality and risk requirements.
* Excellent client service, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships.
* Ability to analyse processes, resolve ambiguity and translate business needs into practical improvements.
* Confidence using technology to solve problems, with knowledge of automation, AI, workflow or low\-code tools.
* Commercial judgement, attention to detail and experience coaching colleagues and supporting continuous improvement.
* Ability to rapidly assimilate the existing PCC operating model and effectively support the business in transitioning to new target models driven by technology changes.
**What you'll receive from us:**


 No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.


We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

jobs.title: Principal Ecologist
jobs.description:
**Principal Ecologist**

**Location: Flexible / UK\-wide**

**Salary: Competitive**

**Contract Type: Permanent**

**Working Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday\-Friday**

### **Lead****projects.****Develop****people.****Shape****the****future****of****a****growing****ecology****team.**


You're an experienced ecologist who enjoys helping others succeed just as much as delivering great projects. You combine technical expertise with strong leadership skills, creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged and empowered to do their best work.


At Ground Control, you'll play a key role in the growth of our Ecology Team. Alongside leading complex ecological projects and providing expert technical advice, you'll help develop the next generation of ecologists through coaching, mentoring and day\-to\-day leadership. This is an opportunity to influence project delivery, strengthen client relationships and play a significant role in building a high\-performing ecology function.


Success in this role isn't just measured by project delivery. It's also reflected in the strength, capability and development of the people around you.

##### **What you'll do:**


In this role, you'll provide technical, commercial and people leadership across a diverse portfolio of ecological projects.

* Lead the delivery of complex ecological projects and multidisciplinary programmes, ensuring high\-quality outcomes for clients while maintaining exceptional technical standards.
* Provide expert ecological advice on legislation, planning policy, Biodiversity Net Gain, protected species and habitat management, helping clients navigate complex environmental challenges.
* Review, approve and sign off technical reports and ecological assessments, ensuring consistency, quality and compliance across all project outputs.
* Manage project portfolios from inception through to completion, overseeing budgets, forecasting, resources and risk to achieve successful commercial and operational outcomes.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, regulators and key stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor and identifying opportunities to grow services.
* Lead major tenders, framework submissions and fee proposals, supporting the continued growth and success of the ecology team.
* Lead, mentor and develop Ecologists and Assistant Ecologists, creating a supportive environment where people can build confidence, capability and technical expertise.
* Provide coaching, technical guidance and constructive feedback, helping team members progress their careers while maintaining high standards across project delivery.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and succession planning initiatives, helping attract and retain talented ecologists as the team continues to grow.
* Foster a collaborative and high\-performing culture where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and professional development are part of everyday work.
* Drive continuous improvement by developing best\-practice guidance, improving technical standards and championing innovation across the wider ecology function.

##### **What you'll get:**

* The opportunity to lead complex and nationally significant ecology projects across a range of sectors and habitats.
* A highly influential role where your expertise helps shape project delivery, team development and business growth.
* The autonomy to make decisions, drive improvements and help build a growing ecology service.
* The opportunity to shape and grow a developing ecology team while making a lasting impact on people, projects and business performance.
* A leadership role where you'll influence both technical delivery and the professional development of others.
* Exposure to senior stakeholders, strategic projects and multidisciplinary environmental programmes.
* Opportunities to further develop your technical specialisms, leadership capability and commercial expertise.
* A collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, professional development and innovation are encouraged.

##### **What we're looking for:**

* A degree or higher qualification in Ecology, Environmental Science or a related discipline.
* Full Membership of CIEEM (MCIEEM).
* Significant ecological consultancy experience at Senior Ecologist level or above, typically five years or more.
* One or more protected species licences, with demonstrable experience leading and overseeing licensed survey programmes.
* Extensive knowledge of UK wildlife legislation, planning policy and ecological best practice.
* Proven experience managing complex ecological projects, multidisciplinary teams and competing priorities.
* Strong commercial awareness, including experience managing budgets, forecasting, fee proposals and project profitability.
* Demonstrable experience leading, mentoring and developing ecologists, with a genuine passion for helping others succeed.
* The ability to inspire confidence, build capability and create a positive team culture where people can perform at their best.
* Excellent technical reporting, quality assurance and decision\-making capabilities.
* Strong client relationship management and business development skills, with the ability to build long\-term partnerships.
* Experience with Biodiversity Net Gain, habitat restoration, infrastructure projects, framework contracts or protected species licensing would be highly advantageous.
* A full UK driving licence.


Join Ground Control and help shape the future of ecological consultancy by delivering technical excellence, developing great people and creating lasting environmental value for clients, communities and nature.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary – aligned with your skills and experience
* Performance‑linked bonus: Bonus opportunities aligned to your level and contribution.
* Pension scheme – helping you plan for the future
* Recognition schemes – celebrating and rewarding great work
* Private GP service – fast, convenient access to medical support
* Life insurance – providing added peace of mind
* Subsidised gym membership – supporting your health and wellbeing
* Holiday buy scheme – purchase up to 5 additional days of annual leave

**\#INDHP**

**Equal Opportunities Statement**


At Ground Control, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.


We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic as defined in the Equality Act 2010\.


We actively support and promote an inclusive culture, ensuring fair and equitable treatment throughout the recruitment process and across all stages of employment, including training, development, promotion, pay, and termination. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for disabled applicants and employees, and to creating a working environment free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, or victimisation.


We expect all colleagues to uphold our values of dignity, respect, and inclusion. We take a zero\-tolerance approach to any form of discriminatory behaviour and are committed to continuous improvement through training, inclusive policies, and accountability at all levels. \#Maint

jobs.title: Fundraising & Partnership Director (Volunteer)
jobs.description:
**Here at Youth4Youth**, we have grown a strong, tight\-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. **Our services** primarily offer a peer\-support network to young people across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor of a similar age who they feel more comfortable speaking with.


If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse but like\-minded individuals, collaborating to increase the Charity's reach and improve the support available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are **remote workers,** but that doesn't stop us from keeping in touch and maintaining a strong, positive culture amongst our whole team.


**About the role**


Drive sustainable, unrestricted, and bid\-based income generation to secure the charity's long\-term future. This strategic role focuses on high\-value corporate partnerships, institutional trusts, and engagement with high\-net\-worth individuals \& networks to scale our digital mental health services nationwide.

 **Responsibilities**

* Strategic Income Generation: Build and execute a diversified income strategy aligned with our 2025–2028 roadmap (targeting trust funds, statutory grants, and corporate sponsors).
* Corporate \& Network Partnerships: Engage mid\-market and SME corporate partners by framing Y4Y as an efficient, low\-cost solution to systemic issues (e.g., NHS waiting lists, youth unemployment).
* High\-Net\-Worth Stewardship: Work alongside our Board of Trustees to leverage high\-net\-worth networks and secure patrons and major donors.
* Bid Writing \& Alignment: Oversee major funding applications, ensuring proposals align with core funder themes (trauma\-informed care, early intervention, digital inclusion, youth employment).

**Skills**

* Background in business development, fundraising, or corporate partnership management.
* Strong commercial acumen with persuasive proposal writing and pitch skills.
* Network\-builder with a strategic approach to partnership growth.


Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you are only a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

**Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth**


We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in\-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

* Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions
* Becoming a member of a strong network of like\-minded individuals, spread across the UK, with whom you can connect and collaborate both within and outside of the Charity
* Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non\-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers
* Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

**The hiring process**


Our hiring process typically has two stages

* Video or Written Application (when applicable)
* Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

*Some roles may have extra stages, but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.*


Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

jobs.title: Mobile Technical Operative - Electrical
jobs.description:
**Mobile Technical Operative \- Electrical**
--------------------------------------------


Offer ID: 90408
Job: Technicians / Electricity
Contract type: Permanent
Schedule: Full\-Time
Country: United Kingdom
**EQUANS are looking for a Mobile Technical Operative (Electrical) to work on our HMCTS contract across Redditch Magistrates and Worcester Combined Courts. This role would be a permanent full\-time role working 40 hours per week. On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package.**

  

**General Overview:**


Equans provide technical and soft services to our client HMCTS across a large portfolio of buildings across the UK. As part of the service, we provide low voltage electrical maintenance and installation services, and because of business growth, we are recruiting for additional roles to provide these services for our customer.

  

**Main Duties and Responsibilities:**


The primary purpose of the role is to carry out both planned and reactive maintenance on a wide variety of Fabric and limited Engineering Assets, ensuring all activities are completed in a safe and timely manner and in accordance with the contracted output specifications and Equans processes and procedures. Activities will include:


* Ensure that routine Planned Preventative Measures (PPM) is carried out to the electrical infrastructure and plant in accordance with Site task schedules and CAFM.


* Ensure that reactive tasks throughout the sites are completed and be proactive in highlighting areas where improvements can be made.


* Ensure that plant faults and defects are always swiftly remedied to maintain plant in serviceable order.


* Ensure that suitable spares are available to carry out both maintenance and reactive works.


* To provide parts lists and estimated timescales to carry out remedial works.


* Ensure that all relevant paperwork/CAFM is completed regarding PPM, reactive and breakdown works and that it is passed without delay to the contract administrator.


* Ensure that Method Statements and Risk Assessments are always prepared and used for all tasks undertaken to ensure safe working practices.


* To develop a good working relationship with all members of Equans staff, subcontractors and the client representatives.


* Ensure the provision of a Safe and Healthy working environment. To include the wearing of uniform and PPE at all times.


* Ensure up to date plant logs are kept at all times.


* Supervising and monitoring of sub\-contractors works whilst they are on site undertaking maintenance.


* Ensure an awareness and compliance to the contractual KPI's/SLA's.


* Ensure CAFM system, e.g. TotalMobile, is kept up to date and that PPM and reactive tickets are closed out with accurate data captured.


* To operate a Permit to Work System in accordance with Equans’ Technical and SHEQ processes and client requirements (or approved client system).


* To carry out any other task as directed by the account management team.


* Participate in the 24/7 maintenance cover (including on call rota) of the Building Engineering Services during normal and emergency activities, assisting in the preparation of emergency and contingency plans. Participate in emergency plans and provide written reports as required.


* The position will require you to provide engineering support in emergency situations to ensure business and operational continuity.


* To gain Technical Appointments as required e.g. LVCP/LVAP/HVAP and to issue PTW to Subcontractors and Equans staff


* Ensure both self\-delivered and subcontracted maintenance, testing and inspection activities are in compliance with the latest version of BS7671, ensuring that all remedials are carried out

  

**Client / Customer**


* Respond in a timely manner to verbal and written requests


* Coordinate quotations with the contract manager


* Production of information for quotations

  

**Helpdesk \- PPM**


* Support the Helpdesk as required when reporting or updating planned and reactive maintenance


* Be available for out of hours call\-out support for the contract

  

**Compliance**


* To gain Technical Appointments as required e.g. LVCP/LVAP/HVAP and to issue PTW to Subcontractors and Equan staff


* Ensure both self\-delivered and subcontracted maintenance, testing and inspection activities are in compliance with the latest version of BS7671, ensuring that all remedials are carried out


* Produce Condition / Dilapidation Reports as required


* Ensure supervisor is informed immediately if dangerous circumstances occur

  

**SHEQ**


* Comply with requests for information from SHEQ manager


* Ensure you work to company health and safety policy


* Ensue PPE is safe to use


* Report accident and near misses in a timely manner


* Ensure your test equipment is within calibration


* Ensure you follow Method Statements \& Risk Assessments for all work

  

**Impact:**


Working to high standard of Building Maintenance, we require a fully reliable and competent Electrician who can work on own initiative, within a team or oversee subcontractor’s, producing high quality reports on their findings and work. The role will involve being the face of Equans so smart appearance and being able to discuss findings with others including customers is required.

  

**Complexity:**


The successful candidate will have the ability to fault find and diagnose and rectify complex Electrical faults and issues unaided. Have an excellent knowledge of Electrical systems, which will enable the development of switching schedules and Safety Documentation prior to shutdowns. To plan and oversee electrical shutdowns to permit maintenance or testing.

  

**Qualifications or Required Experience:**


Suitable experience working in a similar high demanding role.

  

**Essential:**


* Hold relevant Electrical Qualification including; NVQ level 3 in Electrical or equivalent such as City \& Guilds Technical Certificate in Electrical.


* 18th Edition IET Wiring regulations


* Hold and maintain valid Clean UK Driving License


* Post holders must be able to pass and maintain BPSS


* Counter Terrorism Check CTC (applicable for specific sites at: Westminster Magistrates; Woolwich Crown; Royal Courts of Justice; Snaresbrook Crown; and The ‘Rolls’ Building)

  

**Desired but not essential:**


* IPAF


* PLASMA

  

**What can we offer you?**


On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;


* 24 days annual leave


* Life Cover equivalent to 1\.5 times annual salary


* Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers


* Gym membership discounts


* Cycle to work scheme


* Holiday purchase scheme


* 2 corporate social responsibility days per year


* Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes


* Attractive Employee Referral Rewards Scheme


* Access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in EQUANS), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Persons Network) and our Disability Network


* 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

  

**Who are we?**


EQUANS is a world leader in energy services with nearly 100,000 employees working in more than 50 countries, with an annual turnover of over 17 billion euros.


In the UK \& Ireland, EQUANS is a provider of technical, FM, regeneration and energy services – with specialist capabilities in smart buildings, green mobility, district \& embedded energy and decentralised renewables.


EQUANS’ 13,500 UK \& Ireland employees combine these activities to help businesses, public sector organisations and government to embrace the energy transition towards net zero, and also the digital \& industrial transitions that are redesigning the way we move, work and live.


EQUANS is a Bouygues group company.


ENGENG

  

**What's next?**


If this role is of interest to you, please click below to register, apply, and track your progress! A member of our Resourcing Team will review your application and be in touch.


At Equans we’re committed to delivering a culture where everyone’s voice is heard and supported. We know the value a diverse workforce creates, delivering better results for our people, customers, and stakeholders. Diversity and inclusion is at the core of what we do, should you join Equans you’ll find a welcoming and open workplace where you’re supported and encouraged to be your true self at work. You’ll also have access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in Equans), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Professionals Network) and our Disability Network.


For this role, you must have evidence of the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer a re\-location package with this job role. Certain roles may require applicants to undergo a Disclosure check, as noted in the role requirements.


The EQUANS Resourcing Team supports this job advert. Agency involvement is not required. All related enquiries must come to the resourcing team not direct to EQUANS Managers
