jobs.title: Teaching Assistant G5
jobs.description:
**Corfe Hills School** is looking for a Teaching Assistant G5 to join our fantastic team. Could this be you?


Actual Salary £14,131 \- £14,355 per annum per annum (Grade 5\)


This job isfor 23 hours per week and 39 weeks per year.


It is offered on a Permanent basis


Approximate start date November 2026


The postholder will play an important role in supervising the activities of pupils during the teaching period and midday session break within the school, including both indoor and outdoor areas, ensuring a safe environment is maintained at all times.


To assist the Headteacher/SENDCo to promote students’ academic, social and emotional development through the development and implementation of programmes of student work and support (individual and group) and in the provision of a stable, caring and supportive learning environment; to enable students to achieve their full learning potential.


There may be a Special Needs input to support students with activities. Support is both on a one to one basis and in groups, for students with disability, learning difficulties or behavioural problems.

**Key responsibilities:**


To support teaching and learning processes.


? To assist the SENDCo in developing, implementing and managing individual/group student learning strategies aimed at:


a. supporting progress


b. establishing and maintaining relationships with individual students/groups to support with learning activities


c. inclusivity of students with identified SEND needs.

**Essential knowledge and skills:**

* 5 GCSEs including English and Maths (minimum level 4 or equivalent experience/ vocational
* qualification)
* Previous experience of working in an educational setting
* Experience in dealing with challenging behaviour whilst remaining calm
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrate role model behaviour
* Fluency in English for all student and public\-facing roles, specifically to support students’ learning and wellbeing

**Working days/ patterns \-**We welcome flexible working as long as your availability falls within school hours, we are happy to discuss a schedule that works for you. Working patterns may be subject to change depending on business needs.


Please refer to the attached job description for more details about the role.


Interview date: Thursday 1st October or Friday 2nd October 2026

*Please Note: the actual salary shown is based on the number of hours and weeks worked and paid annual leave entitlement for an employee with under 5 years' service.*


If you have any further questions, please contact **Vicky Head** on **01202 112248** or by emailing **recruitment@corfehills.net**

**About our School**


Corfe Hills is an ambitious and high performing school where every student is known and supported to succeed. The school has been on a significant and ambitious improvement journey over the last four years as can be seen by our excellent outcomes. We are also delighted to share that following our recent Ofsted inspection in September 2021 we have been graded good in all categories.

*Living Here*


Corfe Hills School is in a fabulous location within easy reach of Bournemouth and its beaches, Poole and its harbour, the Jurassic Coast and the Dorset countryside.


The school serves the catchment area of Broadstone, Corfe Mullen and the wider area and we truly believe that all of our students are exceptional.

*Our Vision and Culture*


At Corfe Hills School we are passionate about excellence in learning. Our vision is underpinned by the Trust's values of Collaboration, Ambition and Respect.


We believe that this is the foundation which will enable our young people to achieve the highest possible outcomes during their time with us. We have the highest expectations of students – that they will engage fully in their learning, have high aspirations for themselves and embrace the wide range of opportunities available to them both inside and outside the classroom.


Our motto is “High Expectations – Exceptional Individuals” and we truly believe in the potential of every young person who joins the school. We also have an exceptionally committed staff, including talented teachers and a fabulous support staff who provide a range of functions including pastoral and administrative support to students.

*Teaching and Learning*


Teaching and Learning is at the heart of all that we do and our personalised professional development programme is centred around our Principles of Teaching that have been shaped by research from, among others, Barak Rosenshine, John Hattie and Doug Lemov. We also follow a lesson structure shaped around these principles that liberates and enables students to Learn to the Max every lesson. jobs.title: Head of Built Environment IPC
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptional and experienced Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) leader to join Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust as our Head of Built Environment IPC.
  
  

This is a rare 24\-month fixed\-term opportunity to lead one of the most complex and high\-profile built environment IPC portfolios in the NHS.
  
  

Working closely with the Director and Deputy Director of Infection Prevention and Control, you will provide strategic leadership and expert oversight across a broad portfolio including healthcare redevelopment programmes, capital projects, water safety, ventilation, decontamination, environmental risk management and estates\-related infection prevention assurance.
  
  

As a senior member of the IPC leadership team, you will influence decision\-making at site, divisional, executive and Board level, ensuring infection prevention principles are embedded within service transformation, healthcare infrastructure and operational planning.
  
  

We are looking for a registered healthcare professional with substantial senior\-level IPC experience, strong leadership skills and a proven ability to manage complex risks, influence stakeholders and deliver improvement across organisational boundaries.
  
  

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of built environment IPC within one of the UK's leading academic health science centres while contributing to innovation, education, research and service excellence.
  
  

You will provide strategic leadership for the Trust\-wide built environment infection prevention and control portfolio, ensuring effective governance, assurance and risk management across healthcare infrastructure, redevelopment, water safety, ventilation, decontamination and environmental IPC programmes.
  
  

Working closely with senior clinical, operational, estates and facilities colleagues, you will ensure infection prevention requirements are embedded throughout capital developments, refurbishment projects, service reconfigurations and operational activities.
  
  

You will provide authoritative specialist advice, undertake complex risk assessments, oversee assurance arrangements and support the identification, mitigation and escalation of significant infection prevention risks.
  
  

The role includes leading the development of strategy, policy and assurance frameworks; contributing specialist expertise to incident and outbreak management where environmental factors are relevant; and supporting organisational improvement through audit, education, research and innovation.
  
  

You will represent the IPC service at senior internal and external forums and contribute to executive and Board\-level reporting and assurance processes.
  
  

You will provide professional leadership to staff within your portfolio, build effective partnerships across organisational boundaries and drive continuous improvement in infection prevention practice.
  
  

At Imperial College Healthcare you can achieve extraordinary things with extraordinary people, working with leading clinicians pushing boundaries in patient care.
  
  

Become part of a vibrant team living our values \- expert, kind, collaborative and aspirational. You’ll get an experience like no other and will fast forward your career. Benefits include career development, flexible working and wellbeing, staff recognition scheme. Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and improving the working lives of our staff and will consider applications to work flexibly, part time or job share. Please talk to us at interview.
  
  

Environmental sustainability
  
Climate change and poor air quality is a health emergency that harms people’s health and wellbeing and widens health inequalities. The Trust is also committed to reducing its impact on the environment by reducing our greenhouse gas emissions to Net Zero by 2045\. All our employees have a role to play, and we have an active green network that supports staff to act in ways that ensures that our services are efficient, sustainable and reduce our impact on the environment www.imperial.nhs.uk/about\-us/our\-strategy/green\-plan .
  
  

The full job description provides an overview of the key tasks and responsibilities of the role and the person specification outlines the qualifications, skills, experience and knowledge required.
  
  

For both overviews, please view the Job Description attachment with the job advert.

jobs.title: Teacher of Computing - Ballakermeen High School
jobs.description:
**About the role**


We are seeking a dedicated**Teacher of Computing**to join the highly successful Computing Department at **Ballakermeen High School**.


Our Computing Department has an excellent track record of achievement. In 2025, students achieved 100% A to C grades at iGCSE and SQA qualifications, alongside 100% Distinction to Merit grades in A2 BTEC programmes. While we are proud of these outcomes, we remain committed to continuous improvement and delivering the highest standards of teaching and learning.


The department is well resourced and is made up of four teaching staff who work collaboratively to support student success. The ability to teach Computing at Key Stages 3 and 4 is essential. We are also looking for someone who is keen to develop their experience of teaching at Key Stage 5, with training and support provided. Experience of teaching BTEC IT and the ability to teach Computer Science at Key Stage 4 would be advantageous.


At Ballakermeen, we believe that every second of learning matters. We have high expectations of both students and staff, delivered within a warm, welcoming and supportive environment. Professional development is a priority, and all staff have access to a research\-informed Professional Development programme throughout the academic year.


Applications are welcomed from both Early Career Teachers (ECTs) and experienced teachers.

**Please note that all interviews will take place in person at Ballakermeen High School on the Isle of Man. Shortlisted candidates will be required to deliver a lesson as part of the selection process and will be given a tour of the school. As these activities cannot be conducted remotely, attendance in person is essential. Candidates must hold Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) and meet the other essential criteria outlined in the Person Specification.**

**A workplace that invests in you**

Newly qualified teachers will automatically start on a generous salary of £42,718 per annum (spine point M4\).


A competitive salary that increases each 12 months until you reach the salary maximum.


Subject to meeting eligibility criteria, you will be offered two pensions arrangements: the Teachers Superannuation scheme or the Isle of Man Government Defined Contribution (DC) arrangement.


If you are returning to the island and have participated in the Department’s Student Loan scheme for tuition fees, the loan will be repaid by the Department upon completion of your second year working as a teacher at one of the island’s schools. The repayment is subject to a maximum of £7,500 for a three\-year degree course or £10,000 for a four\-year degree course, and the requirements detailed in the Teacher Loan Cancellation Policy.


If you are an Early Career Teacher, you will receive payments of £2,000 at the beginning of your first and second school years in teaching, following the completion of the ECT induction period (2 years).


Financial support to get you, your family and your belongings, including one motor vehicle to the Isle of Man. We will pay 70% of any removal or storage costs incurred.


Help to pay your rent/mortgage while you settle in with a housing allowance up to £500 per month over 2 years.


If you are relocating to the Isle of Man, you will receive financial help towards the costs of visiting to the Island to view housing and to visit your new school. You are eligible to receive up to £325 each for you and your partner and, if applicable, £140 each for up to 2 dependent children.

For those returning to the island after graduating from university, you will receive a refund on your national insurance contributions during the first 12 months of your employment, up to £4,400\.


Access to the Isle of Man Public Service Cycle to Work scheme after your first year of employment.


Access to the Learning, Education and Development training facility, which is exclusively for Public Service employees, to keep on top of your continuous professional development.

Free access to the Isle of Man Government Staff Welfare Service which offers professional counselling, emotional support and signposting on a wide range of issues.

Discounted access to the NSC gym and island swimming pools as well as 1\-to\-1 support programmes and exercise classes with qualified instructors through the ACTIV8 scheme.

You may be eligible for a Blue Light Card, unlocking a wide range of exclusive discounts on shopping, food and leisure activities at hundreds of popular high street and online retailers.

Free on\-site car parking.


A relocation package based on receipts is available for this role.


**Making the Isle of Man your new home**


A hidden gem in the Irish Sea, the Isle of Man boasts an extensive coastline, stunning natural landscapes and unspoilt beaches. There are an abundance of opportunities and lots of places to discover!


You can visit our great cafes, bars and restaurants, and become part of the Island’s close\-knit community. The island is well connected to the UK with quick, direct flights and ferries to many destinations.


Want to find out more about Island life? Visit www.locate.im to find out why you should make your move to the Isle of Man!

**Working for the Isle of Man Public Service**


We are the largest employer on the island delivering a diverse range of services to the people of the Isle of Man. We care, nurture and value our employees’ wellbeing, development and career and place great importance on rewarding the commitment by our wonderful employees.


We support and promote flexible working, recognising the importance of working flexibly around your life and commitments and the benefits in improving work\-life balance. We are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements where possible and if interested you should discuss this with the Recruiting Manager.


The Isle of Man Public Service is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates equality, diversity and inclusion. We understand how a wide range of views and experiences can benefit us as we work together for the Isle of Man.


Your candidate experience is important to us. As a proud member of The Circle Back Initiative, we commit to respond to every applicant that applies for an Isle of Man Public Service role.


We are committed to net zero by 2050 and as an entire nation UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, we are transforming public services for a sustainable future and your contributions will directly benefit our community, economy, and environment.


**Things to note**


An enhanced with barring police check is required for this post, the cost of which will be covered by the Isle of Man Government.


**Ready to apply?**


We understand that you might have some questions about the role and the Recruiting Manager is on hand to support you. You can contact them at BHSrecruitment2@sch.im.


To get the best out of your application, read our article on the important essentials you need to know before applying.


Applications will be accepted up to midnight of the closing date specified. If you have difficulties applying online, please contact us on 01624 685000 or by email at helpmeapply@gov.im.

jobs.title: Security Engineer II, Traffic Quality, Traffic Quality
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Advertising at Amazon is a fast\-growing, multi\-billion dollar business that spans across desktop, mobile and connected devices; encompasses ads on Amazon and a vast network of hundreds of thousands of third party publishers; and extends worldwide. Traffic Quality, within Amazon Advertising, builds technology to detect invalid traffic (IVT) and ensure that Advertiser spend worldwide is directed towards human audiences and protected from ad fraud.  

  

As the Security engineering team within Traffic Quality, we research programmatic advertising risk landscapes to build an understanding of existing and emergent threats. We build specialized techniques to detect and mitigate these threats, contributing to a robust Traffic Quality platform that is a bedrock of advertiser trust and saves hundreds of millions of dollars in ad spend that would otherwise be lost to IVT. The Security Engineering team is responsible for: (a) Targeted threat hunting, including on the dark web, to consistently stay updated on modus operandi and risks associated with advertising fraud, (b) Building sophisticated mitigation techniques through reverse engineering known software, identifying network layer signatures, and conceiving client\-side scripting methods, and, (c) Collaborating with security teams across Amazon for sharing intelligence and devising durable detection techniques.  

  

As a Security Engineer in the team, you are passionate about unraveling ad fraud tactics utilizing a diversity of highly specialized skills in reverse\-engineering, deep packet inspection of network traffic, understanding of network security, operating systems and browser architectures. You accomplish your tasks by applying expert level knowledge to tools to understand not only what a particular piece of malware for perpetrating ad fraud can do but also how it does it. You work with internal security teams to identify and mitigate botnets, as well as leverage the ethical hacking community to obtain standard modus operandi, source code and tactics used by malware and botnets. The role requires influencing leaders across the company to improve our security bar and protect advertiser trust. A Security Engineer also works with other product and security teams to proactively identify problems and suggest approaches to solve them.  

  

Given the high level of ambiguity in the advertising fraud space, and the need to prepare for unknown unknowns, your creativity, judgement and bias for action will all be key ingredients towards delivering the right results for advertising customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language
* You have passion for reverse engineering, malware analysis, threat detection and risk hunting.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS products and services
* Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, WW Operations Sustainability Finance
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


WW Operations Finance is looking for a Financial Analyst to join the Carbon Planning \& Analysis team, supporting EU and Rest of World (ROW) regions. CP\&A is the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity (CI) data integrity, reporting, and planning across WW Ops' \~45MM tCO2 annual footprint, directly supporting the WW Ops S\-team carbon intensity goal and Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment of net zero by 2040\. This role will maintain and improve the data structures underpinning EU/ROW carbon reporting and planning, partner cross\-functionally and cross\-country with regional sustainability and BI teams, and deep\-dive data quality challenges as they arise. The role sits at the intersection of Sustainability, Finance, and Operations \- a rare combination that gives the analyst exposure to carbon science, financial planning rigor, and operational decarbonization levers all in one seat, and offers a strong foundation for building differentiated expertise early in their career. The analyst will operate with oversight and mentorship from a senior CP\&A team member, with growing autonomy over time as regional carbon data fluency builds.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support EU and ROW carbon month\-end close (MEC), ensuring carbon ledger (GCD) aligned data quality and timely resolution of carbonation and data quality issues.
* Maintain and continuously improve EU/ROW carbon reporting and planning data structures within data cluster and Carbon Reporting Deck.
* Partner cross\-functionally and cross\-country with EU and ROW regional sustainability, BI, and BU Finance teams to consolidate data requests, validate submissions, and resolve discrepancies.
* Support EU/ROW carbon planning cycles (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), ensuring carbon drivers (LMPP, 3P cost, WHT LoH, fleet electrification) are captured accurately and tie to the broader financial plan.
* Deep\-dive data quality and reporting challenges, identify root causes, and propose process or automation improvements.
* Contribute to CP\&A's transition toward an AI\-native reporting and planning model \- supporting GenAI\-powered variance commentary, automated data quality checks, and other tools that reduce manual reconciliation work.
* Assist in preparing variance commentary and metrics tables for leadership reporting (Kingpin, WWS reviews), under the guidance of a senior team member.
* Escalate data quality, timeline, or stakeholder risks promptly, partnering with the senior team member on resolution.
* Build subject\-matter expertise in carbon data systems and regional carbon drivers to grow scope over time.

  

A day in the life  

Your day starts with a check of data submission status and the latest carbon ledger (GCD) snapshot for EU and ROW, flagging any late, missing, or anomalous data before it becomes a downstream reporting issue. You'll join a call with an EU or ROW sustainability or BI counterpart to align on a carbon driver discrepancy or walk through a data request \- always leading with data lineage and methodology clarity, since regional teams often hold their own numbers. Back at your desk, you update Carbon Reporting Deck tabs for your regions, validate CI calculations, and dig into any variances that don't tie to plan. You sync with your senior team member to review findings, prioritize open items, and decide what needs escalation versus what you can resolve independently. Depending on the point in the month, your afternoon might involve supporting a planning cycle deliverable (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), pulling together inputs for a leadership review, or scoping a process improvement to reduce manual reconciliation work.  

  

About the team  

Carbon Planning \& Analysis sits within WW Operations Finance and was built from scratch in 2024 to bridge carbon science and financial planning across Amazon's largest and most complex emissions source. The team serves as the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity reporting, planning, and data integrity across NA, EU, and ROW \- covering 10\+ business units and over 45MM tCO2 of annual operations\-wide emissions. CP\&A owns the monthly carbon month\-end close, the Carbon Reporting Deck (WW Ops' single source of truth for CI), and multi\-year carbon planning (OP1/3YF, OP2\), directly informing decisions at the VP and S\-team level in support of the Climate Pledge's net zero by 2040 commitment. It's a small, high\-visibility team that combines rigorous financial modeling with deep carbon domain expertise, and is actively building out AI\-native automation for data quality checks and variance commentary. This role will report to a senior CP\&A team member and work alongside peers covering NA carbon planning and reporting.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field, or experience in relevant finance roles
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
* Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
* Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)

**About Us**
Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.


In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.


With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.


Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

 **Role overview:**


Planet is scaling AI\-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day\-to\-day reality.


We are looking for **Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers** to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands\-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.


You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work.


We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation.


You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands\-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet.

 **What You'll Do:**

* Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI\-first ways of working
* Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team\-friendly way
* Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly.
* Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation.
* Create high\-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role\-specific learning material that teams can actually use.
* Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled.
* Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI\-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software.
* Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting.

 **Who you are:**

* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands\-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering.

 **Why Planet**


Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast\-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel\-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you. Apply now.


At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.

jobs.description:
**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp !


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

As a global leader in our space, SimCorp is on a journey to transform from a traditional enterprise software company into a technology\-enabled services business, while maintaining our double\-digit, highly profitable growth. To further support and drive this journey, we are transitioning to a horizontal delivery model, aligned to client outcomes. Within this setup, the Technical Enablement team plays a critical role in ensuring that value stream teams have the technical foundations, tooling, infrastructure, and support needed to deliver efficiently and reliably.


**We are looking for an IT Support Consultant** who enjoys solving complex technical problems, thrives in a collaborative environment, and takes ownership of issues from start to finish.


The Technical Enablement team is often the last point of escalation when delivery teams encounter technical challenges. As an IT Support Consultant, you will act as a trusted technical partner, helping teams navigate infrastructure, tooling, testing, and configuration\-related issues.


You will investigate problems, coordinate with specialist teams when required , and ensure issues are followed through to resolution. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, a structured troubleshooting mindset, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


This is not a traditional helpdesk role. You will be expected to understand technical systems, read and debug code when needed, and contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of our delivery environment.


**W** **HAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Provide first\-line technical support for infrastructure, tooling, environments, and development processes.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and coordinate resolution of technical issues , collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Take ownership of problems from initial investigation through successful resolution.
* Support and maintain test environments and end\-to\-end infrastructure.
* Monitor automated test executions and analyze failures to identify root causes.
* Collaborate with software engineers, architects, business consultants, and product teams to resolve delivery blockers.
* Assist business consultants in working with configuration and DevOps\-based development practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, quality, and delivery reliability.
**WHAT WE VALUE**

Your high\-quality communication, coordination and interpersonal skills will enable you to direct all activities to planned outcomes. As our preferred candidate , you will have :


* Experience in technical support, application support, IT operations, software delivery, DevOps, or a similar technical role.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate incidents and identify root causes.
* Ability to take ownership of issues and drive them through to resolution, coordinating with multiple stakeholders when needed.
* Basic understanding of software development principles and the software delivery lifecycle.
* Experience with, or willingness to work with, technologies and tools such as:
* C\# or another object\-oriented programming language
* Git and source control systems
* Test automation frameworks
* CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Azure DevOps or similar platforms
* Scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash, Python, etc.)
* Infrastructure, application, and environment troubleshooting
* Monitoring and logging tools
* SQL and database fundamentals
* Ability to read, understand, and debug code, even if software development is not your primary role.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working in an Agile environment.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on increasing efficiency, quality, and delivery reliability.
**BENEFITS**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp , we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. SimCorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.


There is never just only one route \- we practice a personalized approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.


**Compensation ranges are** **being** **disclosed** **at** **the** **initial** **stage** **of candidate engagement.**

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp : www.simcorp.com/career  



**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site.


**Please note that** only applications sent through our system will be processed.


At SimCorp , we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


For any questions you are welcome to contact **Hanna Brzózka, Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, at "** hanna.brzozka@simcorp.com **"** . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.


**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.title: AI Expert (RAG, Semantic Search, bazy wektorowe)
jobs.description:
Do Euvicowego Managed Teamu poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko **AI Expert** , która będzie pełnić rolę eksperta pierwszego kontaktu w obszarze sztucznej inteligencji. Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko zna nowoczesne rozwiązania AI, ale potrafi również ocenić ich biznesową wartość, zaprojektować odpowiednią architekturę i skutecznie doprowadzić wdrożenie do środowiska produkcyjnego.  



  

To wyjątkowa okazja, aby współtworzyć kierunek rozwoju kompetencji AI w organizacji oraz realizować projekty dla klientów z Polski i zagranicy. Poszukujemy praktyka, który ma za sobą udane wdrożenia produkcyjne wykorzystujące technologie takie jak **RAG, Semantic Search czy bazy wektorowe** i potrafi podejmować decyzje architektoniczne poparte doświadczeniem, a nie tylko teorią.  



  

Pierwszym projektem, do którego dołączysz, będzie współpraca przy rozwoju platformy klasy Enterprise Document Management. Produkt obsługuje miliony dokumentów i wykorzystywany jest przez klientów działających w środowiskach objętych wysokimi wymaganiami compliance. Głównym celem projektu jest zaprojektowanie i wdrożenie semantycznego wyszukiwania, które zastąpi lub rozszerzy tradycyjne podejście oparte wyłącznie na full\-text search i OCR.  



  

Dołączysz do międzynarodowego zespołu produktowego i będziesz odpowiadać za ocenę technologii, przygotowanie rekomendacji architektonicznych, wybór odpowiednich rozwiązań wektorowych oraz przekazanie wiedzy zespołowi klienta.  



  

**Technologie:**

RAG, Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, SQL Server 2025 VECTOR, pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch Dense Vectors, LLM, Embeddings, Hybrid Search, Reranking, .NET, MS SQL Server, Ollama, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, MCP, AI Agents  



  

**Dlaczego warto?**

* Dołączysz jako jeden z pierwszych ekspertów odpowiedzialnych za rozwój kompetencji AI w organizacji liczącej około 120 specjalistów
* Będziesz mieć realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju usług i rozwiązań AI oferowanych klientom
* Weźmiesz udział w projektach dla klientów z USA, Wielkiej Brytanii, krajów DACH oraz Skandynawii
* Będziesz pracować nad rzeczywistymi decyzjami architektonicznymi i wdrożeniami produkcyjnymi, a nie wyłącznie nad Proof of Concept
* Otrzymasz możliwość współpracy z zespołami deweloperskimi, QA, DevOps, UX i architektami
* Zyskasz dużą autonomię działania oraz wpływ na wybór technologii i kierunek realizowanych projektów
Będziesz rozwijać rozwiązania wykorzystujące najnowsze technologie związane z GenAI, LLM i wyszukiwaniem semantycznym  
* 

  

**Zadania:**

* Prowadzenie najbardziej wymagających technicznie projektów AI realizowanych dla klientów firmy
* Projektowanie architektury rozwiązań opartych o LLM, RAG oraz Semantic Search
* Ocena wykonalności technologicznej nowych inicjatyw AI oraz rekomendowanie optymalnych rozwiązań
* Analiza wydajności i skalowalności rozwiązań wykorzystujących bazy i wyszukiwarki wektorowe
* Projektowanie pipeline’ów indeksowania, strategii chunkingu i procesu generowania embeddingów
* Tworzenie benchmarków wydajnościowych oraz analiza jakości wyszukiwania semantycznego
* Podejmowanie decyzji dotyczących wykorzystania baz wektorowych oraz usług AI w środowiskach SaaS, private cloud i on\-premise
* Udział w warsztatach discovery, spotkaniach presalesowych i konsultacjach technicznych z klientami
* Przedstawianie i obrona rekomendacji architektonicznych przed technicznymi decydentami po stronie klienta
* Mentoring zespołów projektowych oraz rozwijanie kompetencji AI w organizacji
Prowadzenie wewnętrznych szkoleń oraz definiowanie standardów i dobrych praktyk w obszarze sztucznej inteligencji  
* 

  

**Nasze oczekiwania:**

* Udokumentowane wdrożenie produkcyjne rozwiązania wykorzystującego Semantic Search, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) lub technologie wektorowe
* Praktyczne doświadczenie z co najmniej jedną bazą lub usługą wektorową, taką jak Azure AI Search, pgvector, SQL Server VECTOR, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant lub Elasticsearch/OpenSearch Dense Vectors
* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu strategii chunkingu dokumentów oraz budowie procesów retrieval opartych o embeddingi
* Znajomość technik oceny jakości wyszukiwania, takich jak recall, precision, hybrid search czy reranking
* Umiejętność samodzielnego projektowania architektury rozwiązań AI i podejmowania decyzji technologicznych
* Doświadczenie w analizie wydajności i skalowalności systemów produkcyjnych
* Umiejętność przygotowywania benchmarków technologicznych i przedstawiania wyników klientom
* Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego umożliwiająca codzienną współpracę w środowisku międzynarodowym
* Gotowość do pracy na styku ról inżynierskich, architektonicznych, konsultingowych oraz presalesowych
Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne i prezentacyjne  
* 

  

**Mile widziane:**

* Znajomość ekosystemu Microsoft Azure, w szczególności Azure OpenAI oraz Azure AI Search
* Doświadczenie w pracy z technologiami .NET oraz Microsoft SQL Server
* Praktyczna znajomość self\-hostowanych modeli embeddingowych i inferencyjnych (Ollama, vLLM, ONNX Runtime)
* Doświadczenie z systemami dostarczanymi jednocześnie w modelu SaaS i on\-premise
* Znajomość zagadnień związanych z MCP, agentami AI oraz orkiestracją LLM
* Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu szkoleń, warsztatów lub mentoringu technicznego
Doświadczenie w pracy z klientami enterprise działającymi w środowiskach regulowanych  
* 

  

**Model pracy:** zdalnie (Polska) / hybrydowo / on\-site


**Preferowana lokalizacja:** województwo śląskie (okazjonalne spotkania zespołowe)


**Forma współpracy:** B2B


**Start projektu:** połowa października


**Czas trwania projektu:** długoterminowa współpraca


**Wymiar:** full time  



  

**Przebieg procesu rekrutacyjnego:**

* Rozmowa techniczna z zespołem (ok. 60 minut) obejmująca architekturę oraz doświadczenia z rzeczywistych wdrożeń AI

Opcjonalna rozmowa z technicznym przedstawicielem klienta  

* 
  

**WAŻNE INFORMACJE:**

* W trakcie procesu rekrutacji na kolejnych jej etapach wymagana będzie weryfikacja tożsamości kandydata.
* Pierwszy dzień pracy odbywać się będzie stacjonarnie w jednym z biur Euvic (onboarding, odbiór sprzętu).

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Operations Supervisor**


*Do you enjoy creating structure, keeping priorities moving, and connecting the dots across a complex operational environment? As Operations Supervisor at GlobalConnect, you will work closely with our Customer Operations leadership team to strengthen operational follow\-up and turn priorities into action.*



This is a broad coordination role where daily operations meet continuous improvement and transformation. You will have visibility across Customer Operations in the Nordics and work with colleagues, leaders, specialists, and customers across functions and countries.


**To succeed in this role, you likely have:**


* Experience from a coordination, cross\-functional, or business\-facing role in a larger organisation preferably from telecom, IT, operations, service management, or another complex delivery environment.


* Experience with operational follow\-up combined with improvement initiatives, transformation, or project execution.


* A good understanding of customer delivery, service management, KPI follow\-up, and management reporting, including experience preparing presentations and decision\-support material for management.


* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and at least one Scandinavian language.


**About the role and the team**



Customer Operations is responsible for the operational delivery of services to GlobalConnect customers across the Nordics. The department includes Customer Support, Service Desk functions across several countries, the Advanced Solutions Service Desk, and Operations Management.



Based in our Stockholm office, you will support structure, coordination, and progress across operational and strategic priorities. You will work closely with the Senior Director, Customer Operations, who is based in Fornebu, Norway, while reporting to the Head of Operations Management.



The role brings you close to both daily operations and longer\-term development. Over time, the scope may also develop to include people management responsibilities, depending on organisational development and business needs.


**What you’ll be working on**


* Coordinate and follow up operational priorities, actions, decisions, and deliverables across Customer Operations.


* Drive structured follow\-up of transformation initiatives, improvement activities, and priority deliverables.


* Monitor KPIs, trends, and risk areas and coordinate relevant follow\-up actions across the department.


* Prepare management presentations, status updates, reporting, and decision\-support material.


* Support strategic customer follow\-up, critical cases, and escalations, including participation in relevant customer meetings.


* Coordinate across Customer Support, Service Desk, Advanced Solutions Service Desk, Operations Management, and other relevant functions to support progress and execution.


**Who we are looking for**



You work in a structured way and are comfortable balancing immediate operational needs with longer\-term priorities. You can identify what matters, create clarity across several activities, and keep follow\-up moving when priorities change.



The role involves frequent interaction with leaders, customers, specialists, and colleagues across countries, so clear communication and the ability to build effective working relationships are important. You are motivated by improving how things work and by turning plans, decisions, and improvement initiatives into progress.



Relevant higher education in management, administration, technology, finance, or a related field is beneficial, but relevant experience can compensate for formal education. Experience from telecom, IT, operations, service management, or another complex delivery environment is also an advantage.


**Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.**


**Our recruitment process**


* Talent Acquisition Screening interview
* Hiring Manager interview
* Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition
* Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder
* Final alignment meeting
* References


**Practical information**


* Workplace: GlobalConnect's office in Stockholm.


* The role requires regular travel to Fornebu, Norway and the other locations where Customer Operations colleagues are based.


* GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.



This is an opportunity to take a central role in how Customer Operations coordinates priorities, follows up performance, and progresses operational improvements across the Nordics.



No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.



Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

jobs.title: Process- och Ugnsingenjör
jobs.description:
**About the Position**
======================

För att framställa de mest hållbara och konkurrenskraftiga produkterna till våra kunder strävar vi efter att ständigt förbättra och optimera våra produktionsprocesser. Höganäs är världsledande inom metallpulverindustrin och processerna är energiintensiva. Vi står inför spännande utmaningar för att göra dessa processer klimatneutrala och cirkulära. Inom gruppen för ”Core Process Development” samlar vi vår kärnkompetensen inom smältning, atomisering, reduktionsprocesser, glödgning, pulverhantering och energiteknik.


Höganäs processer är till stor del unika och vi designar och bygger därför vår utrustning själva.


Som Process\- och Ugnsingenjör kommer du huvudsakligen jobba med våra tunnelugns\- och bandugnsprocesser. Här ingår allt från nyinvesteringar och moderniseringar till processförbättringar och effektiviseringar av befintliga. Ugnarna kan vara både el\- och gaseldade med avancerade säkerhetssystem.


Tjänsten är placerad i Höganäs och gruppen är en del av Product \& Technology inom PMT divisionen.


**Din profil**

* Vi söker dig som har en relevant civilingenjörsexamen i maskinteknik, kemiteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet/fördjupning inom strömningsteknik, värme\- och massöverföring, termodynamik, förbränningsteknik och metallurgi är starkt meriterande.
* Vi ser att du har åtminstone 5 till 10 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom liknande arbetsområde.
* Vi ser gärna att du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med naturgas och/eller vätgas. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av ugnar och högtemperaturprocesser är det ett extra plus.
* Då du kommer att arbeta i en internationell miljö men även i nära samarbete med produktionen i Sverige behöver du behärska både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

**Personlig profil**

Som person är du nyfiken och inte är rädd för att kavla upp ärmarna och hjälpa till där det behövs. Du bör ha fallenhet för kritiskt tänkande, vara noggrann och ha förmåga att både fokusera på detaljer och se helheten. jobs.title: LIA-praktik för utvecklare i Uppsala våren 2027

jobs.title: Applikationsexperter till Strömmande dataplattform
jobs.description:
Vi söker applikationsexperter inom AVEVA PI/OSIsoft PI till en myndighet inom elkraft för arbete med en strömmande dataplattform.


Detta är ett konsultuppdrag. Stationeringsort är Sundbyberg.


Uppdraget omfattar en IT\-specialist nivå 2 på 100 % och två IT\-specialister nivå 3 på 50 % vardera.


Uppdraget innebär ett nära samarbete med kunden vilket ställer stora krav på flexibilitet och samarbetsförmåga.

**Uppdraget**


Uppdraget avser arbete med en dataplattform baserad på AVEVA PI System. Konsulterna ska stödja IT\-förvaltningen med vidmakthållande och vidareutveckling av systemet i nära samarbete med systemansvarig IT, övriga medarbetare inom IT\-förvaltningen och pågående projekt.


Arbetet omfattar bland annat felrättning, användarstöd, daglig IT\-drift och underhåll samt anpassningar, förbättringar och vidareutveckling av lösningen.

 **Arbetsuppgifter**


Driva och genomföra uppgraderingar och systemförbättringar samt installera, konfigurera och iordningställa nya systemmiljöer.


Vidareutveckla systemet genom teknisk kravspecificering, framtagande av nya lösningar och skapande av integrationer mot datakällor.


Ge stöd och support till interna och externa parter samt samarbeta med andra IT\-förvaltningar, driftsorganisationer, projekt och intern personal.


Samordna tester och själv genomföra delar av testarbetet samt säkerställa att tekniska förändringar inte påverkar driftsäkerhet eller befintliga funktioner.


Hantera IT\-incidenter och genomföra felsökning i det egna systemet och tillsammans med angränsande IT\-system.


Uppdatera systemdokumentation, exempelvis drift\- och förvaltningsanvisningar samt dokumentation av systemberoenden.


Delta i IT\-säkerhetsarbete, bland annat risk\- och sårbarhetsanalyser och omvärldsbevakning inom informationssäkerhet.


Ge användarstöd för framtagande och byggande av rapporter i PI Vision.

**Krav (OBS, obligatoriska)**

**För IT\-specialist nivå 2:**


Du ska ha högskole\-/universitetsutbildning omfattande minst 120p/180hp inom IT, alternativt yrkeshögskoleutbildning omfattande minst 400 yrkeshögskolepoäng inom IT, alternativt minst 4 års arbetslivserfarenhet i roller som IT\-specialist, systemadministratör eller systemutvecklare.


Du ska ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet under de senaste 5 åren av installationer, uppgradering, konfiguration, vidmakthållande och applikationsdrift av AVEVA PI/OSIsoft PI.


Du ska ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av support, samordning och kommunikation mot externa och interna parter.


Du ska ha erfarenhet av arbete i eller för en stor myndighet med samhällskritisk och komplex verksamhet, där stor myndighet innebär fler än 1 500 medarbetare.


Du ska ha erfarenhet av arbete inom energisektorn.


**För IT\-specialist nivå 3:**


Du ska ha högskole\-/universitetsutbildning omfattande minst 120p/180hp inom IT, alternativt yrkeshögskoleutbildning omfattande minst 400 yrkeshögskolepoäng inom IT, alternativt minst 9 års arbetslivserfarenhet i roller som IT\-specialist, systemadministratör eller systemutvecklare.


Du ska ha minst 6 års arbetslivserfarenhet under de senaste 8 åren av installationer, uppgradering, konfiguration, vidmakthållande och applikationsdrift av AVEVA PI/OSIsoft PI.


Du ska ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av support, samordning och kommunikation mot externa och interna parter.


Du ska ha erfarenhet av arbete i eller för en stor myndighet med samhällskritisk och komplex verksamhet, där stor myndighet innebär fler än 1 500 medarbetare.


Du ska ha erfarenhet av arbete inom energisektorn.

**Meriterande**


Minst 3 års sammanlagd arbetslivserfarenhet, heltidsekvivalent, av praktiskt och operativt arbete i Microsoftbaserade IT\-miljöer. Erfarenheten ska omfatta både drift och förvaltning, exempelvis incidenthantering, felsökning och användarstöd, samt utveckling eller vidareutveckling, exempelvis konfiguration, anpassningar eller systemförbättringar. Arbetet ska ha utförts i en aktiv utförarroll och inte enbart avsett samordning, ledning eller strategiskt arbete.


Minst 1 års arbetslivserfarenhet av systemutveckling i .NET.


Minst 1 års arbetslivserfarenhet av scriptning i Python, PHP, Ruby eller PowerShell.

**Övriga krav**

**Säkerhetsprövning:** Säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll krävs.

**Om oss**


Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt.


Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov.


Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerad personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet.


För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst.


Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se.

**Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska.**


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: Automationsingenjör till industrinära IT
jobs.description:
Vi bygger nästa generations IT för industrin, lösningar som styr, mäter och förbättrar produktion hos riktiga tillverkare. Nu söker vi en driven automationsingenjör som vill ta med sig sin kunskap från golvet och koppla ihop den med modern mjukvara.
  
Det här är en roll för dig som gillar bredd framför spets. Du behöver inte vara djupast i världen på en enskild PLC\-plattform. Vi letar efter dig som ser hela kedjan, från maskin och styrsystem hela vägen upp till data, integration och beslutsstöd. Och framför allt: du gillar att jobba fram lösningar nära och tillsammans med kunden, inte i ett stängt rum utifrån en färdig spec.
  
Automationen är ett ben vi vill bygga upp och växa, och här får du en central och drivande roll. Det innebär mycket eget ansvar, men också en stor möjlighet att forma hur vi jobbar med automation, vilka lösningar vi satsar på och vart vårt erbjudande tar vägen. Du får vara med och lägga grunden, inte förvalta något som redan är satt.
  
VAD DU KOMMER ATT GÖRA
  
Förstå kundens produktion och verksamhet, och tillsammans med dem forma lösningar som faktiskt gör skillnad
  
Jobba brett över hela stacken, från PLC, SCADA och OPC ute i maskinen till integration, data och moderna IT\-lösningar
  
Koppla ihop OT och IT, hjälpa industriella system att prata med varandra (till exempel UNS och MQTT)
  
Driva uppdrag hela vägen, från idé och design till driftsättning och uppföljning hos kund
  
Använda AI\-verktyg för att jobba snabbare och smartare utan att tumma på kvalitet eller säkerhet
  
Vara en trygg partner för kunden, någon de vill ha kvar och ringa igen
  
Dela din kunskap med teamet och lära dig nytt tillbaka
  
  

VEM VI SÖKER
  
Vi bryr oss mer om vem du är än exakt vilka system du jobbat i förut. Din nyfikenhet, ditt driv och din vilja att lära nytt väger minst lika tungt som raderna på ditt CV.
  
**Erfarenhet av industriell automation:** PLC, SCADA, OPC eller liknande i skarp produktionsmiljö
  
Bredd framför spets, du trivs med att röra dig mellan olika tekniker och discipliner snarare än att gräva ner dig i en enda
  
Ett genuint intresse för kunden, du lyssnar, förstår verksamheten och jobbar fram lösningen tillsammans med dem
  
Självständighet, du kan driva ett uppdrag och ta ansvar hela vägen
  
Vilja att bredda dig och koppla ihop den klassiska automationsvärlden med modern IT och AI
  
God kommunikationsförmåga och lust att jobba i team
  
  

MERITERANDE
  
Vi letar efter en bred profil, så ju fler av områdena nedan du har erfarenhet av, på ett eller annat sätt, desto bättre. Vi förväntar oss inte att någon behärskar allt. Har du djup på några och nyfikenhet på resten är det precis rätt person.
  
**Styrsystem:** PLC\-programmering, främst Siemens men gärna andra fabrikat, ABB\-styrsystem, HMI\-utveckling och idrifttagning, motordrifter, servo och frekvensomriktare, felsökning i skarp drift
  
**Robotik och maskinseende:** robotar från till exempel ABB eller Omron, vision
  
**El och hårdvara:** elritningar, bygga och koppla elskåp, sensorer och givare, pneumatik och hydraulik
  
**Industriell kommunikation:** PROFINET, PROFIBUS, IO\-Link, RS\-232, RS\-485, socket och TCP/IP, OPC UA, MQTT, UNS\-filosofi
  
**OT\-utrustning:** vågar, skannrar och annan produktionsnära utrustning, IoT\-enheter och edge\-servrar
  
**IT och mjukvara:** C\# eller Python, Docker och Linux, tidsseriedata och decentraliserade system, SCADA\- och IIoT\-plattformar som Ignition, MES och produktionsteknik, AI\-verktyg i ditt dagliga arbete
  
  

**Och framför allt:** ett generellt brett teknikintresse och genuin lust att lära nytt.
  
VAD VI ERBJUDER
  
Tekniskt ledarskap och mentorskap. De som leder teamet har själva byggt team och produkter, och lägger tid på att du ska växa
  
En bred roll där du jobbar över hela kedjan, från maskin till modern IT
  
Nära kundkontakt och stort eget ansvar
  
Ett litet, sammansvetsat team med korta beslutsvägar och utan prestige
  
Ett modernt, AI\-drivet arbetssätt genom hela leveransen
  
En chans att bygga upp vårt automationsben från grunden och forma det åt ditt håll
  
Tid och utrymme för lärande och utveckling
  
  

Du jobbar nära kunderna och deras produktion, och det du levererar går i drift och används på riktigt. Vägen från idé till färdig lösning är kort. Gillar du att lösa riktiga problem tillsammans med människor tror vi att du kommer trivas hos oss.
  
OM REALPROIT
  
**RealProIT bygger produktionsnära IT för industrin:** stödsystem, integrationer och moderna plattformar som gör tillverkning smartare. Vi är en del av RealCognit Group och ett litet, snabbfotat bolag där varje person gör verklig skillnad. Vi sitter i Örebro och Västerås.
  
Vi är ett gäng med många intressen, från sport och skapande till riktigt bra kod, och vi värdesätter balans och ett liv utanför jobbet. Hos oss får du kombinera automationens verklighet med modern mjukvaruutveckling, och vara med och bygga något från grunden.
  
ÖVRIG INFORMATION
  
Vi rekryterar löpande och intervjuar efter hand, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Målet är att rätt person ska börja så snart som möjligt.
  
I den här rekryteringsprocessen använder vi AI\-verktyg som stöd i vårt arbete. Alla beslut fattas alltid av oss människor.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Expert – Product Development
jobs.description:
*We are looking for an experienced Cyber Security Expert to support the development of several new products with high requirements on cybersecurity, secure software development and compliance with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).*

*In this role, you will drive cybersecurity activities throughout the product development lifecycle and provide hands\-on support to developers and other technical stakeholders. The assignment combines cybersecurity expertise with software development, secure architecture and implementation.*

*The products include both desktop applications and embedded systems, with technologies ranging from hardware\-near firmware to real\-time operating systems and PC\-based software.*

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse current cybersecurity maturity and support compliance with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
* Perform cybersecurity risk assessments and follow up on implementation activities with relevant stakeholders.
* Drive and coordinate cybersecurity activities within product development projects.
* Perform and coordinate security testing, including DSAC testing.
* Conduct attack surface analyses and threat modeling.
* Review security\-critical source code.
* Support system hardening, including Windows images.
* Ensure compliance with internal cybersecurity requirements and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes.
* Identify and drive improvements within secure development practices.
* Participate in the requirements process and define appropriate security requirements.
* Design and implement security solutions for desktop applications and embedded systems.
* Drive security updates, vulnerability management and remediation processes.
* Prepare cybersecurity documentation covering areas such as architecture, manuals, processes and agreements.
* Prepare development projects for cybersecurity and security reviews.
* Monitor relevant vulnerabilities, threats and security updates.
* Support assessments of suppliers' compliance with cybersecurity requirements.
* Collaborate with internal and global cybersecurity stakeholders.
* Technical Environment

**Experience within one or several of the following areas is highly relevant:**

* Embedded systems and firmware
* C / C\+\+
* VHDL / Assembler
* Real\-time operating systems (RTOS)
* C\# / Java
* Windows\-based applications and environments
* Secure software architecture and implementation
* Vulnerability management and security testing

**Your Profile**


We are looking for someone with solid experience in Cyber Security within product development, ideally combined with a background in software development, software architecture or embedded systems.


You should have practical experience working with secure development processes and be comfortable supporting development teams in areas such as security requirements, secure design, implementation, testing and vulnerability management.


Strong collaboration and communication skills are essential, as the role involves working with a wide range of technical stakeholders in both local and international environments.

**Experience with CRA compliance, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC), threat modeling, security testing and security architecture is highly meritorious.**

**This is a full\-time consultant position through Incluso, starting in Mid\-October. It is a five\-month contract.**

**We will review applications on an ongoing basis.**

**Application deadline: 25 September.**

**For more information about this role, please contact Karin Persson**

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare
jobs.description:
Kumpan
  
Vi tycker att det ska vara roligt att gå till arbetet. Att ha en arbetsplats som bygger på gemensamma värderingar, där kollektivet och kompetensen står i centrum. Våra Kumpaner är vår viktigaste tillgång, och det är genom dem som många av våra beslut formas.
  
Arbete är inte allt här i livet
  
Visst är det kul att arbeta – särskilt när man får lösa spännande tekniska problem tillsammans med andra utvecklare. Men ibland kommer livet emellan.
  
Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats och litar på att våra Kumpaner tar kloka beslut som fungerar för både individen och företaget. Hos oss får du sex veckors semester, flexibilitet i vardagen och möjlighet att ibland bryta vardagen med konferenser eller gemensamma aktiviteter.
  
Det ska löna sig att arbeta
  
Bra folk ska ha bra lön.
  
Utöver en konkurrenskraftig lön erbjuder vi en generös pensionsavsättning och något vi tycker är extra viktigt: här delar vi på vinsten. När det går bra för oss ska det märkas för alla.
  
Vi maxar även friskvårdsbidraget och erbjuder en riktigt bra sjukvårdsförsäkring.
  
Kumpaner är konsulter med gemenskap
  
Vår samlingsplats är kontoret vid Mosebacke. Här träffas vi några dagar i veckan, samarbetar och löser våra kunders tekniska utmaningar tillsammans.
  
Luncher, spontana diskussioner om teknik, brädspel – framåt eftermiddagen hör till vardagen.
  
Vem tror vi att du är
  
Du är en nyfiken utvecklare som gillar att lösa problem och bygga stabila system. Du uppskattar att arbeta i team där kunskapsdelning och tekniska diskussioner är en naturlig del av vardagen.
  
Det du behöver kunna när du börjar hos oss
  
Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk bakgrund inom Microsofts utvecklingsplattform. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
  
Minst sju års erfarenhet av utveckling i .NET / C\#
  
**Erfarenhet av ASP.NET Core och utveckling av moderna API:** er
  
Erfarenhet av containerbaserade miljöer, exempelvis Docker och Kubernetes
  
Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis Scrum eller SAFe
  
Erfarenhet av moderna frontendramverk, exempelvis Angular, React eller Vue
  
Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska, både i tal och skrift
  
  

Det är meriterande om du också har
  
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar, exempelvis Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud
  
Erfarenhet av AI\-lösningar, exempelvis LLM\-integrationer eller AI\-baserade funktioner i system
  
  

Lite mer om oss
  
Vi är en webb\- och konsultbyrå som funnits sedan 2004\. Vi utvecklar webb och appar i open source\-miljö och arbetar med kunder inom många olika branscher och tekniska miljöer.
  
Vårt kontor ligger uppe på Mosebacke, precis bredvid Södra Teatern.
  
För fler frågor kontakta nea@kumpan.se.

jobs.title: Digital Development Specialist
jobs.description:
Digital Customer Offering (DCO) is a business function within Fortum Consumer Solutions, where business and technology come together. At DCO, we create superior digital offerings and experiences for our 2,4 million consumer and enterprise customers. We innovate and find new ways to digitalize our offerings and processes. We collaborate closely with our stakeholders and external partners. Through cross\-functional collaboration, agility and sustainability focus, we strive to make our customers’ increasingly digital lives easier with our services. We serve clients in the Nordics as well as Poland and Spain.

  

**About the role**


We are looking for talented and passionate individuals to join our Enterprise Online team. This role involves capturing user and business needs and translating these into initiatives that maximize customer value and ensure a world\-class user experience for our Nordic customer base. United by our passion for technology, curiosity about user experience, and dedication to excellence, we are looking for someone who shares our enthusiasm!

  

Your responsibilities will be:


* Bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions by gathering, analyzing, and documenting detailed business requirements, ensuring that digital offerings meet customer needs and align with Fortum's strategic objectives.
* Develop use cases, user stories, and use planning tools such as Jira and Miro to follow up and support development.
* Define, manage and communicate the Product backlog to stakeholders and team.
* Prioritize and ensure that work is being conducted according to plan and set goals and support in solving blockers.
* Manage multiple projects and adjust priorities based on changing business needs.
* Solve complex problems requiring an understanding of both business and technical aspects.
* Collaborate with team members to foster a customer\-centric approach.
* You will be part of the Enterprise Online team, focusing on developing and improving services for our enterprise customers. We work within an Agile approach, taking end\-to\-end responsibility for our area. Our team, consisting of 15 experts with diverse competencies, has a great atmosphere where we work hard and have fun. We offer a dynamic work environment where you can grow your skills and make an impact on Fortum’s business and customers.

  

This position can be located in our office in Espoo, Solna or Oslo.

  

**About you**


To succeed and thrive in this role, we see that you have:


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum 2\-4 years of experience in digital development or a similar role.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with requirements management tools and familiarity with Agile methodologies.
* Previous experience from the energy industry is beneficial.
* Be fully fluent in English, both spoken and written.

  

**We offer you**
  

At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.


More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.

  

**Interested?**


Submit your application by **01\.10\.2026** at the latest. We will begin actively screening during the application period and hire as soon as the right candidate is found. We will not consider applications outside our recruiting system. If you would like to hear more about the position, please contact hiring manager Thale Fritzner by email thale.christina.fritzner@fortum.com.
  

For Swedish candidates: contact details to union representatives can be found on the bottom of **this page****.**

  

**We are Fortum**
  

Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. jobs.title: Mjukvaruingenjör inom testautomation
jobs.description:

OM TJÄNSTENI rollen som mjukvaruingenjör kommer du att utveckla och förbättra automatiserade testsystem som kvalitetssäkrar produkter innan de lämnar produktionen.
  
Du arbetar praktiskt med automatisering av sluttester och utvecklar stabila och effektiva testflöden i C\#. Rollen omfattar även underhåll och vidareutveckling av befintliga testriggar. Arbetet för dig nära både mjukvara och hårdvara – från programmering av testlogik och integrering av mätinstrument till felsökning av utrustning och optimering av testernas prestanda.
  
Du samarbetar med kollegor inom produktion, hårdvaruutveckling och kvalitet och får därigenom följa hela processen, från produkt\- och testkrav till en färdig lösning som används i serieproduktion.
  
Det här är en tjänst för dig som vill förstå mer än själva koden och som är nyfiken på hur mjukvara samverkar med elektronik, instrument och fysiska produkter.
  
ARBETSUPPGIFTERDina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att vara att:
  
Utveckla testautomation och effektiva testflöden i C\# för serieproduktion
  
Underhålla och vidareutveckla befintliga sluttestriggar
  
Felsöka testutrustning och optimera testernas prestanda
  
Ta fram nya testlösningar och ny testlogik för befintliga och framtida produkter
  
Integrera mätutrustning och testinstrument, exempelvis digitala multimetrar, oscilloskop, CAN\-/LIN\-gränssnitt och strömförsörjningsaggregat
  
Samarbeta med produktionsteam, hårdvaruingenjörer och kvalitetsspecialister
  
Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter inom effektivitet, tillförlitlighet och underhållbarhet

VI SÖKER DIG SOMHar en högskole\- eller universitetsutbildning inom mekatronik, elektroteknik, datateknik eller ett närliggande område

Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to protecting critical infrastructure and supporting the secure operation of one of the Nordic region's leading energy companies? We are looking for a Security Manager to join our Security team in Sweden. In this role, you will help ensure that security risks are managed effectively while supporting compliance with important security regulations and requirements.  

**About the role**
As a Security Manager, you will play an important role in strengthening Fortum's security capabilities and ensuring that security\-related work is carried out in line with business objectives, internal requirements, and relevant legislation.  

You will take independent responsibility for one or more security areas, such as:
* Physical security
* Personnel security
* Information security
* Supplier security

  

You will develop, implement and maintain methods, processes and routines within your areas of responsibility. The role requires a structured and proactive approach, as well as the ability to manage complex matters and make sound decisions independently.  

You will work closely with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, support functions and external authorities. In addition, you will provide guidance and training within your areas of expertise to help strengthen security awareness and compliance throughout the organisation.  

We offer a hybrid work model to support your productivity; you are expected to be at the office two to three times a week.  

The position is based at our office in Solna, Stockholm.  

**About you**
To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of security knowledge, strong judgement and the ability to work independently in a complex environment.  

We are looking for someone who has:
* A relevant university degree in law, technology, security or a related field
* At least two years of experience working within one or more security disciplines
* The ability to communicate effectively in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing
* A systematic and structured way of working
* High integrity, sound judgement and strong security awareness

  

Experience working with protective security is considered an advantage, as is experience in business development.  

**We offer you**
At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.  

More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.  

For permanent employment with Fortum Sverige AB, you may be assigned a wartime posting within the organization. For further information regarding wartime posting, please refer to the Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency.  

**Interested?**
Submit your application latest on 27th of September. We start contacting suitable candidates already during the application period. If you have questions and would like to hear more about the position, please contact recruiting manager Jachym Ctvrtek at jachym.ctvrtek@fortum.com  

Contact details to union representatives can be found on the bottom of this page.  

To be selected for the position, the applicant must undergo security vetting in accordance with the Swedish Protective Security Act (2018:585\) and a health examination including drug testing.  

**We are Fortum**
Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best\-in\-class low\-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. Fortum’s power generation is already 99% from renewable or nuclear sources with one of the lowest specific CO2\-emissions in Europe. We are guided by our ambitious SBTi\-validated emission reduction targets on our way towards net\-zero by 2040\. For our \~4,500 employees, we commit to be a safe and inspiring workplace. jobs.title: Senior AI Foundry Arkitekt
jobs.description:
Vill du ta AI\-lösningar från idé till säker och skalbar produktion? Vi söker en senior AI Engineer med kompetens på arkitektnivå och fokus på Microsoft Foundry. Rollen passar dig som kombinerar djup teknisk förståelse med förmågan att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till lösningar som skapar konkret nytta.
  
Om rollen
  
Du ansvarar för arkitektur och tekniskt genomförande av AI\-lösningar på Microsofts plattform. Du arbetar genom hela livscykeln – från behovsanalys och teknikval till utveckling, utvärdering, driftsättning och vidareutveckling.
  
Det är en praktisk arkitektroll där du både fattar övergripande designbeslut och själv utvecklar kod. Du vägleder andra utvecklare och förklarar tekniska vägval för såväl verksamhet som IT.

* Utforma lösningsarkitektur för AI\-applikationer och agenter med Microsoft Foundry och Azure.
* Utveckla lösningar med språkmodeller, RAG, verktygsanrop och integrationer mot verksamhetssystem.
