* Leda tekniska workshops, dokumentera arkitekturbeslut och stötta kollegor i implementationen.


Vi söker dig som
  
* Har gedigen erfarenhet av systemutveckling och lösningsarkitektur i Azure.
* Har praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft Foundry eller Azure AI Foundry och av att utveckla lösningar med stora språkmodeller.
* Har tagit AI\-lösningar till produktion och förstår kraven på tillförlitlighet, prestanda och förvaltning.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Developer
jobs.description:
At Manta Marine Technologies, we are committed to advancing greener shipping through intelligent technologies — supporting operational efficiency, reduced carbon emissions and fuel consumption as well as simplifying emissions reporting. We provide a wide range of innovative and intelligent maritime technologies, including Vessel Optimisation solutions, Marine Electrification systems and comprehensive Lifecycle Services for all our products. Manta Marine is headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with offices in Sweden, Poland, and China.
  
Do you want to help us to promote a healthy planet for future generations? We are currently seeking a Senior Embedded Developer to enhance our Vessel Optimization team.
  
  

Main responsibilities
  
As part of Manta Marine Technologies Vessel Optimization business line, you’ll work with FuelOpt, our onboard fuel optimisation system installed on more than 500 vessels worldwide. FuelOpt helps ship owners improve operational performance, reduce fuel consumption, and lower emissions through real\-time propulsion optimisation.
  
As a Senior Embedded Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining embedded applications running on our proprietary hardware platform. You will work closely with other developers, application engineers, and adjacent product teams to deliver reliable and high\-quality solutions for vessel operating worldwide.
  
The role combines software development, troubleshooting, product improvement, and technical collaboration across the organization.
  
  

Key responsibilities
  
Develop and maintain embedded software in C running on real\-time embedded kernel, on in\-house hardware
  
Contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of our proprietary hardware platform
  
Diagnose and resolve issues across hardware, operating system, and application layers
  
Participate in concept development and implementation of new product features
  
Develop and maintain internal tools that support system configuration and deployment
  
Integrate software with operator\-facing HMI solutions
  
Review, test, and improve code quality and development practices
  
Collaborate with adjacent engineering teams on shared solutions
  
Provide technical support and expertise to internal stakeholders and customer\-facing teams when needed
  
  

Background and skills
  
We are looking for a Senior Embedded Developer with at least six years of professional experience in embedded software development. You hold a BSc or MSc in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent. You have strong programming skills in C and experience working in complex embedded environments.
  
  

**Furthermore, you have:**  

Experience with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) or real\-time embedded kernels
  
Experience developing software on custom or non\-standard hardware platforms
  
Strong debugging skills across hardware and software boundaries (e.g., JTAG)
  
Experience with industrial and embedded communication protocols such as TCP/IP, Modbus, serial communication, or similar
  
The ability to work independently and take technical ownership of solutions
  
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken
  
  

Meriting experience
  
Experience in one or several of the following areas is considered an advantage:
  
Experience with HMI integration (e.g., Beijer Electronics or similar industrial HMI platforms)
  
Familiarity with C\# for scripting/configuration tooling
  
Familiarity with Python for internal tooling/automation
  
Practical understanding of digital/analog I/O and basic electronics
  
Experience in maritime and/or industrial automation
  
Exposure to cybersecurity practices, especially in embedded/connected systems
  
Experience with IoT devices and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)
  
  

Personal qualities
  
We believe you are a curious and technically driven person who enjoys solving complex problems. You are analytical, structured, and take ownership of your work. As a senior developer, you are comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different teams. You enjoy sharing knowledge, contribute to a high\-quality engineering culture, and take a pragmatic approach to solving technical challenges.
  
  

What we offer
  
We offer an opportunity to be part of a market leading innovative global company in the forefront of green technology for ships. An open and inspiring environment where your energy will make a difference. We provide great potential for personal and professional development.
  
Manta Marine is committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is not only the right thing to do, but also the smart thing to do. Let’s make the world a greener place!
  
  

Application
  
When submitting your application, please include "Application – Senior Embedded Developer" in the subject line of your email. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

The motto "Teamwork makes the dream work" truly resonates with you, and you take pleasure in sharing knowledge to help others grow.


#### **Responsibilities**

* As a test automator, your role will encompass several key responsibilities crucial to ensuring software quality and efficiency and examples of your tasks and responsibilities are:
* Identify what aspects of the testing process should be automated, making recommendations based on business benefits. This involves a deep understanding of the application's functionalities and the potential return on investment from automation.
* Developing an automation strategy and documenting it. This strategy will outline the tools and frameworks to be used, the scope of automation, and the processes for maintaining and updating automated tests.
* Writing and executing automated tests is a core responsibility. Creating test scripts using tools like Selenium, Postman, SoapUI, and ReadyAPI, ensuring these tests effectively validate the software’s functionality and performance.
* Coordinating, prioritizing, and communicating the test work will be essential. Working closely with development teams, business analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure that testing efforts align with project timelines and priorities. Effective communication will ensure that everyone is aware of the testing progress and any issues that arise.
* Reporting status, current risks, and recommended ways forward at both operational and strategic levels is crucial. You will provide regular updates on the testing status, highlight any risks or issues that could impact the project, and propose solutions to mitigate these risks.
* Your role as a test automator is pivotal in ensuring the software meets quality standards and delivers a seamless user experience.

jobs.title: Salesforce-utvecklare
jobs.description:
*Vill du vara med och forma hur AI förändrar Salesforce och framtidens kundupplevelser?*


Vi söker dig som är en skicklig utvecklare – men framför allt dig som är nyfiken på vad som händer när Salesforce, data och AI möts.


På Stretch Customer vill vi ligga i framkant och hjälpa våra kunder att gå från att prata om AI till att faktiskt skapa värde med det. Därför söker vi fler personer som vill vara drivers inom området. Du behöver inte kunna allt om AI idag. Däremot vill vi att du experimenterar, lär dig snabbt, utmanar gamla arbetssätt och tycker att den utveckling som sker just nu är riktigt spännande.

**Så här ser din vardag ut**


Som Salesforce\-utvecklare hos oss arbetar du hands\-on med spännande projekt, olika Salesforce Clouds och kunder med höga ambitioner.


Du utvecklar och designar tekniska lösningar tillsammans med våra affärskonsulter, projektledare och andra utvecklare. Allt oftare handlar det om möjligheterna som uppstår när CRM, data, automation och AI möts – exempelvis genom Agentforce, generativ AI och nya AI\-drivna arbetssätt.


Vi vill inte bara följa utvecklingen – vi vill vara med och driva den. Därför får du utrymme att experimentera, bygga prototyper, testa ny teknik och dela det du lär dig med både kollegor och kunder.

**Vem vi letar efter**

* Erfarenhet av Salesforce – exempelvis Apex, Lightning Components och Flows – eller minst fyra års erfarenhet som utvecklare inom exempelvis Java och/eller .NET.
* Erfarenhet av API, databasutveckling och integrationer.
* Ett stort intresse för AI och en vilja att utforska hur tekniken kan skapa verkligt affärsvärde. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Agentforce, generativ AI, LLM eller AI\-agenter är ett plus.
* Möjlighet att arbeta i Stockholm eller Göteborg 2–3 dagar i veckan.
* Starka kommunikativa färdigheter i svenska och engelska.

**Vi tror att du är**

* Nyfiken – du gillar att testa nya verktyg, tekniker och idéer.
* Drivande – du ser möjligheter, tar initiativ och får med dig andra.
* Teknisk med affärsförståelse – du gillar bra kod men är lika intresserad av vilket värde lösningen skapar.
* Kommunikativ och prestigelös – du delar gärna kunskap och tror på att de bästa lösningarna skapas tillsammans.

**Och lite om oss**


Vi på Stretch Customer är ett gäng nyfikna och engagerade Salesforce\-konsulter som älskar att göra skillnad – för våra kunder, för varandra och för våra affärer.


Vi tror på att testa, lära och dela kunskap – och på att ha kul på vägen. Tillsammans skapar vi framgång för oss själva, våra kunder och hela Stretch.


Vi växer i både Stockholm och Göteborg och ser fram emot din ansökan!


Hej från oss på Stretch Customer!

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About us**


At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.


At Davy, you are the difference.


Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high\-net\-worth individuals, self\-directed investors, small\-to\-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic \& international institutional investors.


Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.

* Support the delivery of business performance reporting to management and key stakeholders.

**Performance Management Support**

* Support the production and ongoing development of performance scorecards and reporting frameworks.

* Provide analytical support to managers and business stakeholders.
* Ensure performance data is accurate, timely and actionable.

* Support data quality improvement initiatives across business systems and processes.
* Assist in maintaining data integrity, consistency and governance standards.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Present findings, insights and recommendations in a clear and concise manner.
* Support projects and initiatives that require analytical expertise and business insight.

**Essential**

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of data governance and data quality management practices.
* Experience working within financial services or a regulated industry.
* Relevant professional qualifications or industry certifications would be an advantage.

  

**Benefits** **What we offer**

**Positive Workplace**

Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.


**Values and Culture**

Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.


**Important Information**


Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. Er du klar til å bli en sentral role hos Norges raskest voksende Shopify byrå?


Scandicommerce er et Shopify Plus Partner\-byrå i sterk vekst. Vi har allerede tredoblet resultatene fra i fjor, og ligger an til å femdoble dem. Vi jobber med noen av Norges mest spennende og ledende varemerker, og vi er blant de mest aktive aktørene i det norske ehandelsmiljøet, både på scenen, i partnernettverkene og i konkrete leveranser hos kundene.


Nå ser vi etter en Senior E\-commerce Rådgiver som kan Shopify inn og ut, og som vil være med på å forme løsningene til ambisiøse nettbutikker sammen med oss.


Du blir vår CTOs nærmeste sparringspartner. I dag eier han løsningsarkitekturen og prosjektansvaret på flere av våre største kundeleveranser, din jobb blir å ta over stadig mer av dette, slik at vi kan fortsette å vokse og levere kvaliteten våre kunder forventer!


**Hva du skal gjøre**
* Utforme løsninger sammen med vår CTO ut mot kunder \- fra behovsavklaring og løsningsarkitektur til leveranse
* Ta kunde og prosjektansvar: eie dialogen, fremdriften og resultatet
* Jobbe hands\-on med integrasjoner og arbeidsflyter mellom Shopify og ERP/OMS
* Koordinere utviklingsteamet og sikre at leveransene treffer på scope og kvalitet
* Jobbe tett med partnerne våre for å finne den beste løsningen for hver kunde \- ikke den enkleste for oss

**Hvem vi ser etter** **Må ha:**
* Solid Shopify\-erfaring \- du kjenner plattformen inn og ut
* Erfaring med integrasjoner og arbeidsflyter mellom netthandel og ERP\-systemer \- for eksempel Microsoft (Business Central), Visma, Unimicro, Finago eller Odoo
* Erfaring med KI\-verktøy og agenter i praktisk arbeid \- hos oss er KI en naturlig del av både leveransene og hverdagen, fra agentbaserte arbeidsflyter til agentic commerce
* Forstår API\-er \- du kan lese API\-dokumentasjon, forstå datamodeller og designe integrasjonsflyter mellom systemer
* Kommersiell teft og trygghet i kundedialog \- du forstår hva som skaper verdi
* Evne til å eie ting ende\-til\-ende og levere i tempoet til et selskap i vekst

**Stort pluss:**
* Erfaring med Omnium
* God forståelse for det norske ehandelsøkosystemet (Vipps, Bring, norske ERP\-landskap)
* Erfaring med Make.com eller tilsvarende automatisering
* En stemme i bransjen, du skriver, snakker eller blir oppsøkt for råd
* Forståelse av API og UCP
* Kan lede utviklere

**Hvorfor scandicommerce**
* Du kommer inn i et selskap i kraftig vekst med reelle muligheter til å påvirke retningen
* Fastprismodell som gir tydelighet på scope, ikke timeregistrering og fakturajag
* Varierte prosjekter for ledende varemerker, ingen to prosjekter er like
* Full\-stack leveranser: Shopify Plus, ERP, OMS, POS og integrasjoner
* Vi bygger egne produkter og verktøy \- inkludert KI\-drevne løsninger som effektiviserer både våre egne og kundenes arbeidsflyter
* Konkurransedyktige betingelser og fleksibel arbeidshverdag
* Aksjonæravtale for riktig kandidat
* Kontor på Skøyen (Drammensveien 167\) med kantineavtale
* Sertifiseringer, kurs og bransjearrangementer
* Et lite, direkte og faglig sterkt team med lav byråkrati og høyt tempo

**Slik søker du**
Dropp søknadsbrevet. Send oss CV\-en din sammen med korte svar på tre spørsmål:


* Hva er det med denne rollen og scandicommerce som gjør at du vurderer å ta steget?
* Hva er det beste eksempelet du har på et e\-commerce\-prosjekt du har eid eller bygget \- hva var problemet, hva gjorde du, og hva ble resultatet?
* Hvordan jobber du best \- med kunder, med team, og når du eier ting alene?
Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gir beskjed etter hvert steg i prosessen \- ingen ghosting.


Kontakt: christian@scandicommerce.no · \+47 333 94 000



**Om bedriften**
----------------


Scandicommerce er et norsk Shopify Plus Partner\-byrå med kontorer på Skøyen i Oslo og i Tønsberg. Vi ble grunnlagt i 2024 av to erfarne e\-handelsprofiler med bakgrunn fra både plattform og konsulentsiden, med ett tydelig mål: å utfordre måten e\-handelskonsulenter jobber på.


Der bransjen tradisjonelt selger timer, leverer vi til fastpris. Det gir kundene våre forutsigbarhet og oss et sterkt insentiv til å bygge smart, gjenbrukbart og effektivt. Modellen fungerer: Vi har allerede tredoblet resultatene fra i fjor og ligger an til å femdoble dem.


Vi leverer hele verdikjeden i moderne netthandel, Shopify Plus, integrasjoner mot norske ERP\-systemer (Visma.net, Business Central, Finago), ordrehåndtering med Omnium, og fysisk handel gjennom vår egen POS\-løsning bygget for norske compliance\-krav. Vi har partnerskap med aktører som Shopify, Vipps MobilePay og Nets/Nexi, og bygger egne KI\-drevne produkter som effektiviserer både våre og kundenes arbeidsflyter.


Kundene våre er ambisiøse norske og nordiske merkevarer i vekst \- fra etablerte retailkjeder til raskt voksende D2C\-merker. Vi er svært aktive i det norske ehandelsmiljøet, blant annet som hovedsponsor av Virke Arena Handelskonferansen 2026 sammen med Shopify.


Vi er et lite, faglig sterkt team med lav byråkrati, høyt tempo og en kultur der praktikere og rådgivere jobber side om side. Hos oss får du reell påvirkning på et selskap i kraftig vekst.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Technology Leadership and Engagement
jobs.description:
**About the role**
We are looking for an energetic Executive Assistant and Team Lead for Technology Support and Engagement with a positive “let’s get this done” mindset. A creative and problem\-solving personality is key to providing daily, proactive support on Executive and Management team level within the Fortum IT function – could this be you?  

Key responsibilities will include but not be limited to
* Manage and develop the technology leadership support and engagement team, leading executive assistants and engagement specialists in delivering effective leadership support, coordination and engagement activities.
* Ensuring accuracy and timely delivery of Digital and Technology related KPIs and performance reporting.
* Supporting in tasks related to the SVP, IT (CIO) agenda and daily work including coordination of appointments, events, documentation and actions as needed.
* Supporting the IT Leadership Team by driving IT’s agenda by managing the meeting schedule, taking minutes, managing action points, and co\-creating meeting agendas. Participating in Leadership team meetings as required, which would include some travel.
* Coordinate leadership communications, engagement activities, events and initiatives that strengthen collaboration, culture and employee experience across the Digital and Technology area.
* Independently manage assigned administrative responsibilities, ensuring proactive follow\-up, effective coordination and timely execution of agreed actions, outcomes and next steps.
* The position is located in Espoo, Finland.

  

**About you**
We will get you started and introduce you to our ways of working – however, we do appreciate:
* Previous experience supporting senior technology leaders, preferably in an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Team Lead or similar coordination role.
* A university\-level degree, such as BBA, HSO or similar, is an advantage.
* Fluent written and spoken English and Finnish; other languages are an asset.
* Strong digital skills and experience using modern productivity, collaboration and AI tools.
* Strong information\-seeking skills and confidence working in unfamiliar contexts and rapidly changing environments.
* A proactive and independent approach to assistance and support.
* Ability to work in a multitasking environment where situational awareness, urgency and prioritization are essential.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  

**We offer you**
At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.  

More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.  

Espoo office is a smoke\-free workplace.  

**Interested?**
Submit your application in English at latest on the 25th of September. We start contacting suitable candidates already during the application period. If you have questions and would like to hear more about the position, please contact Katri Vuorinen, Executive Assistant to SVP IT, via email at katri.vuorinen@fortum.com.  

To be selected for the position, the applicant must go through background clearance and a health examination including drug testing.  

**We are Fortum**
Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best\-in\-class low\-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. Fortum’s power generation is already 99% from renewable or nuclear sources with one of the lowest specific CO2\-emissions in Europe. We are guided by our ambitious SBTi\-validated emission reduction targets on our way towards net\-zero by 2040\. For our \~4,500 employees, we commit to be a safe and inspiring workplace. Fortum's share is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. fortum.com

jobs.title: Account Management Senior Specialist for a Sustainability SaaS
jobs.description:
We are looking for an **experienced Account Management Specialist** to work within our LCA Account Management team, focused on the Nordic market and large global customers.

**Why One Click LCA Group?**


We have united the world’s leading sustainability solutions to accelerate the transition to a zero\-carbon future. With One Click LCA and SimaPro now under one umbrella, we bring together the most trusted, science\-based tools and expertise in the industry. Our combined platforms power environmental transparency, decarbonisation, and circularity across different industries and product value chains.


By integrating deep methodological expertise with innovative, AI\-driven technology, we enable organisations to measure, understand, and reduce environmental impacts with accuracy and efficiency. Our solutions empower companies to make better decisions for the planet at scale.


Here you will join a supportive, effective, and mission\-oriented team in a flexible, friendly work environment. You will be working with cutting\-edge tools and a team of world\-class professionals around the globe to solve one of the world’s biggest challenges.

*This full\-time, permanent position is available on a remote basis for candidates based in the Nordics / EU.*

### **What you will do:**

* You will lead our efforts to retain and grow our existing customer base, focused on mid\-tier and large customers, playing a key role in driving our Gross and Net Revenue retention
* Build strong, trusted relationships with our customers as the basis for revenue expansion and retention
* Own and manage our renewals so that this compelling event is maximised as much as possible
* Identify, nurture, and close expansion opportunities, utilising our impactful array of products for cross\-sell and effectively white space mapping your portfolio
* Use the data at your disposal and work closely with CS Ops to proactively identify customers at risk of churn and work across teams to find solutions to retain them
* Work closely with colleagues in the Nordics market team to act on industry opportunities, attend events and back up marketing campaigns
* Proactively segment and sort accounts under your management to ensure your time is spent targeting the right customers, in the right order
* There are plenty of opportunities to drive improvements in the way we retain and grow our customer base. You will be expected to seize them and be a changemaker for the better

### **What you need:**

* You have proven experience in B2B SaaS, working in Customer Success or Account Management to drive NRR across a portfolio of customers
* Experience in identifying, nurturing and closing €15,000\+ revenue expansion opportunities
* Data\-driven. You use the data at your disposal to identify insights and come up with plans to act on them
* You are proactive and creative. Each customer is different, and you love figuring out how to engage them
* You are happy picking up the phone to customers as a way to drive retention or expansion
* You are an orchestrator and a collaborator. You know you can’t win every retention battle or expansion opportunity on your own, and you know when to engage sales, product, CS or others to maximise the chances of success
* You are metrics\-driven. You thrive on challenging individual and team targets
* You are fluent in English, our working language, and also in Finnish and/or Swedish, reflecting the region you will cover
* Experience in LCA, building sustainability or embodied carbon\-related fields is not essential but would be beneficial

### **What we offer:**

* Work in a growing business that helps bring about a zero\-carbon future
* Fulfilling, meaningful work at a successful, stable and fast\-growing business
* Substantial freedom, with no fixed hours and remote working
* Challenges, substantial responsibility and the chance to see the results of your work directly
* Competitive compensation and opportunity for professional development
* A dynamic, friendly, motivated and diverse team of top\-notch professionals
* Great colleagues, social events and ability to contribute to market transformation

### **Interested?**


We are eagerly waiting for your application until **27 September 2026**. Applications are reviewed upon receipt, so please apply promptly to be considered.

I Bygma tilbyder vi faglig dybde og geografisk bredde. Derfor har du store muligheder, når du vil lægge næste lag på din karriere. I salg eller i stab. På lager eller i ledelse. Sådan hjælper vi med at bygge Danmark.
  
  

**Fastansat/tidsbegrænset:** Fastansat
  
**Timer:** 37\.0
  
  

Erfaren Fullstack\-udvikler til Bygma Gruppen
  
  

Vil du udvikle digitale løsninger og samtidig tage ansvar for at drive udviklingsopgaver fremad sammen med teamet?
  
  

Vi søger en erfaren Fullstack\-udvikler til Bygma IT \& Digitalisering. Du bliver en del af vores interne udviklingsteam, hvor vi arbejder med alt fra websites, CMS og e\-commerce til webapplikationer, API'er og integrationer.
  
  

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack\-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning \- fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.
  
  

Jobbet
  
Du bliver en del af Bygma IT \& Digitalisering med ca. 35 kolleger og får en central rolle i udviklingsteamet med reference til Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov. Stillingen er med base på vores hovedkontor i Søborg.
  
  

Du arbejder selv hands\-on med udviklingen og tager samtidig en drivende teknisk rolle i større opgaver. Sammen med interessenter og resten af teamet omsætter du behov fra forretningen til gode tekniske løsninger, får opgaverne brudt ned og bidrager til at skabe fremdrift hele vejen til implementering.
  
  

Vi arbejder tæt på forretningen og de løsninger, der er i brug hver dag. Derfor består jobbet både af nye udviklingsopgaver og den løbende videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger. Det betyder også, at du sammen med teamet tager fat på bugs, mindre forbedringer og konkrete forespørgsler fra forretningen, når de opstår.
  
  

**Dine opgaver bliver bl.a. at:**  

udvikle og videreudvikle fullstack webapplikationer og digitale løsninger
  
  

tage ansvar for løsningsbeskrivelse og teknisk afklaring
  
  

nedbryde større udviklingsopgaver og drive dem fremad sammen med teamet
  
  

videreudvikle vores CMS\- og e\-commerce\-platforme
  
  

udvikle både frontend og backend samt API'er og integrationer
  
  

håndtere bugs, forbedringer og løbende behov fra forretningen
  
  

sikre stabile, vedligeholdelsesvenlige løsninger, der er effektive at drifte
  
  

sparre om arkitektur, teknologi og best practices
  
  

Din profil
  
Du har flere års erfaring med fullstack webudvikling og gerne solid erfaring med CMS og e\-commerce.
  
  

Vi leder efter en reel fullstack\-profil, som er stærk i .NET/C\#, men som også har solid erfaring med frontend\-udvikling og selv arbejder med Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript og moderne webteknologier. Du trives med at arbejde på tværs af hele løsningen \- fra brugerfladen i frontend til API'er, integrationer og data bagved.
  
  

Du trives med hele spændet i udviklingsarbejdet. Den ene opgave kan være en større ny funktion, den næste en fejl i en eksisterende løsning eller en konkret forespørgsel fra en kollega i forretningen. For dig er det naturligt at tage ansvar for begge dele.
  
  

Du har også blik for løsningen, når den er sat i produktion. Drift er en naturlig del af vores udviklingsansvar, og du tænker derfor stabilitet, performance, vedligeholdelse og effektiv drift ind i de løsninger, du er med til at bygge.
  
  

**Vi arbejder bl.a. med:**  

.NET / C\#
  
  

CMS og e\-commerce – vi anvender pt. Optimizely / Episerver
  
  

Angular
  
  

JavaScript / TypeScript
  
  

SQL og databaser
  
  

Web API'er og integrationer
  
  

Vi tilbyder
  
Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af Bygmas digitale platforme og mulighed for at præge både løsninger og tekniske valg.
  
  

Hos os er IT tæt på forretningen. Vejen fra idé til implementering er kort, og det, du udvikler, bliver hurtigt brugt i praksis. Vi følger vores løsninger efter implementering og arbejder løbende med både drift, forbedringer og videreudvikling.
  
  

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for at få tingene i mål.
  
  

Kan du se dig selv hos os?
  
Så søg jobbet via linket på denne side. Fristen er 8\. oktober 2026\. Vi holder løbende samtaler og kan derfor vælge den rette kandidat inden ansøgningsfristens udløb. Så skynd dig at sende os din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
  
  

Bemærk, at vi kun modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem.
  
  

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov på \+45 27 78 08 18\.
  
  

Om Bygma Gruppen
  
Bygma Gruppen A/S er den største danskejede leverandør af byggematerialer til det professionelle byggeri, og vi giver vores kunder rådgivning, service og kvalitet på branchens højeste niveau.
  
  

I Bygma Gruppen er vi fagfolk, som handler med fagfolk. Vi ved, at godt grej er afgørende for håndværkeren. At entreprenøren har brug for et samarbejde uden knaster. At en byggeplads kræver stram styring og varer til tiden.

Bygma Gruppen beskæftiger ca. 3\.000 medarbejdere fordelt på flere end 125 forretningsenheder i både Danmark, Sverige, Island, Færøerne, Polen og Grønland og omsætter årligt for over 10 milliarder kroner.

Det indebærer både at skabe stærke relationer, følge op på resultater og sikre, at fælles mål og aftaler omsættes til konkrete handlinger. Du skal derfor trives med både at samarbejde, udfordre konstruktivt og stille forventninger til vores partnere, når det er nødvendigt for at skabe de bedste resultater.


**Derudover vil du:**

* Udvikle og vedligeholde stærke relationer til strategiske samarbejdspartnere og fungere som deres primære kontaktperson.
* Planlægge og gennemføre træning, workshops og løbende sparring, så partnernes medarbejdere er klædt på til at rådgive om Ayvens' produkter og løsninger.
* Besøge samarbejdspartnere på tværs af Danmark og gennemføre opfølgningsmøder med fokus på performance, kvalitet og forretningsudvikling.

Understøtte vores private leasingforretning gennem professionel håndtering af kunde\- og forhandlerhenvendelser samt sikre et effektivt lead\-to\-order\-forløb.  
* 

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor samarbejde, vidensdeling og kundeoplevelser er centrale elementer i hverdagen. Rollen giver dig en bred kontaktflade på tværs af både interne afdelinger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere, og du får mulighed for at påvirke udviklingen af vores private leasingforretning.


**Vores kommende Account Manager**

Du har erfaring fra en rolle inden for account management, salg eller partnerudvikling, hvor du har arbejdet med relationer og interessenthåndtering. Du motiveres af at skabe værdi for kunder og samarbejdspartnere og trives med at tage ansvar for både den daglige drift og de langsigtede relationer. Du kan opbygge tillid og stærke relationer, men er samtidig komfortabel med at have de nødvendige dialoger om forventninger, performance og udviklingsmuligheder.


Derudover er der stor sandsynlighed for at **få succes i rollen** , hvis du:


* er struktureret og har sans for detaljer
* arbejder proaktivt og tager ansvar
* har god talforståelse og kommerciel indsigt
* behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale
er en erfaren bruger af IT\-værktøjer og Microsoft 365  
* 

**Grib mulighed for personlig og professionel udvikling**

Vi sørger for, at du kommer godt fra start med både en ”Buddy” og et tilpasset onboarding\-program, der vil sørge for, at du får en god start i Ayvens Danmark. Når du først er faldet til, vil du opleve et passioneret og fagligt miljø, hvor mere end 200 engagerede kolleger venter.  



  

I Ayvens er vores medarbejdere et af vores største aktiver. Derfor er vi klar til at investere i din professionelle udvikling og give dig muligheden for at opnå nye færdigheder. Vi tilbyder selvfølgelig også medarbejderfordele og \-frynsegoder som bl.a.:


* Firmabil
* Bonusordning.
* Ekstra feriefridage.
* Ekstraordinær god pensionsordning.
* Sociale arrangementer for at fremme team spirit og det sociale sammenhold.
* Kantine og nye kontorfaciliteter.
Og meget mere...  
* 

  

**Er du klar til at køre med?**

Send os dit CV og ansøgning senest d. 30/9 2026\. Bemærk: Det er kun ansøgninger gennem vores ansøgningsplatform, der vil blive taget i betragtning.
  

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sales Manager, Frederik Ahm, på mail: Frederik.AHM@ayvens.com  



  

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.  



  

**Why Ayvens?**

  

With over 3\.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full\-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi\-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well\-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.  



  

At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology\-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.  



  

Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

You will be joining an innovative application development team within SimCorp's Product Division. We provide a cloud native SaaS product buil t on Azure using modern development principles, technologies and practices.


The product, Digital Engagement Platform (DEP) has been operational for over 5 years and based o n client feedback and our own experience we have begun to lift the product to the next level, modernizing architecture and tech stack so we can scale DEP for a much larger audience than we can today.


This is why we need you \- to help test and ensure the quality assurance of the new DEP 2\.0 that we are build ing that can support the biggest clients, asset managers, across the globe.


The future success of our SaaS hinges on the ongoing enhancement of the application and the refinement of associated processes and tools. QA will continue be a vital element of this journey. While we have achieved remarkable milestones, there are still challenges to conquer.


Your contribution to the robustness of the DEP will be pivotal as we continually onboard new clients , ensuring high performance, top\- notch security, and exceptional user experience for a diverse clientele .

jobs.title: Internship in DSP and Wireless Technology
jobs.description:
*Are you passionate about digital signal processing and wireless communication? Do you want to become a part of a cross\-disciplinary development group with dedicated and experienced colleagues? Would you like to leave your mark on future technology choices in Kamstrup within wireless communication?*


**Here is what the job entails**
  

As our intern, you will become part of our technology projects, where we investigate and develop new intelligent radio systems. You will be involved in several phases of the projects with tasks ranging widely from concept development to analysis and simulation of performance to actual prototyping.


More specifically, you will be:


* Working with digital signal processing (DSP)
* Developing tools for testing new radio technologies and protocols
* Preparing mathematical analyses and simulation using Python
* Working with prototype implementation on radio development boards, possibly in C\+\+, VHDL, MatLab, C\#, etc.
* Exploring Software Defined Radio (SDR) platforms and the GNU Radio framework.

During your internship, you will have the opportunity to work with different projects and in different areas depending on your interests and aspirations. Moreover, you will work with dedicated and experienced colleagues who will support your personal and professional development through close collaboration and continuous sparring.


**Meet your future team**
  

As our intern in Tech Lead, you will become part of our technology development team consisting of 6 dedicated employees. Here, you will participate on equal terms with your colleagues in a cross\-disciplinary development group who are developing and shaping the wireless communication systems of the future for remote reading of utility meters. The department has a good working environment, where you will discover that both freedom with responsibility and personal development are in focus. The team has extensive experience with employing interns and has, over time, had more than 20 interns. Several of the former interns are still employed at Kamstrup.


Did you know? We are all interested in technology and go on team events where we have, among other things, had guided tours of the parking garage beneath Dokk1 in Aarhus, the robotic warehouse at Proshop, and the waste incineration plant in Lisbjerg.


**Less about us, more about you**
  

We are looking for an enthusiastic student who is eager to up\-to\-date theoretical knowledge and contribute to the development of wireless technologies at Kamstrup. During the internship, you will collaborate with the team on a variety of tasks and technical areas, including some you may not have encountered before in your studies. Therefore, a can\-do attitude and a willingness to learn are important to us. Of course, we will support and guide you throughout the process.


In order to succeed, we imagine that you:


* Are currently studying Electronics, Software Technology or a related degree
* Have a professional interest in, particularly, electronics, mathematics, communication theory, and software development
* Are thorough and structured and are excited by seeing your ideas become reality
* Can work independently and possess a critical mindset with the aim of finding the best solution
* Value collaboration and proactively seek professional sparring with your colleagues on your own initiative

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.


Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to .


**We offer more than just an internship**  

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhuset Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.


Besides the best program, we also offer:


* The internship is paid if your place of study allows it
* Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches
* Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in\-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic
* An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?**
  

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027\.


Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.


In case of questions regarding the position, please contact Manager, Flemming Hald, on phone: \+45 89 93 10 00\.

  

  

***Get to know us***  

*At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close\-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.*

*Explore more on our* *website**, see our* *annual report**, and stay updated through* *LinkedIn* *for the latest news and job openings.*

**Application deadline:**
  

As soon as possible

Value \& Access TA Head Immunology \& Neuroscience, APMA  

Location : Singapore  

\#LI\-Hybrid  

  

Are you an experienced Value \& Access leader ready to shape sustainable patient access across diverse healthcare systems? We are looking for a strategic, collaborative leader to drive regional V\&A execution for an assigned Therapeutic Area across Asia Pacific Middle East Africa (APMA) markets.  

  

As Region V\&A Therapeutic Area Head, you will translate international strategies into locally relevant access plans, influence asset\-level strategy through Integrated Product Access Teams, and enable countries to secure timely, sustainable, and value\-based patient access. You will lead access readiness, pricing and lifecycle inputs, performance improvement, and cross\-country collaboration while partnering closely with Medical, Commercial, Corporate/Public Affairs, Finance, Regulatory, and other functions.
### **About the Role**

**Major Accountabilities:**

* Shape and execute V\&A strategy: Drive Therapeutic Area access strategies across the region, align international direction with country needs, and guide markets through access challenges and opportunities.
* Lead launch readiness: Own the V\&A contribution to Launch Readiness Reviews, ensure high\-quality deliverables, and coordinate cross\-functional risk identification, action planning, and follow\-through.
* Accelerate access performance: Use dashboards, analytics, Execution Excellence, and Access360 insights to identify high\-impact opportunities, strengthen payer engagement, and scale cross\-country learning.
* Influence pricing decisions: Provide regional input on pricing assumptions, profitability, competitive benchmarks, gross\-to\-net implications, business cases, and cross\-country pricing decisions.
* Shape the external environment: Partner with Public Affairs and other stakeholders to address market access barriers, strengthen reimbursement pathways, monitor policy developments, and support healthcare\-system readiness.
* Build regional capability: Develop tools, training, frameworks, and communities of practice across pricing, negotiation, HEOR, HTA, evidence generation, and access execution.
* Lead through collaboration: Unite regional and country teams, foster an inclusive and high\-performing culture, support talent development, and role\-model ethics, compliance, and an enterprise mindset.

**Requirements**

* An advanced degree in life sciences, health economics, public health, business administration, or a related field; an MBA is an advantage.
* At least 15 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including significant leadership responsibility in market access, pricing, reimbursement, health policy, or a closely related discipline.
* A strong record of developing and executing access strategies, leading cross\-functional teams, and influencing effectively in a complex matrix environment.
* Experience engaging payers, health technology assessment bodies, health authorities, and other external stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of pricing, reimbursement, evidence requirements, scenario planning, contracting, value communication, and healthcare\-system dynamics.
* International or above\-country experience across multiple markets or regions; country V\&A experience and relevant Therapeutic Area expertise are strongly preferred.
* The ability to translate complex access challenges and analytics into clear strategies, decisions, and measurable performance improvements.
* Commercial or profit\-and\-loss experience would be an added advantage.

**About us**
------------


At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world's largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.


The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.


We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society's evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together.


**ExxonMobil in Singapore**
---------------------------


ExxonMobil is one of Singapore’s largest foreign manufacturing investors with over S$25 billion in fixed asset investments.

  

  

We have manufacturing facilities that include an integrated world\-scale refining and petrochemical complex in Jurong and Jurong Island, a network of service stations under the Esso brand, operate a lubricant plant and are a supplier of cylinder cooking gas. ExxonMobil provides customers and commercial markets in the region with ground transportation, industrial, aviation and marine fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals and liquefied natural gas (LNG).

  

As Singapore serves as the AP hub for some of our businesses, we employ about 3,500 people across positions in operations, projects, commercial, corporate support functions and others.

  

  

ExxonMobil also contributes to community programs in Singapore that support the arts, education, health and the environment.  



  

For more information, visit **www.exxonmobil.com.sg** or follow ExxonMobil Singapore on LinkedIn and Instagram.


**ExxonMobil Global Trading**
-----------------------------


ExxonMobil Global Trading is where we trade oil, natural gas, and energy products safely and responsibly around the world. We leverage our expertise in analytics, logistics, origination, and knowledge of energy markets to maximize the value of our global assets and deliver industry\-leading results.

  

  

This is an exciting time to join our growing trading team and be an integral part of ExxonMobil.


**What role you will play in the team**
---------------------------------------


If successful, you will join ExxonMobil's Global Trading organization as a member of the Front Office technology team supporting commodity trading, commercial optimization, and market analytics activities across global energy markets.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Full Stack Developer with strong software engineering, data engineering, and application development capabilities to design, build, and support modern applications that enable traders, analysts, risk managers, and commercial teams to make informed decisions in fast\-moving markets.

  

In this role, you will work closely with trading desks, quantitative analysts, commercial teams, and technology professionals to develop scalable applications, data platforms, analytics tools, and workflow solutions that enhance market transparency, streamline operations, and create commercial value. You will play a key role in building production\-grade systems used directly by front\-office teams across crude oil, natural gas, LNG, refined products, power, environmental products, and related commodity markets.

  

**What you will do**
--------------------


* Develop, enhance, and maintain front\-office applications supporting commodity trading, market analytics, risk management, and commercial optimization activities.
* Design and build scalable full\-stack solutions leveraging modern front\-end, back\-end, and cloud technologies.
* Partner directly with traders, analysts, quants, and commercial stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into technology solutions.
* Build intuitive user interfaces, dashboards, and analytical workflows that improve decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and application integrations supporting market data, trading systems, and analytical platforms.
* Design, develop, and support data pipelines and data platforms that provide timely access to market, risk, operational, and fundamental data.
* Build tools that support pricing, market analysis, forecasting, position management, and trading workflows.
* Contribute to application architecture, technical design, and software engineering best practices.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve application performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, and platform teams to deploy and support production solutions.
* Implement automated testing, CI/CD processes, version control, and development standards across applications.
* Identify opportunities to modernize legacy processes and develop innovative solutions that improve front\-office productivity.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
**About you**
-------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing commercial or enterprise software applications using modern software engineering practices.
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production\-grade applications and services.
* Experience developing front\-end applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks such as React.
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Experience building data pipelines, data workflows, and data\-driven applications.
* Familiarity with cloud technologies including Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and development teams.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to operate in a fast\-paced commercial environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high\-quality solutions.
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience supporting energy trading, commodity trading, market analytics, or financial trading organizations.
* Understanding of commodity markets including crude oil, natural gas, LNG, refined products, power, environmental products, or related energy markets.
* Experience working directly with front\-office users such as traders, analysts, risk managers, or quantitative researchers.
* Strong proficiency in Python ecosystem tools including Pandas, NumPy, FastAPI, and related analytics libraries.
* Experience developing applications using React and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Experience building and supporting large\-scale databases, data warehouses, and market data solutions.

* Understanding of software engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, version control (Git), and DevOps methodologies.
* Knowledge of market data platforms, trading systems, and real\-time data integration processes.
* Experience developing applications that support trading, risk management, forecasting, optimization, or commercial decision\-making.
  
**Your benefits**

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last and we provide job rotations throughout your career with us. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance, and life.

jobs.title: AVP/VP, Fund Structurer, Global Financial Markets
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and execution\-driven AVP/VP, Fund Structurer to join our front\-office fund management desk. This unique hybrid role sits at the intersection of investment product manufacturing, multi\-asset trade execution, and legal/regulatory engineering.


Operating as a licensed representative of our fund manager, you will be responsible for translating the complex governance and aspirations of clients into robust, high\-performing investment vehicles. You will lead the legal and regulatory setup of our innovative Variable Capital Company (VCC) sub\-funds, drive best\-execution trading across global markets, and manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the portfolios.


**Key Responsibilities**  

1\. Fund Structuring \& Legal/Regulatory Engineering
  

* Architect Bespoke VCC Structures: Partner with wealth, corporate and financial institutional teams to design and implement innovative investment structures leveraging the Variable Capital Company (VCC) platform.
* End\-to\-End Fund Lifecycle Management: Support the full operational and legal lifecycle of the VCC, including the launch and legal setup of new sub\-funds, NAV validation oversight, corporate action elections, dividend distribution processing, and winding\-up procedures.
* Legal and Regulatory Compliance: Liaise closely with internal legal, risk, and compliance teams, as well as external legal counsel, to draft fund documentation (such as offering memorandums and investment management agreements) and ensure strict compliance with MAS VCC guidelines (e.g., AML/CFT under VCC\-N01\).
* To recommend, supervise and manage external lawyers to ensure that high quality and focused advice is received at reasonable cost and in a timely manner to appropriately protect bank’s and fund shareholder’s interests.
* To prepare and update standard form documentation and fund documentation (including the private product memorandum, termsheet, subscription agreement and other ancillary agreements etc.) for use by the business together with related guidance notes and other advisory materials for new and existing funds.
* To ensure the relevant legal and regulatory requirements are well understood by the business and are reflected in the relevant documentation and internal procedures.
  

2\. Portfolio Construction \& Multi\-Asset Trade Execution
  

* Front\-Office Best Execution: Operate as a licensed representative to execute trades across global markets (including Fixed Income, Equities, and Derivatives) with high accuracy and efficiency, ensuring minimal slippage and optimal fund performance.
* Portfolio Rebalancing \& Monitoring: Assist in portfolio construction, investment strategy positioning, and systematic rebalancing in line with the fund’s defined mandate and risk appetite.
* Risk \& Control Oversight: Monitor portfolio risk limits, manage market exposure, and ensure that all trading activities align with global risk management, internal compliance policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) .
* Operational Excellence \& Automation: Work with fund administrators and custodians to ensure the accuracy of Net Asset Value (NAV) reporting and build automation/digital workflows to scale fund operations.

  

**Key Requirements**  

* Experience: Relevant legal experience in the banking, asset management, or financial services industry, with direct exposure to wealth management, private banking, or capital markets execution desks .
* Education \& Professional Licensing: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline. Must be eligible to be registered as a licensed representative under the MAS capital markets services regime.
* Technical Structuring \& Legal Knowledge: Strong understanding of fund structures (both restricted and retail funds), with specific, hands\-on experience or deep exposure to Singapore Variable Capital Company (VCC) frameworks and legal documentation.
* Product \& Execution Mastery: Practical product knowledge across Fixed Income, Equities, and Derivatives, with prior experience executing trades and navigating portfolio management systems.
* Analytical \& Programming Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Strong aptitude for quantitative analysis, spreadsheet modeling, and problem\-solving; experience with programming/automation tools (e.g., Python, VBA, or SQL) is highly advantageous.
* Soft Skills \& Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication, coordination, and presentation skills. Must have the ability to influence senior internal stakeholders (Risk, Legal, Finance) and articulate technical structuring and market details clearly to family office clients and business partners .
* Mindset: Self\-motivated starter who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, leading operational change, and managing tight deadlines in a fast\-paced front\-office environment.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking, Insurance, and Chief Operating Office.


We are currently seeking a high calibre professional to join our team as a **VP, Customer Life Cycle Management**


The role ensures that customer insights and lifecycle triggers are translated into actionable engagement opportunities and targeted customer campaigns, leads the strategy and execution of lifecycle initiatives that increase customer engagement, cross\-sell, retention, and repurchase across the existing customer portfolio.

### **Description \& Requirements**

**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

* Contribute your talents to high\-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson and Revel
* Unite your passion for audio innovation with high\-tech product development
* Create pitch\-perfect, cutting\-edge technology that elevates the listening experience.

**About the Role**


In this role, you will be a core member of a small but effective integrated regional team that will help HARMAN build and grow APAC’s digital ecosystem.


You will be in charge of collecting, analysing, and interpreting complex data sets to provide insights that drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for data mining, analysis and data visualisation. You will also be able to work independently and as part of a team to deliver high\-quality results with the goal of bringing best in class experiences to life for our consumer. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for digital business growth.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Digital \& E\-Commerce, and this is an independent contributor role managing JBL and Harman Kardon across APAC. You will also be working collaboratively with our distribution partners, digital, ecommerce leads and regional business development managers to drive strategic thinking and KPI measurements.

**What You Will Do**


Data Collation and Analysis:

* Design and implement data collection methodologies and process to collate relevant data from multiple sources and ensure sanity check.
* Conduct detailed data analysis using data techniques, mining and visualisation to extract insights and identify trends.


Reporting and Visualisation:

* Create dashboards, reports and visualisations that effectively communicate data\-driven insights to various stakeholders.
* Present findings and recommendations to internal teams, stakeholders and senior management in an accurate and concise manner.
* Continuously refine reporting processes to improve accuracy, efficiency and effectiveness of data.


Business Insights and Strategy:

* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their analytical needs.
* Analyse data, work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Develop data visualisation to communicate findings.
* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analytics.
* Collaborate with the wider product and marketing team to plan and create digital driven marketing plans (includes paid media), content, creatives, KPIs \& reporting.
* Work in hand with the global insights team to manage and deliver an annual brand health insights report across key APAC countries.
* This role will also require you to manage agency relationships, to ensure data and reports are delivered on time.

**What You Need to Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s Degree in eCommerce/Digital analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field.
* 2 or more years working experience in data analytics.
* Strong understanding of data mining, analysis and data visualisation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex info to non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiar with eCommerce operating platforms, web analytics, UX\-UI tools (Google Analytics, Mouseflow or similar), Proficient in Excel, Power BI or similar tools.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Prior experience in Consumer Electronics or FMCG industry with APAC experience.
* Ability to juggle between the details and big picture, manage multiple and competing projects and priorities.
* Passion for and genuine curiosity for innovation in the Digital / e\-Commerce space and a passion for data analysis.
* Data/Insight\-driven, strong sense of accountability and solution\-oriented are key. Ability to draw insights from multiple data sources and formulate recommendations for improvements.
* Adaptable to ambiguity, changes and be at the forefront to lead change in both actions and behaviour.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a culturally\-diverse team environment, and understanding what it means to achieve success with others and through others.
* Excellent communicator and able to perform well in a matrixed organization.
* Proven experience in managing and influencing a network of local senior managers and managers in a cross functional team.

**What Makes You Eligible**

* Full working rights in Singapore.

**What We Offer**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development


**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.  

  

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.  

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!  

  

**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**

-----------------

* Participate in the full project lifecycle, including technical analysis, solution design, architecture, technology selection, and implementation planning.

	+ Page Layouts
	+ Reports \& Dashboards
	+ Workflows

* Experience with Salesforce integrations and third\-party APIs.

------------------------


* Experience leading Salesforce implementation projects from architecture and design through development and deployment.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce ecosystem and integration architecture.
* Experience working with complex enterprise environments and multiple integrated systems.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions.

To se odráží i v tom, že řadu úkolů budete moci řešit po svém \- hodnotíme výsledek. Zároveň se staráme o sladění pracovního a soukromého života a dokážeme dodržet „rádiový klid" po pracovní době.

Základní zkušenost s CI/CD pipeline nebo kontejnerizací (Docker)

jobs.title: Sportsbook Operations Associate - 3 month Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description:
**About Kambi**


*Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our services provide an end\-to\-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. From front\-end user interface to customer intelligence, risk management and odds compiling, all built on our in\-house developed software, we strive to deliver the ultimate service and solution to our partners.*


*Our vision is to create the world's leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners.*

**Sportsbook Operations Associate**



Type of Contract: Fixed\-term, 3 months initially.



Work Model: Office\-based, Bucharest.



Shifts: Varied, including evenings and weekends.


**The Role**



Love sport? Ever wondered what actually happens inside a sportsbook while a match is live? Here's an opportunity to find out from the inside.



We're looking for people to join Kambi's Trading team in Bucharest for a focused 3 month contract with the possibility for extension, working directly with live sporting events, markets and sportsbook operations.



You'll work alongside experienced colleagues and learn how decisions are made while matches are live and markets are moving.



You don't need previous sportsbook experience. If you know your sport, learn quickly, pay attention to detail and enjoy environments where things move fast, we can teach you the rest.



As a Sportsbook Operations Associate, your day\-to\-day work will look like:


* Monitor live sporting events and make sure markets are operating accurately.
* Support live trading activity, including real\-time odds adjustments within established processes.
* Spot issues quickly and help get them to the right people before they become bigger problems.
* Monitor third\-party sports data and identify anything that could affect an event or market.
* Work directly with traders, managers and operational teams during live events.
* Build knowledge across different sports and competitions as coverage needs change.


Some shifts will include evenings and weekends. Live sport doesn't only happen Monday to Friday, 9 to 5, and neither does this role.


**You'll be a great fit for the role if you:**


* Have a genuine interest in sport and understand how live sporting events work.
* Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Notice details other people sometimes miss.
* Can stay calm and focused when several things are happening at once.
* Are comfortable learning new systems and working across multiple tools.
* Can work varied shifts, including evenings and weekends.


Previous sportsbook experience is not required. Experience in operations or an international environment is useful, but it isn't essential.


**Why Join Us?**



Because in a short period of time, you can gain experience that is difficult to get from outside the industry.


* Real sportsbook experience: you'll work on live events, not simulations or training exercises for months before getting involved.
* Exposure to Trading: you'll see first\-hand how odds, sports data, market movements and operational decisions come together during live events.
* A steep learning curve: over a few months, you'll build practical knowledge across sports, systems and real\-time operations.
* Experience you can take with you: whether you're looking to enter sports betting, move towards trading or simply try something completely different, you'll leave the contract with genuine hands\-on experience in a global sportsbook environment.


And because the contract is initially for 3 months, you don't need to know today whether this is what you want to do for the next five years. Come in, learn the industry, contribute from early on and see where it takes you.



Local Benefits:


* 180 RON net monthly wellbeing allowance.
* 40 RON meal vouchers per working day.
* 35% enhanced night\-shift supplement for hours worked after 21:00\.
* Premium private medical insurance.
* Life insurance.
* Paid annual leave, pro\-rata for the contract period.


**Who We Are**



Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our technology powers sportsbooks around the world, covering everything from odds and risk management to trading, data and the user experience.



You'll be joining the team behind that operation.



Everyone belongs at Kambi



Kambi is committed to an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is.



So please come as you are – we can't wait to meet you!



Curious about how a sportsbook really works? Come and experience it from the inside.



Come and join us!



\#wearekambi

***Kambi's ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace***


*If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback.*


***Creating an inclusive environment***


*We believe Kambi's greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today.*


*\#wearekambi*

jobs.description:
Job Information


Level of experience


Expert
